After making changes, inspect and synchronize them explicitly: omztty sync status omztty sync push Shared shell edits made through omztty are already recorded as local commits when profile Git is enabled. push commits any remaining allowed changes, including manual edits, then pushes to the configured private repository. It checks the repository's ownership and visibility. Staged or tracked files outside the allowed configuration layout stop synchronization for review. Untracked files outside that layout remain local and are reported as Kept local. Keep credentials and machine-specific environment values in the local scope described in the shell guide. Git is the version history once the profile has its own repository. The shell manager stops creating new file snapshots, and its local commits stay on the machine until you push. Machine-specific environment values and the ordinary home rc startup block stay outside Git and receive no new snapshots in this mode. Previously saved snapshots remain local. Only allowed text configuration is synchronized. Binary files, caches, snapshots and local environment files are excluded. Set your Git commit name and email before enabling history or changing shared files. Review and restore a version omztty sync history omztty sync restore COMMIT omztty sync restore COMMIT shell/env.tsv history shows the latest 20 local commits with their short identifiers, dates and subjects. Choose COMMIT from that output. With no path, restore restores the shared shell/ configuration: environment values, PATH rules and rc snippets. Supply one path relative to the profile to restore a particular allowed file, including an application configuration under files/. Restore requires a clean working tree. It checks the selected configuration before writing and records the restoration as a new local commit. It creates no file backup and does not push. If the selected version predates a currently tracked file, restoring that file removes it and records the removal. Run omztty sync push when you want the restored version on your other machines. You can still edit configuration files directly. Review them with omztty sync status, then use omztty sync push to commit and synchronize allowed changes. Open a new shell after restoring shell settings. In Git mode, rc backups and rc restore direct you to these Git commands. Pull configuration changes status reads local Git state. Pull requires a clean working tree and fast-forwards the current branch: omztty sync pull If you have local edits, commit and push them first or review them with Git. If branches have diverged, resolve that history with Git before pulling again. The sync commands do not force-push, merge divergent histories or execute downloaded rc files. New shell sessions load the resulting settings through the configured startup entry. The profile's shell/ directory and allowed application configuration files are shared. Machine-specific variables, history, caches and existing restoration records are stored outside the synchronized profile. The .baseline/ copy of shipped defaults stays local and is excluded from Git synchronization. omztty config sync is an alias for the same profile-history and synchronization commands. Restore on another machine Install oh-my-ztty and sign in to the same GitHub account, then choose your existing private repository: gh auth login omztty setup --from YOUR_LOGIN/dotfiles omztty rc check omztty rc install --dry-run omztty rc install omztty shell Replace YOUR_LOGIN with your account name. --from requires the standard profile location to be absent and preserves an existing profile by refusing to overwrite it. The downloaded profile is not automatically linked over application configuration or sourced during the clone. New standard profiles adapt application configuration destinations to the current machine's XDG_CONFIG_HOME. Review the deployment plan before linking applications on that machine: omztty config plan --json omztty config apply --backup PATH entries under your home directory are portable. Recreate machine-specific environment values with omztty env set NAME VALUE on each machine. Review absolute paths in your own snippets and application files before using them on another system. Restoration does not copy another machine's .baseline/. Before using config refresh, follow the default-baseline requirements, including availability of the profile's recorded release when no baseline is saved. Update configuration with the suite Use the update scope that matches the change you want: omztty update --config-only omztty update --with-config --config-only pulls the configured profile without replacing the suite runtime. --with-config updates a per-user runtime and pulls its configured profile. The same clean-tree and fast-forward rules apply. Plain omztty update retains the suite-only update behavior; AUR installations update their runtime through the package manager. Run omztty config refresh separately when you want the new suite's unchanged application defaults. It compares against the saved default baseline and preserves your custom files. Manage an independent repository omztty dot links selected files from another repository into your home directory, backs up existing files when requested and restores those originals when you remove the deployment. Its lifecycle is separate from the standard suite profile. Create a layout omztty dot init --root "$HOME/dotfiles" This creates the file layout and a profile. It does not initialize Git or choose a remote. Copy the files you intend to manage into files/. For example, to manage an existing .zshrc: cp "$HOME/.zshrc" "$HOME/dotfiles/files/zshrc" printf 'files/zshrc\t.zshrc\n' > "$HOME/dotfiles/profile.zdot" Each profile line has a source path, a tab, then a destination path. The source is relative to the repository; the destination is relative to the target. Blank lines and # comments are ignored. Spaces and Unicode names are supported. Preview and apply For the .zshrc example, preview the replacement and apply it with a backup of the existing file: omztty dot plan --root "$HOME/dotfiles" --target "$HOME" --backup --json omztty dot apply --root "$HOME/dotfiles" --target "$HOME" --backup omztty dot status --root "$HOME/dotfiles" --target "$HOME" Plan only reads. Apply creates the managed link and records the saved original. Without --backup, an existing destination stops the operation. Repeating apply keeps matching links. Edits made through a managed symlink change the source file in the repository. Remove a deployment omztty dot remove --root "$HOME/dotfiles" --target "$HOME" Remove uses the saved deployment profile, checks link ownership and restores originals that were backed up. It refuses to remove a destination that you replaced. To change a deployed profile, remove its previous deployment, edit it, then apply again. Keep the repository at its original path until removal. For a per-user installation, omztty uninstall restores the adopted omztty config home profile before removing the runtime. Before removing the AUR package, run omztty config remove to restore that profile. Independent repositories deployed through omztty dot remain independently managed. Synchronize an independent repository Initialize the repository, commit selected files and configure a remote through normal Git commands. Once that is in place: omztty dot sync --root "$HOME/dotfiles" status omztty dot sync --root "$HOME/dotfiles" pull omztty dot sync --root "$HOME/dotfiles" push Sync uses the installed Git at /usr/bin/git or /bin/git. Pull only fast-forwards. Commits, remote selection, credentials and merge resolution stay with Git. A pull does not automatically apply a changed profile. No synchronization daemon or background network activity is started. Limits and recovery Boundary Current behavior Profile size At most 64 KiB Mappings per profile At most 128 Source and parent symlinks Rejected Traversal and overlapping destinations Rejected Ordinary apply failure New links and moved originals are rolled back Interrupted deployment Journal is retained for remove recovery The suite profile uses --state-dir to keep metadata and backups under ~/.local/state/zdot/oh-my-ztty. Direct zdot invocations without that option retain the target’s .zdot-state layout and .zdot.lock compatibility. zdot does not upload these files. Concurrent edits by unrelated programs are outside its transaction model. The native tool requires Linux 4.11 or later and a mounted /proc. Its Rust library and CLI use no_std, Project Z's zclap and direct system calls, without an allocator or libc. See zdot's usage reference and design and recovery details.

title: Performance
body: 组合终端、shell、应用配置与内存管理，提供 Linux 工作环境。 Performance These measurements come from earlier releases and the configurations named in each section. They describe the costs observed in those runs; the current suite needs its own measurements. Shell initialization, first completion and terminal memory are separate experiments. Each result includes its method and source record so you can inspect the scope or repeat the run. Framework startup The zshard 0.1.2 experiment used an Intel Core i9-12900HX, Arch Linux and zsh 5.9.2. Each case has 31 interleaved launches after three warmups. The times include process creation and initialization; prompt rendering is excluded for every case. Configuration Median, ms p95, ms Idle PSS, KiB Plain zsh 1.679 2.005 767 zsh with audited completion 12.291 15.236 2,308 zshard, completion deferred 4.106 5.114 1,161 zshard, completion ready 19.185 24.213 2,500 Oh My Zsh, git + robbyrussell 28.403 33.335 2,824 In this experiment, the Oh My Zsh initialization time was 6.92 times the deferred zshard time, or 1.48 times its completion-ready time. The feature sets differ. The Oh My Zsh case uses its git plugin and robbyrussell theme without extra suggestion or highlighting plugins; it is pinned at commit c0140703a53eb0d22be44f7bac318d0baacc927c. These results do not establish a ranking of every shell or plugin combination. Framework method · Individual samples First completion The first Tab took a median of 15.848 ms with a warm completion dump. Creating a fresh dump took 147.310 ms. Deferring completion moves the work to when it is needed; it does not remove the work. The per-user installer prepares the audited dump before activating a release. zshard 0.1.2 validates current completion files and native audit exclusions, including ownership changes and same-count file replacement. It retains native compinit -i auditing. That validation cost is included in the measurements. Cache design and compatibility Complete suite startup The suite 0.1.1 record includes a 40-sample interleaved experiment of the full omztty shell -i -c exit path with the Ink preset: Configuration Median, ms p95, ms Complete preset shell 10.914 13.057 Minimum-feature vanilla zsh 2.700 3.893 This includes the launcher and preset initialization. It excludes the prompt, first Tab, model calls and network activity. Do not combine this run with the independent framework experiment as though their times came from one controlled comparison. Live terminal memory The same historical suite check opened one actual 100 × 28 cell window on an isolated Xvfb display, with a temporary HOME and Git checkout. It used the preset's 24 px padding and 13 pt font request. Fontconfig resolved JetBrainsMono Nerd Font in that environment. No AI connection was active. Application memory excludes the X server and includes the resident ztty broker. Process Before Tab, PSS KiB After Tab, PSS KiB ztty broker and renderer 10,425 10,425 Preset zsh 2,718 3,746 Waiting launcher/client 850 850 Total 13,993 (13.67 MiB) 15,021 (14.67 MiB) PSS divides shared pages among the processes mapping them, reducing double counting in the total. These are samples at the stated idle points, not peak allocation or active AI-session figures. Font choices, plugins and other running applications can affect the result. The measured integration archive is identified in the raw suite record. Formal GitHub release archives were built separately and have their own checksums. A real first Tab left the installer-prepared completion dump's hash and modification time unchanged. See the cache-reuse evidence. Native dotfile manager The published zdot 0.1.1 executable is 53,848 bytes on x86_64 and 66,168 bytes on ARM64. Both are static ELF files without libc or a dynamic interpreter. zdot has no resident synchronization service. Explicit Git synchronization starts Git, whose resources are outside the native tool's own measurements. The component's separate timing and memory experiment used a 53,776-byte local build. Its timings are not attributed to the exact published binary. zdot method and evidence Reproduce a result From a recursive source checkout: python3 components/zshard/scripts/benchmark.py --samples 31 --output /tmp/zshard-benchmark.json make -C components/zdot benchmark The full-suite graphical check takes an archive and its checksum sidecar: python3 scripts/verify_graphical.py dist/oh-my-ztty-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz \ --output /tmp/oh-my-ztty-evidence --samples 40 It requires Xvfb, xdotool, ImageMagick, zsh and the terminal's libraries. It creates an isolated home, display and broker socket, then cleans up the processes it owns. A separate Xvfb/software-OpenGL terminal diagnostic is retained in the full performance record. It uses one launch per terminal and different padding units, so it is not a native GPU desktop ranking.

title: Architecture
body: 组合终端、shell、应用配置与内存管理，提供 Linux 工作环境。 Architecture The suite packages seven independently maintained tools around system zsh. This page explains which process does each job, where configuration lives and how a release records the versions it uses. Process boundaries Component Responsibility When it runs ztty Terminal rendering, windows and PTY While its broker is running System zsh Parse and execute commands While the shell is open zshard Prompt, completion, editing and plugin loading Inside the existing zsh process zrc Native editor and terminal-tool profiles Read by the corresponding application zdot Dotfile planning, links and explicit Git sync For a requested command zfetch Native system overview Only for omztty info or omztty zfetch ssmcp Authenticated MCP workspace connection After an explicit connection command zmem Memory pressure policy, managed background scopes and Swap lifecycle As the system service enabled by default during installation The ztty broker supports detached sessions that can outlive a window. Opening omztty shell alone does not start that broker or an AI process. Shell startup does not download plugins, run zfetch, call a provider or connect to MCP. Optional work is requested through commands or declared plugin loading modes. Native code The zdot library and Linux executable use Rust no_std. Their Project Z zclap dependency is configured without its default standard-library feature. The executable uses direct system calls with no allocator, libc or dynamic ELF interpreter. zshard is written in zsh and adds no compiled helper. The pinned ztty core and executable also use Rust no_std; the graphical front end still depends on the listed graphics libraries. The bundled ssmcp retains its existing Rust standard-library and networking dependencies. These boundaries describe separate programs. They do not make the whole bundle free of all standard libraries or system libraries. zrc supplies Lua for Neovim 0.11+ and each application's native configuration files. Applications load those files directly; no separate configuration process runs. zfetch is a native Rust no_std utility without crate dependencies and runs only when requested. Development scripts and build tools are outside the installed native dependency graph. Installing a release and using its configuration commands require neither Rust nor Python. Source and artifact pins The component gitlinks record exact source commits for ztty, zshard, zrc, zdot, zfetch, ssmcp and zmem. The .gitmodules file records their repository locations. dependencies.lock.json records the canonical repository, default branch, exact commit and observation time for every component. Source gitlinks and this source lock must agree before building the bundle. A release includes a build record and MANIFEST.sha256. The installer checks both the downloaded archive and its contents before activation. Versioned archives and their checksums are listed on the release page. zmem has a zero-dependency Rust no_std policy library and a Linux adapter using the standard library and system tools. Its state and policy are exposed as JSON for AI clients. Installation state The per-user installer keeps releases below the user's XDG data directory and selects one with a current link. The AUR package owns /usr/lib/oh-my-ztty and exposes /usr/bin/omztty; its runtime is updated and removed through the package manager. In both layouts, the launcher addresses bundled executables explicitly, even when another tool with the same name exists elsewhere. The launcher supplies a separate ZDOTDIR for trying the shell, a suite history path and a cache path tied to the release directory. Adopting omztty config creates an editable profile and deploys it through zdot; the managed default .zshrc reads the same suite entry point. Personal options.zsh, local.zsh and completion files live under ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/oh-my-ztty. Personal completions use its completions/ directory, outside the runtime. HOME adoption requires an absolute XDG_CONFIG_HOME within HOME. Its journal and backups live under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/zdot/oh-my-ztty. For a per-user installation, uninstallation restores the adopted profile first. A restoration failure or inconsistent deployment record preserves the runtime for recovery. For the AUR package, restore the profile with omztty config remove before removing the package. Independent omztty dot deployments remain separate. See configuration. Before activation, the per-user installer prepares the audited completion cache. Native zsh auditing and input validation remain part of reuse; it is not a bypass of completion security checks. The default installer also enables the independent zmem system service. It copies the executable to /usr/local/bin/zmem, preserves existing /etc/zmem/zmem.conf policy, and records a recovery path for earlier managers. --no-memory-manager skips this setup. Removing the user suite keeps the system service installed; sudo /usr/local/bin/zmem rollback remains available. Extension boundaries Shell plugins use ordinary zsh files, hooks, standard completion functions and prompt callbacks. A pinned plugin installation and its explicit integrity verification are separate from loading it into a shell. AI providers receive a bounded, explicit context through the provider contract. Proposed commands enter the editing buffer for review. zrc profiles share the Ink palette through native application files. Neovim supports native packages and explicit local extensions; application and language-server installation remain separate. Dotfile profiles describe repository-relative sources and target-relative destinations. zdot computes the plan before applying it and records ownership for recovery and removal. Terminal and MCP extensions remain the responsibility of their upstream Project Z projects. The suite pins those implementations and links to their documentation rather than defining a second incompatible interface. Versioned combinations The suite and its components have independent semantic versions. A suite release is a validated combination, identified by its commit and seven gitlinks. Publish a component change first, then advance the suite pin and validate the assembled result. Normal shell startup uses the installed versions. Development and release workflow

title: Development
body: 组合终端、shell、应用配置与内存管理，提供 Linux 工作环境。 Development Use this workspace to change a component, validate its integration and prepare a suite release. Development follows each component's latest default branch. The suite records the observed revisions and builds that exact source combination. Clone the workspace git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/oh-my-ztty.git cd oh-my-ztty python3 scripts/workspace.py status Development uses Git, Python 3, make, zsh and the Rust toolchain required by the component you change. Installation from a release does not need Rust or Python. Use a machine-readable view when integrating with another tool: python3 scripts/workspace.py status --json Status reads local repository state and makes no network request. Validate a change python3 scripts/workspace.py check This runs the zshard, zdot, zrc, zfetch and zmem checks, then the suite's installer and integration tests. Use --component suite for the suite checks alone. Full ztty and ssmcp test suites remain in their own repositories; the bundle build compiles their programs and subsequent smoke tests exercise the integration. Run the relevant checks locally after a change. Manual validation workflows are available. Routine code pushes and pull requests do not start a duplicate daily test matrix. Keep benchmark runs separate from correctness checks, and record the source, binary, machine, configuration and workload behind each number. Work in a submodule A freshly cloned submodule starts at a detached commit. Create a branch before editing: git -C components/zshard switch -c improve-completion make -C components/zshard check Commit component changes and merge them into the repository's default branch before synchronizing the suite. Review the parent gitlink together with its source-lock record. Synchronize default branches Synchronize the current default-branch heads of all seven components: python3 scripts/workspace.py sync python3 scripts/workspace.py check Sync resolves the live default branch of each canonical GitHub repository, fetches its observed head, checks out that source and updates nested submodules recursively. dependencies.lock.json schema 2 records the repository URL, branch, exact commit and observation time; its top-level timestamp records the completed synchronization. Commit the changed gitlinks and source lock together after validation. The first migration from the old release-asset lock requires a full sync. Once schema 2 is present, an optional component limits the update: python3 scripts/workspace.py sync zshard Every synchronization observes the current remote head again. The saved commit identifies the input selected for a build. Component publication and suite publication remain separate, explicit steps. Local state and recovery Sync requires clean selected source checkouts, including initialized nested repositories, and a committed dependency lock. It refuses a nonempty uninitialized submodule directory and preserves its contents. Ignored paths in an initialized nested repository are also refused. These paths may be ordinary build caches; the restriction exists because Git's recursive checkout can overwrite ignored files. The error names the repository and paths to move aside. An ignored cache at the component's top level can remain if it does not collide with the new revision. The source lock is replaced after all selected checkouts succeed. If an update fails, sync attempts to restore the changed component and nested commits, their checkout branches, and saved submodule URL configuration. It leaves the lock unchanged and preserves concurrent lock edits. Newly initialized directories can remain and are listed for inspection. A failed recovery is reported alongside the original failure. For example, a source edit made while sync is running can prevent Git from restoring an old checkout. Inspect the reported paths before retrying. Build the source-locked bundle python3 scripts/build_bundle.py python3 scripts/smoke_bundle.py "dist/oh-my-ztty-$(cat VERSION)-linux-$(uname -m).tar.gz" The build requires all seven checkouts to be clean and match schema 2's recorded commits. It compiles ztty, ssmcp, zdot, zfetch and zmem with Cargo's --locked --release options. The ztty build enables Wayland, and ssmcp's JavaScript helper is copied from its matching source checkout. BUILD.json records the component commits, branch names and source-lock synchronization time. Cargo discovers executable paths through its build output and respects the user's configured target directory, including shared output caches. Native builds use normal release outputs. A different --arch selects a cross target and requires its Rust standard library, linker and system development libraries. The resulting executable architecture is checked before packaging. See the release workflow for the native development libraries. Builds consume the source lock without refreshing component branches; use workspace.py sync to select newer sources. Source and lock consistency are checked again before the archive is written. Bump and release Prepare the suite's next version with: python3 scripts/bump.py patch This updates version files for review. In the suite it also synchronizes the current release version and installation examples in the documentation. Historical performance results and release evidence keep their original version links. Use minor or major when appropriate. From a clean, validated main branch, the release form checks, commits, tags and pushes: python3 scripts/bump.py patch --release Synchronize component sources, validate the assembled bundle, then bump oh-my-ztty when preparing publication. The suite's release-tag workflow builds and validates Linux x86_64 and ARM64 on native runners. Historical releases retain their original source and evidence; the 0.2.6 report describes that shipped version. Release evidence A release record should identify the source lock, seven gitlinks, archive checksums, local check results and a full installation lifecycle. Store text measurements and artifact links in Git; keep generated screenshots and release archives in the artifact destination. Use --no-memory-manager when testing in an isolated home so bundle tests leave the host services alone. Validate system adoption separately through zmem. Install twice in that home, exercise the actual shell and bundled programs, then uninstall. Include pre-existing files so preservation checks test real data. Keep startup, first completion, live memory and active AI sessions as distinct measurement scopes. The 0.1.1 report shows the evidence format. The formal workflow and public download audit verify the published result. Edit this documentation Pages are Markdown files in site/content/. Navigation is declared in site/nav.json. The build produces static HTML for GitHub Pages. Create the isolated build environment and render the site: python3 -m venv .cache/docs-venv .cache/docs-venv/bin/python -m pip install --require-hashes -r site/requirements.txt .cache/docs-venv/bin/python scripts/build_site.py Preview the generated pages locally: python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory _site Check desktop and narrow layouts, keyboard navigation, search, copy controls and links before publishing a site change. The Pages workflow handles website deployment independently of binary releases. See the site authoring guide and repository contribution guide.

title: 概览
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 OniMods English 缺氧（Oxygen Not Included）Mod 工程仓库。开发、测试、发布就这三步：onim dev、onim build、onim publish。项目地址：OniMods。 onim：本仓库内置的缺氧 Mod 开发 CLI，用于初始化、构建、安装、卸载和发布 Mod。 OniMcp：让 AI 助手通过 MCP 读取并操作缺氧殖民地。 CycleTrim：高风险实验性性能模组。启动即用 Rust 仿真内核 OniSim 接管官方 SimDLL；热扩散和符合条件的气体/液体区域已在时间步内走 Vulkan（wgpu）GPU 算子，并实验一格多物。先加速，再兼容。 OniOnline：联机框架。安装后默认是大厅和聊天，其他玩法由单独模组注册。 Jlib：OniMcp 和 CycleTrim 共用的 PLib 兼容前置库（创意工坊 3835083839）。游戏里要单独启用，并排在依赖它的模组前面。 OniModTemplate：用 onim init 开新模组时的目录模板。 OniHarness：缺氧 Mod 测试工具（子模块），支持任意形状物理地图、建筑模拟、Mod 安装测试与无窗口实机启动。 兼容性警告：OniMcp 在 1.0.0 之前 API 仍可能发生不兼容变更。二创、插件、脚本或第三方客户端请锁定具体版本，并以运行时 tools_manifest / oni://tools/manifest 为准做兼容适配。 开源激励计划：可购买 token，也可以通过参与开源项目贡献赚取 token。服务地址：api.lmm.best；项目源码由 TokenNotIncluded 组织托管，欢迎使用与贡献。 效果展示 测试来源：以下截图取自其他人测试 OniMcp 的视频，并非本项目作者本人测试。 我把《缺氧》交给 GPT，这三个小人能活下来吗？-哔哩哔哩 让 GPT 通过 OniMcp 操作缺氧殖民地，看看它如何建造、种植，以及过程中遇到的问题。以下截图均取自视频，展示这次实验的实际过程。 视频 03:05：GPT 操作后的殖民地全景 读取状态、下达操作 · 00:18 建造与挖掘过程 · 02:10 视频中的 OniMcp 读取状态与下达操作示意 视频中的殖民地建造与挖掘任务 快速入口 项目 路径 说明 onim src/ Rust 编写的 Mod 开发工具链 OniMcp mods/OniMcp/ ONI MCP Server Mod CycleTrim mods/CycleTrim/ 高风险实验。Rust 仿真内核 + GPU 热扩散/气液区域算子 + 一格多物，先加速再兼容；进度见 OniSim/gpu OniOnline mods/OniOnline/ 联机框架，内置大厅和聊天；其他玩法由单独模组提供 Jlib mods/Jlib/ 可独立安装的 PLib 兼容共享前置库 OniModTemplate mods/OniModTemplate/ onim init 使用的新模组目录模板 OniHarness tools/OniHarness/ · 说明 Mod 测试、物理地图与建筑模拟、无窗口实机启动 oni-skills (可选) oni-skills/ · GitHub 缺氧高阶游戏攻略与工程模块库（社区共建、开放完善） 架构与核心原理 docs/architecture-and-principles.md OniMcp 与 CycleTrim 的底层实现机制、世界文本化与性能优化设计 OniMcp 中文文档 mods/OniMcp/README.md 安装、连接和功能说明 OniMcp English docs mods/OniMcp/README_EN.md English installation and usage guide 项目缘起与开源激励 写给所有对这个项目感兴趣的人 了解 OniMods 的项目缘起与开源激励计划 ONI MCP Server ONI MCP Server 文档 支持 OniMcp 的开发与测试：捐赠。 OniMcp 捐赠进度 捐款，加速一切。 OniMcp 是为缺氧量身定制的 MCP 服务器 Mod。安装后，支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端可以通过本地 HTTP 接口读取殖民地状态、分析局势，并在授权后执行游戏操作。 目前公开工具面是一组会出现在 tools/list 中的聚合入口： world_editor：代码文件风格的世界编辑器。将存档视为虚拟目录，客户端通过读取文件观察状态，并通过 edit 配合 SEARCH/REPLACE 块来下达修改意图（如挖掘、建造、连接管线和设置优先级）。 game_control：游戏状态、速度、存档、UI 与游戏级操作。 navigation_control：相机、视图、覆盖层和截图操作。 building_control：建筑规划、放置、配置、生产与管线连接。 orders_control：挖掘、清扫、拖地、拆除等任务标记。 server_control：MCP 服务状态、会话清单、截图任务和后台任务管理。 原有的 colony_control、dupes_control、read_control、search_control 和 coordinate_control 已降级为虚拟文件工作流的内部操作，不再注册为 MCP 工具，也不支持客户端按名称直接调用。 它目前更适合作为“半自动操作助手”。复杂世界规划、长期自治游玩和高质量决策仍然需要人工监督。 相关 AI Skill 实现参考：zhuiyun.skill 当前交互约定：游戏操作优先使用语义搜索和虚拟文件编辑。每次工具调用都要提供简短任务说明，该说明会自动显示在玩家鼠标附近。 省流结论：不要指望当前 AI 能长期自主玩好缺氧这类复杂模拟游戏。现阶段更现实的方向是让 AI 读取更多游戏数据、执行明确的小任务，并在玩家确认下辅助完成局部规划。 onim onim 是缺氧 Mod 开发工具链，覆盖从项目初始化到 Steam 创意工坊发布的常用流程。 一句话开始 cargo install --path . onim setup onim doctor onim init MyMod onim dev -m MyMod onim dev 只在 mods.json 配置实际变化时备份，最多保留最近 5 份有效配置备份。 每次构建必须生成新的 dist/<AssemblyName>.zip；编译成功但没有新包也会失败并恢复旧包。 安装先解压、检查 DLL 和 mod_info.yaml，再替换目录；解压或 Dev 启用失败会保留原安装。 它只启用选定的 Dev 条目，不会顺带启用同一 Mod 的其他副本。 同一 staticID 在 Local、Dev、创意工坊之间只保留一份启用安装；核实的重复副本移到 mods/.onim-recovery， Jlib 等前置会自动排在消费模组之前。 配置已写入但备份清理失败时，会单独警告，不把安装误报为失败。 常用工作流 # 1. 安装 onim CLI cargo install --path . # 2. 交互式初始化：检测游戏路径、检查依赖、写入配置 onim setup # 3. 只读检查本机开发环境 onim doctor # 4. 创建新 Mod onim init MyMod --author YourName --desc "Mod 描述" # 5. 开发迭代 onim dev -m MyMod # 构建并安装到游戏 Dev 目录 onim build -m MyMod # 仅构建 onim info # 查看已安装的 Mod # 6. 正式发布 onim install -m MyMod # Release 构建并安装到 Local 目录 onim publish -m MyMod --dry-run # 只构建并生成发布计划，不上传 onim publish -m MyMod # 单文件 Legacy ZIP 原生上传到 Steam 创意工坊 # 7. 清理 onim uninstall -m MyMod # 从游戏目录卸载 -m <name> 用于指定 Mod。不指定时，onim 使用 onim.toml 中的 default_mod。 首次构建前需要生成本机 MSBuild 配置： cp Directory.Build.props.example Directory.Build.props # 然后把 Directory.Build.props 里的 OniGamePath 改为本机缺氧安装目录 也可以运行 onim setup 自动检测并写入配置。 命令速查 命令 作用 onim setup 初始化项目配置，检测游戏路径和依赖 onim doctor 只读检查路径、外部工具和已配置 Mod 源码 onim init <name> 从模板创建新 Mod onim build 构建 Mod，--release 为 Release 构建 onim dev 构建并安装到游戏 mods/Dev/ onim install Release 构建并安装到 mods/Local/；--release OWNER/REPO / --repo OWNER/REPO 从 GitHub 安装 onim uninstall 卸载 Mod，支持 --scope dev/local/all onim info 查看已安装的 Dev、Local 和 Steam Mod onim publish 默认用原生单文件 Legacy ZIP 发布器上传；支持 --dry-run、--preflight、--create、--resume、--update-preview、--gui onim workshop search / install / uninstall 创意工坊条目；page show/set 修改自有条目页面（不上传 ZIP） onim list 列出配置文件中的 Mod 创意工坊硬性禁止：不要用 SteamCMD workshop_build_item 或 SteamUGC.SetItemContent 目录模式上传，转换不可逆且会让缺氧无法安装该条目。详见 Steam 发布说明。 目录结构 . ├── onim.toml # onim 配置文件，记录默认 Mod 和 Mod 列表 ├── Directory.Build.props.example # 本机 MSBuild 配置模板 ├── Directory.Build.props # 本机生成配置，不提交 ├── Cargo.toml # onim CLI ├── src/ # onim 源码 ├── mods/ # Mod 项目目录 │ ├── OniModTemplate/ # Mod 模板（ModInfo + Patches/） │ ├── OniMcp/ # ONI MCP Server │ │ ├── ModInfo.cs # 仅入口 │ │ ├── Patches/ UI/ Config/ Core/ Server/ Support/ │ │ └── Tools/{Core,Entry,WorldEditor,Shared,Impl}/ │ ├── CycleTrim/ # 高风险实验性性能模组，方向是把运算搬到 GPU │ │ ├── ModInfo.cs # 仅入口 │ │ ├── Core/ # 非补丁核心逻辑 │ │ ├── Patches/ # Harmony 补丁 │ │ └── OniSim/ # Rust 仿真内核、wgpu/WGSL GPU 算子、Lean 证明 │ ├── OniOnline/ # 联机框架，默认大厅和聊天 │ └── Jlib/ # 共享前置库（子模块） ├── sdk/ # OniOnline.Framework SDK、Jlib.Bootstrap ├── examples/ # OniOnline 第三方玩法示例 ├── tools/ # OniHarness（子模块）、Legacy ZIP Steam 发布器 ├── tests/ benchmarks/ # 宿主回归测试与消融基准 ├── oni-skills/ # 可选：缺氧高阶攻略与工程模块库 ├── docs/ # 参考文档 └── scripts/ # 辅助、校验与 Legacy ZIP 发布脚本 依赖 代码回归检查：安装 Python 3 与 .NET SDK 10 后运行 python3 scripts/check_mods.py。该入口不需要安装游戏；完整构建与游戏内验证步骤见 Mod 测试说明。 Rust：编译 onim .NET SDK：构建 Mod unzip：安装构建产物时解压 tar：打包源码 onim setup 会自动检查依赖并提示安装方式。 许可证 本仓库中 LIghtJUNction 有权授权的原创材料采用 Agent Upstream License（AUL）1.0-draft.1。旧版 MIT 授权仍有效，原文见 LICENSE.MIT。第三方材料及来自其他贡献者的改动保持各自授权，具体见 LICENSING.md。AUL 是自定义草案，不是 OSI 已批准的开源许可证。Agent title: See it working
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 This project is developed by AI through a fully automated, end-to-end closed-loop workflow. Typing code by hand is human abuse! Protect humans! OniMods License Stars Issues Last commit 简体中文 · onim CLI · OniMcp docs · Architecture See it working Test attribution: The screenshots below are from a video of someone else's OniMcp test, not a test by the project author. GPT operating an Oxygen Not Included colony through OniMcp The linked gameplay demo shows an MCP client reading colony state and issuing bounded operations for construction and farming. It is a real integration run, including the failures encountered along the way—not a scripted product animation. Read state and plan · 00:18 Construction in progress · 02:10 OniMcp state and operation workflow Colony construction and dig orders What ships here Component What it does Start here onim Creates, builds, installs, inspects and publishes ONI mods CLI guide OniMcp Exposes colony state and bounded game operations to MCP clients English · 中文 · Rust CLI CycleTrim High-risk experiment. A Rust SimDLL (OniSim) takes over after exact runtime checks; thermal diffusion and eligible gas/liquid regions use Vulkan (wgpu) GPU passes. The Linux U60 development checkpoint has limited mixture save/load evidence; mixed saves require the new format reader. This iteration is not yet on Workshop, and whole-game speedup remains unverified Compatibility and save format · GPU status OniOnline Multiplayer framework with lobby chat; other gameplay ships as separate mods Module docs Jlib A standalone shared PLib-compatible prerequisite library (Workshop 3835083839) Source and install notes OniModTemplate A reusable starting point for a new ONI mod Template OniHarness Headless/real-game test harness: arbitrary-geometry physics maps, building simulation, mod install tests Notes · Submodule oni-skills (optional) Colony engineering notes for SPOM, cooling, ranching and power Guides · GitHub The repository is intentionally split into two layers: onim provides the repeatable development workflow; mods/ contains independently scoped game modules. Every mod here is developed, tested, and published with onim: onim dev, onim build, onim publish. Project: OniMods. Quick start Requirements: Rust, a .NET SDK, a local Oxygen Not Included installation, and the normal packaging tools (unzip and tar). cargo install --path . onim setup onim doctor onim init MyMod --author YourName --desc "Your mod description" onim dev -m MyMod onim setup discovers the game path and can generate local build configuration. If you configure it manually: cp Directory.Build.props.example Directory.Build.props # Set OniGamePath in Directory.Build.props The normal lifecycle is deliberately small: init → dev → inspect → install → publish Command Result onim init <name> Scaffold a mod from the maintained template onim dev -m <name> Build and install into the game's mods/Dev directory onim info Inspect installed Dev, Local and Steam modules onim install -m <name> Produce and install a release build (--release OWNER/REPO / --repo OWNER/REPO install from GitHub) onim publish -m <name> Upload a single-file Legacy ZIP through the native publisher (--dry-run, --preflight, --create, --resume, --update-preview, --gui) onim workshop … Search, install and uninstall Workshop items; workshop page show/set edits an owned page without uploading a ZIP onim uninstall -m <name> Remove a selected Dev/Local installation onim dev only rewrites mods.json when configuration actually changes, retains the latest five valid backups, and reports cleanup failures separately. Installation validates the new archive, DLL and metadata before replacing the previous copy. Only one installation per staticID stays active across Local, Dev and Workshop; verified duplicates move to mods/.onim-recovery, and prerequisites such as Jlib are ordered before their consumers. Workshop safety: never publish with SteamCMD workshop_build_item or SteamUGC.SetItemContent. Directory-mode uploads irreversibly break ONI items. See Steam publishing. OniMcp: the operational boundary OniMcp is an MCP-native operations layer, not an unrestricted automation backdoor. Its public surface is grouped by intent: world_editor — virtual-file SEARCH/REPLACE workflows for save-like artifacts; game_control — pause, speed, save and load orchestration; navigation_control — camera, overlays and screenshots; building_control — building and utility operations; orders_control — dig, sweep, clean and deconstruct orders; server_control — manifests, diagnostics, sessions and screenshot lifecycle. Critical operations remain bounded and should be preceded by read-only inspection and explicit task framing. The project does not claim that autonomous play replaces human oversight. Pre-1.0 compatibility: OniMcp may still introduce breaking API changes. Pin exact versions for clients and plugins, then verify the live surface through oni://tools/manifest rather than assuming a README is the runtime contract. Repository map . ├── src/ onim Rust CLI (+ oni-mcp client binary) ├── mods/ │ ├── OniMcp/ MCP server mod │ ├── CycleTrim/ GPU-first performance experiment │ │ └── OniSim/ Rust SimDLL, wgpu/WGSL operators, Lean proofs │ ├── OniOnline/ multiplayer framework, lobby and chat │ ├── Jlib/ shared PLib-compatible library (submodule) │ └── OniModTemplate/ reusable mod scaffold ├── sdk/ OniOnline.Framework SDK, Jlib.Bootstrap ├── examples/ sample OniOnline gameplay mod ├── tools/ OniHarness (submodule), Legacy ZIP Steam publisher ├── tests/ · benchmarks/ host regressions and ablation benchmarks ├── oni-skills/ optional colony engineering guides ├── docs/ architecture, testing and publishing notes ├── scripts/ verification and Legacy ZIP publishing helpers ├── Cargo.toml onim package definition └── onim.toml workspace aliases and defaults Verification and contribution Before opening a pull request: Shipped mods depend on the standalone Jlib mod (Steam Workshop). The source checkout uses the mods/Jlib submodule; in game, enable Jlib and keep it above its consumers. onim doctor python3 scripts/check_mods.py The regression suite requires Python 3 and .NET SDK 10. Checks that need a locally installed game are documented separately in Mod testing. Keep changes focused, update the affected changelog, and open an issue first when a proposal changes module boundaries or public MCP behavior. Releases and further reading OniMcp changelog CycleTrim changelog · OniSim progress onim changelog OniOnline Jlib Template changelog Steam publishing workflow Architecture and principles Open-source letter OniMcp development and agent testing consume model API credits. Project donations support that work. An OpenAI-compatible endpoint is optional; OniMods does not require a specific provider. License Original material that LIghtJUNction has the right to license is offered under Agent Upstream License 1.0-draft.1. This custom draft is not an OSI-approved license. Historical MIT releases retain their original permissions in LICENSE.MIT. Third-party and adapted upstream material keeps its own terms; see LICENSING.md. Agent contributors must also read AGENTS.md and UPSTREAM.toml. Pull requests Low-quality human-written PRs will not be accepted. This includes, but is not limited to: Commits written entirely by humans. Code that is insufficiently defensive, fails to consider enough scenarios, or is excessively terse, showing obvious signs of human laziness. Any form of code typed entirely by hand.

title: oni-mcp CLI
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 oni-mcp CLI oni-mcp is a standalone Rust client for the Streamable HTTP endpoint exposed by mods/OniMcp. It complements the existing onim mod-development workflow and does not require a running Rust daemon. Install Download the platform archive from GitHub Releases, extract the binary, and add it to PATH. The CLI uses the system curl executable for HTTP(S), so curl must be installed. Configure oni-mcp set-url http://localhost:8788/mcp/ printf '%s' "$ONIM_MCP_SECRET" | oni-mcp set-secret - oni-mcp status The default endpoint is http://localhost:8788/mcp/. Configuration is stored at ~/.config/onim/mcp.toml (Unix mode 0600). ONIM_MCP_SECRET overrides the stored secret. The secret is never printed by oni-mcp config. For remote access, use HTTPS or a trusted VPN/tunnel. Bearer tokens sent over plain HTTP are not encrypted. The server remains responsible for authentication and authorization. Commands Command Purpose oni-mcp config Show endpoint and whether a secret is configured oni-mcp set-url Set MCP endpoint oni-mcp set-secret Store MCP secret oni-mcp clear-secret Remove stored secret oni-mcp status Initialize and ping the server oni-mcp tools List live MCP tools oni-mcp call '' Call a tool oni-mcp read Read an MCP resource Example: oni-mcp tools oni-mcp call game_control '{"domain":"speed","action":"time","task":"Check whether the game is paused"}' oni-mcp read oni://tools/manifest Each invocation creates an MCP session using protocol 2025-11-25, performs one operation, closes the session, and exits. Session IDs are not persisted. Use the live tool manifest because tool schemas evolve with the mod. The server requires a task description on tool calls. Tool responses with isError: true produce a nonzero exit status. Releases Tags named oni-mcp-v* trigger multi-platform builds for Linux x86_64/aarch64, Windows x86_64, and macOS x86_64/aarch64. Each archive includes the executable and SHA-256 checksums are published with the release.

title: ONI MCP 工具参考
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 ONI MCP 工具参考 本文档描述 OniMcp 当前推荐的工具面。运行时清单永远以 server_control domain=catalog action=manifest 和 oni://tools/manifest 为准。 快速开始 MCP 地址: http://localhost:8788/mcp/ 支持协议: 2025-11-25，使用 initialize 和服务端签发的 Mcp-Session-Id Public tools: 7 entrypoints: benchmark, world_editor, game_control, navigation_control, building_control, orders_control, server_control 旧聚合入口: 仅作为虚拟文件工作流的内部操作，不再注册为 MCP 工具 coordinate_control 不属于当前公开运行时；普通聚合工具拒绝 raw coordinates Tool descriptions: default-public tool descriptions and parameter descriptions are in English 客户端先以 2025-11-25 调用 initialize，读取响应中的 Mcp-Session-Id。后续会话请求携带该 ID 和 Mcp-Protocol-Version: 2025-11-25，再调用 tools/list 获取当前工具清单。 2026-07-28 无会话路径、server/discover 以及 2025-06-18 已退出支持范围。历史资料见 协议回归与历史来源。 定位与执行原则 Authoritative model: Saves are directories. latest/ is the fixed alias for the current/latest save. cd latest enters a save; cd or cd ~ exits back to /, representing the main menu/root. Save contents are structured world files such as map/terrain.oni, buildings/plans.oni, infrastructure/power.oni, and views/power.png. There are no action patch files. World changes use world_editor command=edit; prefer one SEARCH/REPLACE block. Multiple blocks require outer allowPartial=true and cannot be transactionally rolled back. Reading the same file again is the observation step after an edit. Example edit: `<<<<<<< SEARCH` # observed or empty planning text `=======` 用铜矿连接电池到制氧机 `>>>>>>> REPLACE` world_editor is the default world interaction tool. It treats the loaded save as a virtual folder and exposes map views as files: world_editor command=ls path=/ world_editor command=read path=/world/map/text.txt world_editor command=read path=/world/views/power.png world_editor command=search domain=buildings query="wire" world_editor command=plan plan="用铜矿连接电池到制氧机" world_editor command=connect plan="connect battery to oxygen diffuser" Search, planning, actions, building, orders, navigation, game actions, dupe actions, and coordinate fallback are routed through world_editor. The default public surface also keeps benchmark, game_control, navigation_control, building_control, orders_control, and server_control available for direct focused calls. Other former aggregate entrypoints are internal-only virtual-file operations and are not callable as MCP tools. 新工具面按搜索/动作优先设计: 优先使用 query、target、search、name、id、areaId。 For dedicated search, use world_editor command=search or the typed /active/ops/search.md workflow. The underlying search_control operation is internal and is not a direct MCP tool. Public aggregate tools do not accept raw x/y, x1/y1/x2/y2, dx/dy, points, or anchors. For exact orders, read /active/ops/tools.md and edit /active/ops/orders.md; use only currently public typed files/tools and ignore hidden coordinate_control and /active/ops/coordinate.md compatibility entries. 面向任务的返回应尽量包含 reachable、executable、失败原因、缺失条件和建议下一步。 需要定义区域并取得 areaId 时，通过 world_editor 的 typed /active/ops/read.md 工作流完成；底层 read_control 是 internal operation，不应作为 MCP 工具直接调用。 写入、执行和危险动作应支持 dryRun 或 confirm，并在执行后重新读取状态验证。 危险或大范围精确操作必须保持 pause -> read/plan -> dry-run -> confirm -> verify。 核心工具 工具 主要 domain/action 风险 用途 benchmark cases, iterations, tool, includeDetails read 固定工具链路基准与诊断，不修改游戏状态 world_editor cd, ls, read, search, edit, plan, connect read/write/execute 虚拟文件化世界访问、搜索、规划与受控编辑 server_control catalog, batch, program read/execute 健康检查、工具清单、工具搜索、目标指南、批量调用、agent program game_control launch, speed, state, save, dlc, ui read/execute/dangerous 原生新开局、暂停、恢复、调速、存档、DLC、UI 编辑标记 navigation_control camera 或按已知相机 action 推断 execute 相机移动、世界切换、覆盖层、聚焦和截图 building_control planning, config, storage, filter, production, side_surface, rocket read/write/execute 建造规划、材料检查、蓝图、建筑侧屏配置、储存过滤、生产队列、火箭 orders_control area, priority, designation, conduit execute/dangerous 挖掘、清扫、拖地、拆除、优先级、区域订单、线路/管线剪断 原生新开局 使用 game_control domain=launch action=new_game_status 读取当前菜单阶段与可选 choices。在主菜单调用 action=new_game，随后使用 action=new_game_select name=<choice id> 逐步选择；写操作先 dryRun=true 预览，再 confirm=true 执行。每次选择后重新读取状态，等待原生异步切换完成。 生存模式经典泰拉星路径为 survival → classic → generate_world → 等待 characters → embark。只能选择当前状态广告的选项；生成世界与开始殖民地要求生存模式且沙盒关闭。embark 使用原生生成的三名初始候选，进场后自动暂停；验证 baseAlreadyCreated=true、liveDuplicants=3、isPaused=true 与 pauseAfterStart=ready_paused 后再开始游玩。已有殖民地内不会直接新开局，须先保存并退出到主菜单。 当前入口提供上述原生流程，不提供候选属性编辑或自定义难度设置。 打开主菜单或暂停菜单中的加载列表：game_control domain=ui uiDomain=action action=open_load_menu。先 dryRun=true，再 confirm=true；这只打开原生列表，不选择或载入存档，游戏内打开时保持暂停。OniMcp 会忽略迁移时确认缺失的可选 PNG 预览图；存档本体及其他迁移错误仍由游戏原生检查。 active 是原生 KScreen.IsActive() 标志。有模组差异等子弹窗时，列表可见而该标志为 false；应检查当前弹窗，不要因此重复打开菜单。原生加载列表可能整理本地与云端的重叠存档，文件路径可以变化。 建造规划 building_control domain=planning 是新的建造入口。 action 用途 search_defs 搜索可建建筑定义 materials 查询建筑可用材料和库存 preview 预检一个蓝图锚点，返回可执行性和材料需求 placement_candidates 在区域或目标附近搜索可放置位置 build_area 放置蓝图，线性 utility 支持自动连接 auto_connect 兼容旧流程的显式连接入口，新流程通常不需要单独调用 材料返回 蓝图预检和放置结果应返回材料可行性。旧字段 materialSelection 仍保留兼容，新字段 materials 用于任务级判断: { "materials": { "requirementKnown": true, "requiredKg": 200.0, "selectedAvailableKg": 1240.0, "satisfied": true, "shortageKg": 0.0, "availableMaterials": [ { "tag": "SandStone", "availableKg": 1240.0 } ] } } 调用方应先检查结果及 materials.valid 和 reasonCode；valid=false 必须停止执行。insufficient_material 表示目标世界本地库存不足，invalid_material_requirement 表示配方缺失或无效（包括 NaN/Infinity），两者均返回 materials.satisfied=false。需求无效时 requiredKg=null 不代表可以执行。随后检查 materials.satisfied，为 false 时展示需求、可用材料和已知缺口；为 null 时材料可达性仍未证实。 线路和管路 build_area 对线性设施支持自动连接: Wire LogicWire GasConduit LiquidConduit SolidConduit For semantic building, prefer plan, blueprint, areaId, search results, or semantic calls in /active/ops/build.md. For exact placement, read /active/map/viewport.md (zoom or read symbols/glyphs.md when needed), then edit the map markdown by replacing target empty-cell tokens with 建筑名:优先级 and optional #材料字. The map route translates these tokens to underlying building_control build_area anchors; /active/ops/build.md does not accept raw coordinates. 示例: Prefer one SEARCH/REPLACE block. Multiple blocks require outer allowPartial=true and cannot be transactionally rolled back. Each operation-file replacement must contain exactly one executable command. Preview with outer world_editor edit dryRun=true and confirm=false (or omitted); execute with a new edit using outer dryRun=false, confirm=true, and non-conflicting command flags, then re-read the map or state. This directly creates a continuous line, with no separate follow-up connection step required. 文件夹式蓝图管理系统 (Folder-based Blueprints) world_editor command=blueprint 提供了完备的蓝图全生命周期管理，深度集成 Blueprints Expanded v2 格式与原生自动建造回退机制： action 说明 示例参数 list / ls 列出分类文件夹与蓝图文件（支持树状和 JSON 格式） category: "power", format: "json" preview 预览蓝图（尺寸、建筑清单、材料用量、网格字符图） name: "power/spom" create / capture 从纯文本创建或直接框选地图矩形捕获现存建筑与管路 name: "spom", category: "power", x1: 10, y1: 20, x2: 25, y2: 30 import 从 JSON、Markdown 或 Base64 分享码导入蓝图 name: "spom", content: "<json/base64>" export 导出蓝图为 JSON、Markdown 或 Base64 字符串 name: "power/spom", format: "json" share 将单个蓝图或整个分类打包为分享代码 name: "power/spom" 或 category: "power" rename 重命名或跨目录移动蓝图 from: "test", to: "power/spom" categorize 将蓝图移动到分类文件夹 name: "spom", category: "power" replace_materials 批量替换蓝图内的建筑材料 name: "power/spom", from: "Sandstone", to: "Granite" place / use 放置蓝图（支持 dryRun 预览、材料动态重定向与原生回退） name: "power/spom", x: 15, y: 30, dryRun: false, confirm: true cancel 取消指定区域或指定蓝图范围内的待建工单 name: "power/spom", x: 15, y: 30 或 x1: 15, y1: 30, x2: 25, y2: 40 delete 删除指定蓝图文件或空目录 name: "power/spom" 视觉反馈：Agent 进行预览、手持蓝图准备放置、成功放置、捕获、材料替换时，会在玩家鼠标光标附近实时弹出 ToolCallSpeechOverlay 对话气泡（例如 📐 手持蓝图 [ SPOM ] 准备放置于 (15,30) [预览]）。 存档隔离的文件夹式游戏笔记工具 (Save-Isolated Notes & AGENTS.md) 虚拟文件系统 /active/notes/ 与 /active/ops/colony.md (notes 域) 提供按当前活跃游戏存档物理隔离的笔记管理系统： 自动生成 AGENTS.md：每个存档的 notes/AGENTS.md 自动初始化为该存档专属的核心背景文档，包含殖民地战略目标、防爆温/防爆管心法、禁忌规则（默认禁用自动消毒、严禁盲目开挖液体蓄水池等）及阶段里程碑。 子文件夹管理：支持组织 plans/（工程规划）、milestones/（阶段日志）、issues/（疑难杂症）等目录。 操作接口：可通过 /active/ops/colony.md 调度 notes 域动作： list [folder="plans"] read path="AGENTS.md" write path="plans/spom.md" content="..." append path="milestones/cycle-50.md" content="..." rename from="..." to="..." delete path="..." status 虚拟文件系统支持：可通过 world_editor 读取 /active/notes/AGENTS.md 并通过 SEARCH/REPLACE 直接编辑。 视觉反馈：读写、更新 AGENTS.md 或追加里程碑日志时，同样在鼠标光标旁弹出实时气泡提示。 动态资源体系与异步长耗时通知 (Dynamic Resources & Async Notifications) 除了传统的电网与建筑工具，ONI 具备丰富的动态游戏生态状态。OniMcp 将核心状态作为 MCP 原生 Dynamic Resources (oni://...) 公开，替代繁重的工具轮询： 核心殖民地动态资源 URI 说明 内容格式 oni://atmosphere/summary 全图大气质量、氧气占比、主要气体分布与气温统计 JSON oni://atmosphere/breathability 复制人可呼吸格子数、氧气储量、CO2 及窒息风险评估 JSON oni://fluid/liquid/summary 净水、污水、原油、盐水等液体存量、储液罐与温度分布 JSON oni://fluid/gas/summary 世界主要气体储量、储气罐与管道通畅度 JSON oni://plumbing/summary 液体/气体管网网格段数、畅通状态及布局统计 JSON oni://thermal/summary 世界最高/最低/平均温度场，极端高温与极寒格统计 JSON oni://food/summary 全殖民地食物卡路里储备、人均可用天数及断粮预警 JSON oni://farming/crops 种植箱与农砖作物数量、成熟可收获数量及生长分布 JSON oni://ranching/summary 动物存活总数、按物种分布统计与圈舍拥挤状态 JSON oni://dupes/vitals 复制人生理指标：生命、压力、饱食、呼吸、膀胱等 JSON oni://dupes/morale 复制人士气值、士气期望值、净士气差额及高压预警 JSON oni://geysers/summary 已探明喷孔、类型、喷发元素、温度及坐标 JSON oni://research/progress 当前研发科技、已解锁科技总数及各级研究点数 JSON oni://resources/stockpile 按分类汇总的矿物、金属、原材料与工业存量 JSON oni://notes/{path} 读取当前存档隔离的游戏笔记（如 AGENTS.md） Markdown oni://blueprints/{name} 读取已保存蓝图的完整结构定义 JSON 异步执行与主动通知 (Method 2: Async + Dynamic Resources Notification) 对于长耗时计算（如大范围扫描、生存长跑分诊、高负载蓝图分析）： 任务提交：调用操作时附带 async: true，服务器立即返回： { "status": "submitted", "taskId": "task_20261019_...", "resourceUri": "oni://reports/task_20261019_...", "message": "任务已提交，完成后结果将写入 oni://reports/... 并主动发送 notifications/resources/list_changed 通知。" } 异步执行：MCP 服务器在 Unity 主线程调度队列或后台任务池中异步执行，不阻塞客户端调用。 主动通知：任务结束时，服务器写入该动态报告资源，并通过 SSE 主动广播 notifications/resources/list_changed 与 notifications/resources/updated。 按需读取：Agent 接收到通知后，调用 resources/read 读取 oni://reports/task_... 获取完整结果，实现真正的事件驱动与动态资源分离架构。 订单与剪断 orders_control supports semantic targets and area handles. For an exact rectangle, read /active/ops/tools.md, ignore hidden coordinate compatibility entries, then edit /active/ops/orders.md, for example 挖 x1=10 y1=20 x2=18 y2=20 priority=7 dryRun=true. Preview with outer dryRun=true and no confirmation; execute only with a new edit using outer dryRun=false, confirm=true, and non-conflicting command flags. { "domain": "area", "action": "dig", "areaId": "a1", "confirm": true } 剪断管线和线路时: cut_conduits type=auto 默认包含气管、液管、固体轨道、电线和逻辑线。 type=wire 只剪电线。 type=logic 只剪逻辑线。 type=all 适合明确需要更大范围时使用。 相机与视图 navigation_control 仅用于相机、覆盖层和截图。支持的动作包括： get_view：读取当前相机位置、缩放和激活世界。 set_active_world：切换激活世界并移动相机。 set_view / move：设置或平移相机。 set_zoom zoom=23：保持当前中心缩放，不需要 x/y。zoom 是视野的半高，数值越大看得越远；默认立即生效。 switch_view：切换氧气、电力、管线、温度等覆盖层，可选截图。 focus_cell / focus_dupe：聚焦格子或复制人。 screenshot / coordinate_screenshot：保存普通截图或带坐标网格的区域截图。 相机动作可直接传对应的 x/y、dx/dy 或截图边界坐标；这不会开放建造、订单等工具的坐标输入。set_view 和 move 省略 zoom 时保持当前缩放，snap=false 同时平滑移动与缩放。随后用 get_view 核对当前 orthographicSize 与原生目标 targetOrthographicSize。world_editor command=zoom ... syncView=true 默认完整取景；显式 focusMode=detail 才使用可能裁切范围的近景模式。 建造和任务操作应直接使用 building_control 与 orders_control。每次工具调用必填的 task 文本会自动显示在玩家鼠标附近，无需额外定位流程。 尚未就绪的读数 电力端口的 networkPending=true 表示电网正在重建、组件电路 ID 与网络不一致，或网络尚不可读。此时 connected 和 circuitId 为 null，不能推断为断电；网络稳定后，circuitId 仍使用字符串，"-1" 表示没有连接。 建筑配置中的温度传感器需要填满原生八次采样缓冲区并发布平均值。预热期间修改阈值可能提前发布不完整平均值；采样计数达到八次、尚未执行下一次原生发布时也保守返回等待状态。就绪前 samplePending=true，currentValue 和 formattedCurrentValue 为 null；不要把初始零值当成零开尔文。其他阈值组件的有限零值仍有效。读取后等待短暂模拟，再重新查询；这两个标记不会自动恢复游戏。 常用资源 URI 说明 oni://colony/status 周期、复制人数、速度、暂停状态 oni://colony/diagnostics 缺氧、断粮、过热等诊断 oni://colony/alerts 当前警报和通知 oni://colony/summary 面向行动规划的殖民地摘要 oni://resources/inventory 资源库存 oni://resources/food 食物库存和保质信息 oni://dupes 复制人列表 oni://dupes/status-check 复制人位置、差事、需求和疑似被困风险 oni://plumbing/liquid 液体管道回路、流动方向向量、流速与堵塞瓶颈 oni://plumbing/gas 气体管道回路、流动方向向量与气体元素分布 oni://circuits/logic 自动化逻辑信号网络（0/1 电平与 4-bit 线束通道） oni://circuits/power 电网摘要、回路负载、发电量与过载状态 oni://power/summary 电网摘要和电池状态 oni://power/ports 电力接口格、锚点、接线点和端口是否已有电线 oni://rooms/list 房间系统状态 oni://thermal/overheat-risk 建筑过热风险 oni://world/text-map 文本地图 oni://buildings/defs 可建造建筑定义 oni://tools/manifest 工具清单 oni://tools/guide 按目标推荐工具链 oni://guide/mechanics 机制、公式、边界条件速查 代码目录 mods/OniMcp/ ├── ModInfo.cs # KMod 入口 ├── Config/ # 选项 ├── Core/ # MCP 协议类型 ├── Localization/ # STRINGS ├── Patches/ # Harmony 补丁与游戏策略 ├── UI/ # 运行时 Overlay（坐标网格、对话气泡） ├── Server/ # HTTP/MCP 服务 ├── Support/ # 日志、路径、反射 └── Tools/ ├── Core/ # 工具与资源注册 ├── Entry/ # 聚合入口（*Control* / Read / 英文描述） ├── WorldEditor/ # 虚拟世界文件系统 ├── Shared/ # 共享辅助 └── Impl/ # 各域实现（Build/Dupes/World/...） Prefer extending aggregate entrypoints in Tools/Entry/ for new public capabilities. Domain implementations live under Tools/Impl/<Domain>/. Shared search, reachability, and material checks belong in Tools/Shared/; exact spatial operations are routed through typed files under /active/ops/. 兼容性说明 客户端按当前会话协议接入： 以 2025-11-25 调用 initialize，保存响应中的 Mcp-Session-Id。 后续请求携带该会话 ID 和 Mcp-Protocol-Version: 2025-11-25。 不要硬编码旧版细粒度工具列表；按当前协议调用 tools/list 或读取运行时 manifest。 调用 server_control domain=catalog action=search 或读取 oni://tools/guide 查找目标流程。 优先传语义定位参数。 对危险动作传 confirm: true。 执行后读取资源或区域快照验证状态。

title: OniMods 架构与核心实现原理
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 OniMods 架构与核心实现原理 本文档系统介绍仓库内两大核心 Mod 的底层实现机制、设计取舍与运行原理： OniMcp：面向大模型（LLM）的智能体交互协议与虚拟化世界系统（AI 交互与控制层） CycleTrim：早期实验性性能模组。眼下裁剪模拟热点；下个版本实验拆掉「一格一物」，把组分通量核搬上 GPU。先加速，再兼容。说明见 next-cell-representation.md。 目录 一、 双 Mod 协同体系 二、 OniMcp 原理：世界文本化与大模型交互 1. 为什么需要世界文本化？ 2. 语义行程编码 (Semantic Runs) 3. 单一坐标权威与消除歧义 (Disambiguation) 4. 动态活动图例 (Active Legend Filtering) 5. 空间 AABB 快速初筛裁剪 6. 虚拟文件系统与代码编辑隐喻 (World Editor) 7. 严格安全控制环路 (Preflight & Safety Guard) 三、 CycleTrim 原理：底层模拟热点削峰 1. 缺氧模拟的性能瓶颈分析 2. 忙碌复制人任务感应节流 (Busy Duplicant Chore Throttle) 3. 条件弱引用状态表与反射短路 (ConditionalWeakTable) 4. 寻路探针队列配额与削峰 (AsyncPathProber Quota) 5. 静态/沉睡生物脑休眠 (Stationary Critter Sleep) 四、 架构对比与设计取舍 一、 双 Mod 协同体系 在《缺氧》中实现长周期大模型自主代理（Autonomous Play）面临两大根本难题： 交互瓶颈：原版游戏信息极度碎片化，大模型直接读图代价高昂且缺乏精细坐标，直接倾倒全量网格 JSON 会瞬间爆满上下文。 算力瓶颈：游戏进行到大后期，全星体实体、动物与寻路逻辑导致单核 CPU 严重过载，造成卡顿掉帧，进而导致外部 AI 调用的时钟超时与失序。 OniMcp 与 CycleTrim 形成了互补的协同闭环： ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 外部 AI / 客户端 │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ Model Context Protocol (HTTP) ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ OniMcp │ │ • 将 2D 物理世界压缩为极低 Token 的语义行程与虚拟文件 │ │ • 确保坐标无歧义，消除幻觉图例，提供代码级编辑接口 │ │ • 严格执行：暂停 -> 观察 -> 规划 -> 预检 -> 验证环路 │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ 操控游戏实体与订单 ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Oxygen Not Included │ │ 原生游戏物理引擎 │ └───────────────────────────▲────────────────────────────┘ │ Harmony 运行时补丁 ┌───────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────┐ │ CycleTrim │ │ • 截断忙碌小人的无用感应计算，缓存 ChoreConsumer 引用 │ │ • 动态控制寻路探针配额，休眠静止生物行为树 │ │ • 为 AI 长期自主游玩提供平稳帧率与低延迟环境 │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ 二、 OniMcp 原理：世界文本化与大模型交互 1. 为什么需要世界文本化？ 《缺氧》拥有复杂的网格系统（默认每个星体宽度数百格，每个格子包含实体、温度、气压、质量、病菌、铺设管线等）。如果直接输出网格 JSON，一个 40×40 的小房间需要 1600+ 个对象，占用数万 Token；如果输出 ASCII 像素画，既无法表达多层物理信息（如气体中的电线与管道），又充斥无意义空格。 OniMcp 的世界文本化将 2D 实体网格转换为语义行与结构化切片。 2. 语义行程编码 (Semantic Runs) 在视口扫描中，横向连续同质的单元格被压缩为一个“行程”（Run）： 格式定义：x=X1..X2:token（单格为 `x=X:`token） 示例： | Y | RY | Runs | |---|---:|---| | `102` | `2` | x=14..18:`tile`; x=19:`bld_anchor`; x=20..22:`bld`; x=23..30:`oxy` | 成效： Token 开销由网格维度的 $O(W \times H)$ 降至语义连续区段的 $O(\text{Runs})$，平均节省 70%~90% 的 Token。 行程内保留高层抽象符号（bld_anchor 建筑基准点、bp 施工蓝图、tile 砖块、oxy 氧气）。 3. 单一坐标权威与消除歧义 (Disambiguation) 早期文本化实现中包含 x=14..18 rx=0..4 等相对坐标字段，实践证明大模型经常发生“坐标系混淆”，将相对视口偏移 rx 当作绝对坐标下达挖掘指令，造成越界空挥或破坏重要设施。 全局权威坐标：文本地图表格全面废除 run 内连续的 rx= 重复输出，仅在表头标注视口原点，正文 Run 统一使用绝对坐标。 稀疏模式去冗余：稀疏运行表格（sparseRuns）剔除 RX Range 列，防止并列多列数值造成模型视觉注意力错位。 4. 动态活动图例 (Active Legend Filtering) 传统静态图例无论当前区域有何元素，均倾倒全量 14~20 行定义（包含氢气、高危氯气、极低温气体等）。 动态追踪：扫描网格单元时通过 observedTokens 收集实际出现的 Token。 按需渲染：图例表格仅输出当前视野中真实存在的标记，彻底杜绝模型因看到图例条目而臆测当前区域有毒气或特殊物料的幻觉（Hallucination）。 5. 空间 AABB 快速初筛裁剪 在生成建筑与蓝图覆盖层时，建筑的地基支撑（MissingSupportCells）与空间重叠（FootprintObstructions）计算开销昂贵。 包围盒剪枝：在对星体全量建筑调用分析算法前，先执行视口 AABB 快速相交初筛（objX < minX || objX > maxX || objY < minY || objY > maxY），跳过 90% 以上与当前视口无关的建筑。 6. 虚拟文件系统与代码编辑隐喻 (World Editor) OniMcp 的 world_editor 将整个世界状态映射为一组虚拟 Markdown 文件： /active/infrastructure/power.md：电力连通性拓扑 /active/infrastructure/liquid_conduits.md：水管网络 /active/buildings/instances/...：具体建筑的参数与运行配置 /active/map/cell_X_Y.md：单格跨层快照 大模型无需记忆海量专属 API，而是通过最擅长的代码重构能力（read 配合 SEARCH/REPLACE 块）提出规划与管线布线修改。 7. 严格安全控制环路 (Preflight & Safety Guard) 为防止 AI 执行破坏性操作，OniMcp 强制执行防作弊与安全预检： 硬编码安全策略：禁止沙盒强制放置、瞬间建造与实体无成本生成。 前置预检 (Dry-Run)：建筑规划与指令下达优先使用 dryRun=true 验证地基、材料存量与路径可达性。 闭环节奏：AI 操控遵守 pause (暂停) -> observe (观测) -> plan (规划) -> dryRun (预检) -> execute (执行) -> resume (短恢复) -> pause (再次暂停) -> verify (验证) 节拍。 三、 CycleTrim 原理：底层模拟热点削峰 1. 缺氧模拟的性能瓶颈分析 0.4.0 已落地的裁剪仍是复制人、寻路和组件查询。下个版本要动的是更底层的格子表示：官方和当前 OniSim 都是一格一物，物质相遇就搜索邻格排挤。这个搜索又分支又跳内存，和后面要上的 GPU 通量核不在一条路上。实验范围、还没解决的压力步和玩法契约见 next-cell-representation.md。当前包没有换成混合流体。 《缺氧》模拟每帧都需要更新大量系统。大后期殖民地性能急剧劣化的主要热点包括： Duplicant Chore Sensors：无论复制人是否在执行任务，传感器系统每 tick 都在重新评估全图搬运池。 Component Lookup 开销：C# 托管层与 Unity 原生层之间的 GetComponent 密集查询。 寻路风暴 (NavGrid Churn)：几十只小动物同时计算不可达目标导致的异步寻路队列暴涨。 2. 忙碌复制人任务感应节流 (Busy Duplicant Chore Throttle) 核心观察：当复制人正处于长周期确定性任务中（如长途跋涉搬运、持续建造、持续挖掘），绝大多数情况不需要在下一 tick 强行打断并重新分配相同的常规任务。 行为保持：一旦小人变成空闲（Idle）、任务被打断、或优先级发生主动改变，节流立即失效，无缝恢复原版排程敏感度。 3. 条件弱引用状态表与反射短路 (ConditionalWeakTable) 痛点：在传感器补丁中每次调用 sensor.GetComponent<ChoreConsumer>() 会在高频调用下累积严重的 CPU 耗时。 实现机制： // 维护传感器与状态对象的弱引用绑定，不阻碍垃圾回收 private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<PickupableSensor, State> SensorStates = new ConditionalWeakTable<PickupableSensor, State>(); 在 State 中缓存解析好的 ChoreConsumer 引用，使后续数十万次的高频检查完全避开反射与原生组件查询，纯粹在托管内存完成。 4. 寻路探针队列配额与削峰 (AsyncPathProber Quota) 异步寻路探针在高密度基地下容易积压成千上万个工单。 CycleTrim 对后台 Worker 分发实施滑动窗口配额，按在途排队数量做自适应背压削峰，防止突发大范围不可达搜索抢占主渲染线程。 5. 静态/沉睡生物脑休眠 (Stationary Critter Sleep) 当小动物处于被束缚、在捕获点等待搬运或夜间休眠时，其空间坐标处于静态锁定。 补丁将其高频的地面导航探测与行为树刷新挂起，直至受到外部物理扰动或状态变更事件唤醒，单项热点耗时下降 90% 以上。 四、 架构对比与设计取舍 核心维度 OniMcp CycleTrim 层次 应用层 / 外部通信协议 核心模拟层 / 引擎补丁 工作介质 HTTP、JSON-RPC、Markdown 文本 C# IL 字节码、Harmony 运行时 Patch 优化目标 降低上下文 Token 消耗，消除 LLM 幻觉与歧义 先把模拟帧时间打下来。下个版本实验用无分支通量核替换一格一物 安全准则 零作弊、沙盒隔离、必须经过 Preflight 验证 0.4.0 的热点裁剪仍尽量不改排程语义。格子表示实验不把「与原版逐格一致」当通过条件 验证体系 静态契约检查、无头 MCP 协议套件、离线格式断言 合成微基准、ILSpy 反编译断言、目标 DLL 契约验证 五、 现代浏览器自动化驱动的高效控制范式 (Browser-Inspired & CodeMode) 为了解决传统基于 LLM 的游戏控制中“频繁乒乓轮询、盲目休眠、进度缓慢、Token 开销巨大”的痛点，OniMcp 深度借鉴了现代浏览器自动化框架（Playwright、Chrome DevTools Protocol）的核心设计模式： 1. 目标驱动条件推进 (step_until，对标 Playwright waitForCondition 与游戏自动化硬件报警) 事实读取（step_facts）、原子条件与 all / any 组合（until）、有时限推进并暂停（step_until）分别负责观察、表达和执行。具体暂停策略交给 Agent；例如全员空闲只是可选条件。完整语义与示例见 可组合推进条件。 淘汰盲目休眠：严禁无目的的 resume -> sleep(10s) -> pause（复制人跑路需要十几秒，固定休眠导致 LLM 频繁空转轮询）。 事件驱动快进：通过 game_control domain=speed action=step_until 指定终止条件（condition: "orders_complete" | "dupe_idle" | "cycle_end" | "print" | "research" | "alarm" | "alarm:<name>" | "notify:<keyword>" | "notify:good" | "notify:bad" 等），游戏以 3x 快进倍速 持续模拟。 全方位原生通知拦截（HUD Notifications Hook）：全面接管缺氧游戏内的 NotificationScreen 与 NotificationManager。不仅支持打印舱就绪（condition: "print"）与科技研究完毕（condition: "research"）这类里程碑瞬时唤醒，还支持按通知类型（notify:good / notify:bad / notify:message / notify:event）或按关键字（如管道堵塞 notify:pipe、建筑故障 notify:broken、饥饿 notify:starv）进行模糊拦截。 自动化告警硬件联动（Hardware Alarm Hook）：充分利用缺氧强大的自动化电路（传感器 + 自动化通知器 LogicAlarm）。Agent 只需建造自动化通知器并命名（如 WaterFull 或 TempNormal），即可直接运行 step_until condition="WaterFull"。信号线变绿瞬间，主线程毫秒级捕获通知器事件并自动暂停返回，达到对标 Webhook / 硬件中断级别的超高效率。 原生威胁自动拦截：无论当前设置何种条件，只要出现复制人窒息、致命伤、受困红警或 NotificationType.DuplicantThreatening，引擎立即强制刹车暂停并返回威胁告警，杜绝挂机致死。 自动暂停与截断：主线程在 Unity Update() 每帧监听目标达成或异常告警，一旦达成立即触发安全暂停，避免挂机空跑或灾难蔓延。 2. 增量感知与执行报告 (ExecutionDelta，对标 DOM Mutation Diff) 拒绝全量 Dump：推进结束后不重新序列化数千 Token 的完整地图，而是直接返回仅百余 Token 的精炼差异摘要（包含新增 HUD 通知、告警、空闲复制人与工单状态）： { "stopReason": "notification:Research Complete: Basic Farming", "condition": "research", "elapsedGameSeconds": 48.5, "elapsedWallSeconds": 13.2, "startCycle": 10, "endCycle": 10, "remainingTargetOrders": 0, "idleDuplicants": [], "alerts": [], "alarms": [], "notifications": [ { "title": "Research Complete: Basic Farming", "type": "Good", "isNew": true, "isAlarm": false, "notifier": "ResearchCenter" } ], "newNotificationCount": 1, "immigrantsAvailable": false, "isPaused": true } LLM 凭借增量即可确认工单达成，节省 85%+ 上下文开销。 3. 原生 CodeMode 流程支持 (domain=code / domain=program) 单回合闭环控制：Agent 无需在聊天对话中反复来回发起单个工具调用，可直接以代码/流程形式将“工单下达 -> 目标快进 -> 结果返回”组合为原子脚本： { "domain": "code", "action": "execute", "code": [ { "tool": "orders_control", "args": { "domain": "dig", "action": "line", "x1": 20, "y1": 20, "x2": 25, "y2": 20 } }, { "tool": "game_control", "args": { "domain": "speed", "action": "step_until", "condition": "orders_complete", "speed": 3, "maxGameSeconds": 60 }, "saveAs": "delta" }, { "return": "$delta" } ] } 该架构实现了单回合内游戏时间推进数十秒、工单全量交付的极高自主游玩效率。

title: OniHarness: independent headless testing project
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 OniHarness: independent headless testing project OniHarness is an independently usable Git project, linked here as the tools/OniHarness submodule. The gitlink pins a reviewed revision; it does not copy the harness into OniMods' source tree. git submodule update --init tools/OniHarness python3 tools/OniHarness/scripts/verify.py The command above builds and runs the harness's own game-free checks. It does not add a game dependency to OniMods' existing source contracts or host tests. For explicitly requested local tests with your installed game: python3 tools/OniHarness/scripts/verify.py --game-path /path/to/OxygenNotIncluded For fixture tests, OniHarness starts its own test workers and calls the installed native simulation library directly. It does not launch ONI, Steam or Unity Player. The initial preview has a verified Linux x64 adapter for build 744825 and exact file hashes. Other native versions are unsupported until verified. The examples cover gas mass, heat transfer, liquid movement, custom material parameters, energy input and cell replacement. C# tests can exercise portable mod helpers and selected installed game methods in a .NET host. In those workers, full colony loading, duplicants/AI, building lifecycle and Harmony patch execution are not supported. These tests do not replace in-game acceptance gates for OniMods. See the subproject's capability table and local verification receipt. Game libraries, assets, saves and decompiled implementation are not distributed. The new framework uses AUL 1.0-draft.1, with its own license and upstream identity. Agent skill and observed physics experiment Use the project-local oni-harness skill. It routes to the maintained skill in the submodule. Native fixture commands remain game-free; starting the real game is a separate explicit workflow. cd tools/OniHarness python3 scripts/physics_playground.py --game-path /path/to/OxygenNotIncluded \ --repeat 2 --output artifacts/physics-playground The experiment waits for water to reach the basin, removes three partition cells, observes flow into a second chamber, then adds heat to a measured water cell. It records all sampled state and checks; reaching an observation limit fails and prevents later actions. Open the output index.html to replay the data; --gif also renders images when Pillow is already installed. The skill and example are source-checkout additions after the v0.1.0 release. No full colony gameplay capability is implied by this physics experiment. Real headless game and optional text spectator For actual colony/mod behavior, use the experimental runtime workflow. It starts ONI through Steam, keeps native simulation and offers an optional companion with a configurable update cap and game-owned stop deadline. Default launch requires batch mode, a Null graphics device and zero camera renders, with no graphical fallback. Normal/reduced are explicit graphical modes. Compatibility and performance must be checked per installed game, save and mod combination. cd tools/OniHarness python3 scripts/runtime.py launch # After a disposable save copy is loaded and paused: python3 scripts/runtime.py observe --view text python3 scripts/runtime.py serve Install the companion and enable OniMcp as described in the runtime document before launching. The text spectator shows the same paused virtual-file map returned to the agent, with observation time, supplied intent and action result. It does not control the game or poll its state. --view none records without printing a terminal map. Linux headless support is experimental; the public native run receipt includes a loaded colony, native progression and a client-loss stop/recovery test. A successful startup alone does not establish a working colony. For a performance iteration, launch an installed CycleTrim with its opt-in probe: python3 scripts/runtime.py launch --game-arg=--cycletrim-perf-probe # After loading the same disposable save and verifying pause: python3 scripts/measure_steps.py --label candidate --seconds 3 --samples 5 --warmup 1 \ --require-log-marker '[CycleTrim][PerfProbe] resolved target:' Compare native advancement, CPU per native second, control phases and paging. The first iteration fixed duplicate CycleTrim patch installation; see the evidence and limitations. Shorter control waits or lower resident memory alone do not establish faster simulation. Runtime files are source-checkout additions after v0.1.0. Existing CLI/Core release assets are unchanged. Keep actual game evidence distinct from native fixtures and host/source checks; no full-feature compatibility is promised.

title: A Letter to Everyone Who Finds This Project Interesting
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 A Letter to Everyone Who Finds This Project Interesting To everyone who finds this project interesting: Recently, I have been working on something a little unusual. It is called OniMods. One of the projects inside it is an MCP Mod that allows AI to enter the world of Oxygen Not Included. The idea is not simply to let AI answer questions. I wanted to explore something deeper: Can AI understand a world with rules, observe its environment, make decisions, and actually become a participant rather than just a tool? That curiosity is what started this project. But during development, I quickly discovered a problem: This is expensive. Every decision AI makes consumes Tokens. And in a continuously running environment like a game, the cost can grow very quickly. I am just a university student. I do not have a company, investors, or a development team behind me. Most of the cost has been supported by myself. I have spent countless hours writing code, testing models, debugging problems, and using a large amount of Tokens just to make this idea work. Sometimes I ask myself: Is a personal project really worth this much effort? But every time I see AI starting to understand the game world, every time someone becomes interested in this experiment, I feel that it is worth continuing. I do not want this to become a simple donation request. Instead, I hope to create a way where people can support the project while also receiving something valuable. So I created: https://api.lmm.best It is an AI API service platform. You can purchase Tokens here to use AI services, and at the same time help me cover the ongoing development costs of OniMods. A part of the revenue will be used to support open-source development. The source code is now hosted by the TokenNotIncluded organization. I also want to give something back to people who contribute. If you are willing to: Submit Issues and help find problems; Submit Pull Requests and improve the code; Share ideas and suggestions; Help test new features; I will provide Token rewards whenever possible. I hope to build a small cycle: People use the service and help the project continue. People contribute to open source and make it better. I keep investing my time to turn more interesting ideas into reality. OniMods is still a small project today. But many meaningful things start from a simple thought: “What if this could actually work?” And then someone spends the time to make it real. Thank you to everyone who follows, uses, contributes to, or supports this project. I hope this curiosity can continue for a long time.

title: 写给所有对这个项目感兴趣的人
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 写给所有对这个项目感兴趣的人 最近，我一直在做一件有点不寻常的事情。 它叫作 OniMods。 其中一个项目是 OniMcp，这是一个让 AI 进入《缺氧》世界的 MCP Mod。 我想做的并不只是让 AI 回答问题。 我想探索更深一层的问题： AI 能否理解一个有规则的世界，观察周围的环境，做出决定，并真正成为其中的参与者，而不只是一个工具？ 正是这份好奇心，让我开始了这个项目。 但在开发过程中，我很快发现了一个问题： 这件事的成本很高。 AI 做出的每一个决定都要消耗 Token。 而像游戏这样持续运行的环境，成本增长得会非常快。 我只是一名大学生。 我的身后没有公司、投资人或开发团队。 大部分成本都由我自己承担。 为了让这个想法真正运转起来，我花了无数个小时编写代码、测试模型、调试问题，也消耗了大量 Token。 有时我会问自己： 一个个人项目，真的值得投入这么多精力吗？ 但每当我看到 AI 开始理解游戏世界，每当有人对这个实验产生兴趣，我就觉得它值得继续下去。 我不希望这变成一个简单的捐款请求。 相反，我希望找到一种方式，让大家在支持项目的同时，也能获得有价值的东西。 于是，我创建了： https://api.lmm.best 这是一个 AI API 服务平台。 你可以在这里购买 Token 来使用 AI 服务，同时也帮助我承担 OniMods 持续开发的成本。 其中一部分收入将用于支持开源开发。项目源码现由 TokenNotIncluded 组织托管。 我也希望回馈那些愿意参与贡献的人。 如果你愿意： 提交 Issue，帮助发现问题； 提交 Pull Request，改进代码； 分享想法和建议； 帮助测试新功能； 我会在可能的情况下提供 Token 奖励。 我希望建立一个小小的循环： 大家使用服务，帮助项目继续发展。 大家参与开源贡献，让项目变得更好。 我继续投入时间，把更多有趣的想法变成现实。 OniMods 现在仍然只是一个小项目。 但许多有意义的事情，都始于一个简单的念头： “如果这真的能实现呢？” 然后，有人投入时间，让它真正成为现实。 感谢每一位关注、使用、贡献或支持这个项目的人。 我希望这份好奇心能够持续很久。

title: Licensing and provenance
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 Licensing and provenance The root LICENSE sets out the Agent Upstream License (AUL) 1.0-draft.1 for original parts of OniMods that their rights holders can license under AUL, from this revision onward. It does not relicense materials owned by other authors or retroactively change a prior license grant. Prior MIT releases: Earlier versions of this repository were released under the MIT License. That grant remains available for those earlier versions and cannot be withdrawn retroactively. Its original text and copyright notice are kept at LICENSE.MIT. Third-party dependencies and references: .NET, Rust packages, Harmony, PLib, FastTrack and the Oxygen Not Included game are separate works and retain their own terms. A mention of a reference or inspiration does not make it an AUL-covered work. TOON encoder: OniMcp bundles Toon.Format from toon-format/toon-dotnet under MIT; its copyright and license are retained in mods/OniMcp/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Adapted contributions: Changes that incorporate code owned by other authors retain the original terms for that material unless the actual rights holders expressly authorize a different license. In particular, review the attribution in docs/adiatma-ports.md. Keep copyright and required notices in the source. Future contributions: A pull request does not automatically convey rights the contributor does not possess. Confirm the licensing basis before describing contributed material as AUL-covered. AUL is a custom MIT-inspired license with upstream issue and PR duties; it is not the standard MIT License and has not been approved by OSI. See the AUL project for the reference text. Licensing questions involving third-party files should be resolved before publication. Jlib (mods/Jlib): separate MIT-licensed fork of Peter Han’s PLib; its inherited terms, notices and upstream relationship are maintained in that submodule. Consumer Mods reference the shared library and do not embed it.

title: OniSim engineering log
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 OniSim engineering log Current checkpoint (2026-11-20) The exact Linux x64 U60/763796 tuple is admitted after strict assembly, Mono, official Sim and ABI checks. Development source 8db2654 has actual-game evidence for six naturally formed oxygen/carbon-dioxide cells: complete inventories, mass, temperature and total mass match as binary32 bits after a unique checkpoint and same-process reload, followed by bounded advancement. See runtime validation for method, identities and the linked profile, actual-Mono and live receipts. These changes are not yet on Steam Workshop; Windows/macOS profiles remain limited to 744825. Mixed saves now use version 0x4f4d0001 and a mandatory ONIMIX extension; ordinary single-inventory v15 images remain unchanged. The tested older OniSim rejects mixed images. The save contract records exact 22-species host/FFI round trips; live extra-species slots remain unverified. Whole-game performance A/B and long-duration/DLC acceptance remain open. The tested pressure values are placeholders; later fill, pressure-availability and background-run changes need their own actual-game validation. The dated snapshots below retain their original evidence and limitations. Status snapshot (2026-11-16) CycleTrim 0.4.24 corrects multicomponent region coverage at the final public row and column. Public coordinates are shifted by one into padded storage, so the interior occupies [1, width + 1) x [1, height + 1). Gas and liquid staging, species discovery, batch/idle keys, diffusion ownership masks and the thermal region map now share those exclusive upper bounds. The surrounding halo remains outside the regional operators. Validation on the development machine: Eight new boundary regressions pass, covering edge/corner gas expansion, per-species liquid conservation, exact mask dimensions, sleeping-region invalidation, batch wake-up and thermal ownership. Gas direct/batch tests explicitly require the GPU path; Vulkan logs identify the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU. Sparse liquid and reference liquid diffusion both execute on that device. The complete native Release suite passes: 229 passed, 0 failed, 19 ignored. The ignored cases retain their existing manual benchmark annotations. The conservation fixture for a 4x4 public world now sums all sixteen cells; its original 1e-4 tolerance is unchanged. This is native CPU/GPU correctness validation. No ONI process was launched in this iteration under the previously retained no-launch instruction. Whole-game FPS, save/load and long-duration acceptance are outside these results. Status snapshot (2026-11-08) Runtime policy Since CycleTrim 0.4.5 OniSim is always mapped at startup; the PLib EnableOniSimExperimental toggle and the official-SimDLL fallback were removed. CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_ENABLE=0 is an emergency kill switch only. CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_WORKERS defaults to 8 when unset (0.4.6). 0.4.7/0.4.8: FLAG_MULTICOMPONENT_COEXISTENCE lets a second gas species share a cell when classic displace_gas fails; the multicomponent CPU upwind flux runs in the native tick. Saves still store the dominant element plus a runtime mixture overlay. GPU pipeline GpuSimulation (wgpu 30, Vulkan) is created at engine construction unless CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_GPU=0; failure falls back to CPU with a log line. Committed and in the tick: whole-grid thermal diffusion with resident temperatures and compressed mixture-presence uploads; regional gas multicomponent diffusion / pressure projection / transport / thermal chained between GPU buffers; sparse liquid multicomponent diffusion overlapped with the CPU gas-pressure pass; diffusion snapshots limited to the active region. CPU-side tick changes: bubble simulation skips empty spans, liquid droplets settle, bubbles and droplets share one sparse scan, and idle zero-time frames reuse the previous publication. Working tree (uncommitted): GPU bubble/droplet movement, phase-transition selection, gas pressure faces and liquid head/flow, disease diffusion and growth, radiation regions and inactive-cell decay are wired into simulation_step.rs behind systems.gpu, with the CPU functions kept as the no-GPU path. cargo check --release passes for the native crate. No unit test run, differential fixture or in-game log has been recorded for these passes yet. Last game evidence: Player.log from 2026-11-08 00:26 reports GPU acceleration active on Vulkan device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (grid 738x306). It predates all 2026-11-08 commits listed above. Open gates Per-step upload / device wait / readback remains; not a device-resident loop. Pressure, partial-pressure and liquid-volume-fraction publication, three or more species per cell and full save/load of all components are incomplete. No whole-game FPS, long-duration, DLC or other-Mod acceptance for the current source. Status snapshot (2026-11-07) Message routing audit A static audit against OFFICIAL-MESSAGES.md found all 62 official message IDs referenced by the current native source. Fifty-nine route into lifecycle, world, cell-material, cell-command, thermal-component, mass-component, interaction or radiation handlers. SetVisibleCells, ToggleProfiler and RadiationSickness are explicit no-ops because they are absent from both dispatch registries in the pinned official 744825 library. This is identifier and dispatch accounting only; it is not proof that every message's complete gameplay semantics are equivalent. Confirmed remaining gaps Elements_CreateInteractions is parsed and its rule records are retained in state, but do_gas_interaction and do_gas_interaction_pair have no caller in the Rust fixed-step pipeline. Static inspection of the pinned official control flow also found no incoming call to the legacy three-argument helper. Whether these helpers belong in the active simulation path is unresolved; do not add a guessed phase call without a positive official call-site or a differential behavior fixture.
