The current source has no passing overall four-worker scaling gate. Worker creation and differential correctness do not prove a performance win. The current source snapshot has no corresponding full-game graphical, long-duration or whole-colony acceptance. Historical receipts apply only to their exact source and binary identities. The 29 ordered GameDataUpdate event queues are declared and published by events.rs; each individual callback still requires end-to-end behavior coverage, not merely a non-null span. SIMSAVE v15 parsing/serialization and world-offset/topology handling exist; full multi-world DLC and long-running game compatibility remain separate acceptance gates. Physical pipeline status The fixed-step path currently runs temperature exchange and state transitions, gas/liquid pressure traversal, disease diffusion, radiation-region updates, component updates and cell post-processing. Post-processing calls partial-melt, sublimation/off-gas and unstable-cell paths. The helper remains unconnected in Rust; its required role in the pinned official simulation is unresolved and must not be guessed or marked complete. Safety and CI PR #568 changed the CycleTrim option to a new EnableOniSimExperimental key, default off. (Superseded by 0.4.5: the toggle was removed and OniSim is always mapped.) The standalone loader was also default-off, requiring an explicit CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_ENABLE=1/true/on opt-in. (Superseded by 0.4.5 for the CycleTrim package; =0 remains the kill switch.) The original tools/OniHarness gitlink pointed at an unreachable commit (107fee3c…). The PR pins reachable OniHarness main (c149819e…) so checkout can proceed. Checkout success alone is not test acceptance. The Jlib submodule now pins 68e4935…. Its net48 FrameworkPathOverride is applied only when the supplied ONI Managed directory actually contains mscorlib.dll; a references-only directory therefore falls back to the installed .NET targeting pack. The embedded SteamPublisher build smoke test still checks extracted files on every host. It compiles only when the game-shipped com.rlabrecque.steamworks.net.dll is available; otherwise it reports an explicit skip instead of treating a missing ONI installation as a Rust core regression. This is not a substitute for a game-installed publisher integration build. The existing source checkpoint below records 47 passing Release Rust tests. It explicitly does not claim whole-game FPS/RSS, overall worker speedup or a current-source game launch. Older results below remain historical evidence. Source checkpoint: inline thermal command queue The production thermal command queue now stores each validated fixed-size ABI payload inline in a 48-byte queue entry. Its 14 supported message types need at most 44 payload bytes. Individual commands no longer allocate a separate payload Vec, and energy batches reserve once and append directly without a temporary batch vector. The queue still owns copied bytes; caller buffer reuse cannot alter pending commands. Processing preserves type rank, arrival order within a type, the backwall boundary and the exact original message bytes, including float bit patterns. All 47 Release Rust tests pass, including four new checks for owned payloads, ordering, batch ingestion and bounded rejection. This is a source-level allocation reduction. No whole-game FPS, RSS or one/four-worker speedup is claimed; short payloads can use more inline storage than their previous bare queue record. The four-worker overall performance gate remains open. No game was launched for this iteration, and the older binary hashes and runtime receipts below do not validate this changed native source. Previous source recheck at adc4b2e The then-current production native source tree 78a3a96032d063b196a52226fcdd9dcb0ab76564 rebuilds with Rust 1.99.1 as 55d5a236ccf6ac311d05a63898e34faceff686495ac372d1f6c9ccd785a62fd9. All 43 Release Rust tests and 57 game-free Python tests pass. Fresh runs against the fingerprint-pinned official 744825 library pass all 287 cases / 9,739 publications with one worker and again with four workers. The parallel emitter case observes all four OniSim-cell-* threads. The receipt is conformance/results/linux-744825-native-recheck-20261021.json. This correctness recheck does not turn the earlier failed one/four-worker scaling gates into a pass. No Steam/Unity client was launched; full game thread sampling, Unity memory, graphical and whole-colony performance acceptance remain open for this exact library. Earlier successful runtime receipts below belong to their stated binaries and cannot approve this one. A new equal-row disease-cleanup scheduling experiment is rejected. All 96 96x96 complete-frame final states match the official library, with four working cell threads and no timed major faults. However, mixed-germ CPU rises 4.30% and wall time rises 5.69%, exceeding the unchanged 3% regression limits. No production kernel or dispatch policy changed. The proposal and all samples are retained in conformance/results/linux-744825-balanced-disease-rows-20261021.json. The first timing attempt exposed a harness error: this container has no /proc/pressure files. The benchmark now records these optional counters as unknown with the OS error, allowing timing to proceed without inventing zero load. Required process memory and worker observations remain strict. New tests cover missing, denied and available pressure readings. Previous pressure-sweep development source The pressure-sweep native at that stage was 2772e52680f74a953a8fd18be396e2718ea1ccba1b7dad4fa738bc9cb98dc76f. The pressure sweep borrows fixed-length storage once, retaining checked indices, original floating expressions, serial transfer/notification order and padded-edge projection. It adds no heap storage or world copies. The former transfer caller has been migrated and removed; shared projection logic serves both notification paths. Transfer/cell source bodies match the baseline after adapter-name changes. All 43 release Rust tests and 50 game-free Python tests pass. Twenty-four new raw-flow-word fixtures include signed zero, subnormals, infinities and quiet/ signaling NaNs. Both the baseline and new core pass the expanded 287 cases / 9739 publications at one and four workers. An independent build from committed base e0e0fe7 plus the archived proposal reproduces the exact measured native. Incremental complete-frame tests against 8bd415ce on CPU0/2/4/6 with four workers pass the unchanged CPU/wall/RSS gates at both sizes: 96x96 has 96 samples and 192x192 has 60. CPU medians fall 2.56-16.31% in the five nonthermal 96x96 scenes and 5.15-13.48% at 192x192. Thermal increases 0.70% / 2.50%, below the 3% limit. All final states match official and no timed major faults occur. A separate 24-sample PMU diagnostic observes whole-process instructions -13.38% fluid / -12.36% mixed-germs, cycles -8.19% / -8.20%; physics instructions fall about 13.7-13.8%. Host load/frequency dispersion and fixture scope still apply. The new file now also passes a direct one-worker CPU16 comparison against official: 96 exact 96x96 samples, zero timed major faults, CPU medians -9.52% fluid, -22.19% thermal, -22.46% sealed, -8.65% germ-flow, -8.91% mixed-germs and -51.99% vacuum. The original fixed native CPU/RSS gates pass. This is not whole-game FPS or Unity memory evidence; the exact receipt is conformance/results/linux-744825-pressure-sweep-official.json. Fresh same-file one/four-worker scaling still fails at both sizes. All 156 final states match official, four worker names and positive scheduler runtime are observed, but CPU/elapsed regressions remain. A separate 36-sample hardware run observes only 0.80-2.14% extra retired instructions, with cycles +6.52-11.10%. Scheduling, frequency and cache effects are not separately attributed. The thread policy stays unchanged. See conformance/results/linux-744825-pressure-sweep-scaling.json. The isolated 5eb76a3 package has ZIP bd0b2823, managed d0437d55 and native 2772e526. A genuine Steam headless process loaded those exact bytes, the approved disposable save, Null graphics and zero camera callbacks. Normal bounded progress, save/load, clock rollback and post-reload progress passed; the original save is unchanged. All four owned game/runtime processes, the supervisor and controller exited normally. Actual worker-thread names were not captured, so complete headless acceptance is still not claimed. Graphical, whole-game CPU/RAM and four simultaneous-game acceptance remain pending. See conformance/results/linux-744825-pressure-sweep-{delivery,headless}.json. The first armed memory probe correctly refused at its freshness guard, but investigation found a tooling defect: automatic JSON date parsing followed by string conversion lost the UTC suffix and reparsed it in local time. The helper now retains raw ISO strings. Forty-three production-helper checks in UTC, Asia/Taipei and America/Los_Angeles plus 12 Python collector/mapping tests pass; the fixed probe compiles against the pinned installed game. Its next launch was refused by the unchanged 6 GiB single-game capacity gate. No Unity/Mono counter capture has passed. The failure and new build remain separate, with no lowered identity, freshness or capacity limits. See conformance/results/linux-744825-memory-probe-timezone.json. Previous 8bd development source The preceding development native was 8bd415cea1129c5b7a1e94b08dc269e829f00c815d8c38d06b733437f8c2e0e0. Twelve native source files and the expanded thermal case registration were integrated after checking the C301 source-archive ancestor and preserving unrelated source bytes. An independent canonical build produces the exact tested binary. All 41 release Rust tests and 49 game-free harness tests pass. The canonical harness matches the frozen expanded run byte-for-byte: both one and four workers pass 263 cases / 9571 publications, including 32 new thermal wire-word cases. The 12 memory-collector protocol/mapping tests are separate. The new cases exposed existing cell/backwall MINSS operand-order errors and a backwall MINSD cap/clamp order error. C301 and intermediate candidates failed; the corrected binary passes. A fresh one-worker direct official comparison passes all predeclared native CPU/RSS gates. CPU median reductions are 3.452% fluid, 20.683% thermal, 9.286% sealed, 1.356% germ-flow, 1.788% mixed-germs and 35.463% vacuum. These are authored 96x96 native fixtures, not whole-game FPS. Retained host-load/frequency dispersion limits conclusions about exact gain magnitude. Fresh full-frame scaling tests on four distinct physical cores do not pass the predeclared performance gates at either 96x96 (96 samples) or 192x192 (60 samples). All final states still match the official library. Four workers reduce some fluid/germ wall times, but increase CPU work and regress other scenes; see PARALLEL-VALIDATION.md. Parallel correctness and thread creation do not establish an overall performance win. The private active-disease dispatch experiment 7762e676… passes all 41 release tests and 263 cases / 9571 publications at both worker counts. It is not adopted: the 96x96 comparison reduces CPU use but regresses thermal wall time by about 18.8%, failing the original gate. The 192x192 run also fails: thermal wall time increases 9.2% and sealed wall time 12.5%. All 156 timed final states still match official; no timed major faults occurred. The experiment and rejection are in conformance/results/linux-744825-disease-active-dispatch.json. The canonical native remains 8bd415ce…. The follow-up checked-cleanup-slice experiment 6ad189b3… also remains rejected. It passes 42 release tests and both complete 263-case / 9571-publication runs, but its 156 full-frame timing samples still fail the original elapsed-time gates. See conformance/results/linux-744825-disease-cleanup-slices.json. The common dispatch-removal premise was then tested directly on production disease post-processing. Parallel clean-cell cleanup is faster than serial at both sizes, so uninfected regions cannot be treated as having no useful parallel work. The next optimization should reduce cleanup work while retaining useful parallelism. The rerunnable test and limitations are documented in conformance/DISEASE-DISPATCH-DIAGNOSTIC.md. Two further SSE2 cleanup proposals preserve the pool and exclusive row ownership. 368df124… and the exact all-clear/all-retained branch variant 9dbb9536… each pass 45 release tests and both 263-case / 9571-publication suites. Bounds, tails, all lane masks and float words are checked; the branch variant also checks three input classes in each of 512 MXCSR environments. Neither is adopted: the first fails both full-frame size gates; the branch variant passes 192x192 but fails the original 96x96 mixed-germ limits (CPU +4.37%, wall +3.83%). All 156 timed samples per variant are retained. Public proposals are archived; the branch proposal independently rebuilds to the exact tested native hash. A 24-sample CPU-core PMU diagnostic then counts actual warmed physics, pool and orchestration threads. In sealed fixtures, pool instructions fall 39.85%, but whole-process instructions fall only 1.11%; mixed-germ whole-process instructions fall 0.15%. The serial physics thread accounts for about 90-97% of retired instructions in these two scenes. Prioritize its hotspots for larger gains. Counters do not override failed elapsed-time gates or establish whole-game FPS. Receipts are conformance/results/linux-744825-disease-cleanup-{sse2,sse2-fastpaths,counters}.json. A fresh canonical 8bd415ce profile covers all six 96x96 scenes, five repeats per scene with four workers on CPU0/2/4/6. All 30 final states match official; 13,135 CPU-clock samples contain 12,402 native IPs with no loss/corruption. Pressure transfer takes 27.90-39.21% of native samples in the five nonthermal scenes. This supports examining repeated pressure-storage setup, not a claim of precise stall or actual-game attribution. Instrumented timings are excluded from performance acceptance. See conformance/results/linux-744825-canonical-frame-profile.json. A compact immutable element-property proposal 2390ab48… targets serial phase and pressure lookups. It keeps raw flow words, checked indices and the original records; a shared-only record wrapper prevents stale derived properties. Four new tests include the full u16 index domain, state/float words, cloning, replacement and invalid indices. All 45 release tests and both complete 263-case / 9571-publication comparisons pass. It is not adopted: 96x96 thermal CPU increases 7.45% and 192x192 vacuum increases 13.14%, failing the unchanged full-frame gates. All 156 exact samples and live-host dispersion are retained. The benchmark has six authored elements, not the full actual-game table. See conformance/results/linux-744825-element-fluid-properties.json and its public proposal. A separate 24-sample hardware diagnostic finds only 0.96% fluid and 1.05% mixed-germ whole-process instruction reductions (physics reductions 1.00% / 1.16%). The lookup removes little total work and is not the next large performance target. Counters do not override the failed timing gates. The canonical source remains unchanged. The dedicated OniSim CI now also runs the complete production native crate's Release unit tests without game files, alongside the emitter differential suite. This closes a coverage gap; official-library and actual-game runs remain local, separate acceptance levels. The source includes checked common-length pressure slices, integer SIMD index validation, phase-local contact reuse, conservative identity-copy elimination, and the consumed PreparedStep token. The contact-cache and PreparedStep Lean model sources are now under lean-lab with their source-identical prior checker receipts; neither model proves compiled Rust/libm or game compatibility. This identity has not yet passed actual-game headless or graphical acceptance; older runtime receipts below do not approve it. The distribution ZIP has not been promoted. Whole-game performance and four simultaneous complete games remain unverified. See conformance/results/linux-744825-thermal-minss.json and conformance/results/linux-744825-thermal-minss-official.json. Earlier accepted fixture binaries The Rust core builds and is integrated into CycleTrim's Linux package. The old 36-compiler-error snapshot is obsolete. The notification-dedup V2 source is now landed, with 31 passing release host tests. Its original isolated binary 4e677de1… passed ordered headless then graphical small-colony save/load, positive progression, full CPU/GPU texture comparisons and actual screenshot inspection. Both owned processes exited normally; the original save is unchanged. See the V2 runtime receipt. Release builds now explicitly disable host compiler wrappers. Fresh builds in two different source roots produce the same native SHA-256: c301cc3ead6bfe0edebf928b901f767c144a6dc143eb75cdf260ebff4288ba42. This identity has separate Steam headless and graphical acceptance for the small fixture: four actual cell workers, normal save/load with clock rollback, positive progression and full CPU/GPU texture comparisons before/after graphical reload. The actual screenshot was inspected and its dimensions matched the scaled physical window. All owned games exited normally. Exact package/source identities require their separate delivery-validation.json receipt. Whole-game performance remains unmeasured; historical results below retain their original binary scope. The earlier C301 official-versus-Rust suite passed 227 cases with one and four workers, comparing 9103 publications per run, including empty batches. This includes 224 positive contracts and three explicitly negative diagnostic cases. Data comparisons retain exact float bits, every public grid/flow/CPU texture field, all 29 ordered event lists, conduit outputs and current native save bytes. The candidate hash and harness hashes are recorded in the compact receipts. Coverage now includes building/chunk and mass/disease-component lifecycles, conduit heat exchange, radiation emitter modes, sunlight, active regions, authored native save versions 0 through 15, legacy thermal boundaries, overlapping loads, rectangular world initialization/freeing, sublimation, liquid offgas, partial melting and boiling, and session-reset/save roundtrips. Repeated EndSave calls match the original idempotent release. These comparisons exposed and fixed gas-swap direction timing, cooling-cell equilibrium, backwall transfer/sentinels, retained emitted-mass output, sublimation's flow field and capacity limit, partial-melt mass/heat/germ branches, and restoration of the cooled neighbour when a partial transition cannot displace its source. Conduit failures now reach the actual managed fatal callback rather than only the extension status. Invalid temperatures fail before mutation; continued execution after the original's fatal report is not claimed equivalent. The three formerly missing enum messages are absent from both dispatch registries in the pinned official library and are explicit compatible no-ops. Batched Load prevalidates all records and commits in order. Prepare retains a publication barrier per record and returns the final descriptor. Earlier Steam-launched headless runs loaded a disposable colony, created four Rust cell workers, advanced, saved, reloaded and advanced again. They apply only to the binary identities in RUNTIME-VALIDATION.md. The earlier component/phase fixes passed a Steam-launched headless smoke run: four workers, positive native progress before/after save and reload, equal reload clock/dupe count, zero cameras/crashes, and restored original files, mod settings and continue-save preference. The source save hash was unchanged. An earlier launch was refused while another OniOnline test was running; its process was untouched, and the successful run began only after the game was free. The previous export/readiness binary (b5b0bd4d860b9451399771e9a3b6ddf527b53b22119172b1ed15cb9e3457000f) has a Steam-launched headless receipt: an ordinary non-sandbox early colony (only OniMcp in its saved mod footprint) loaded with three duplicants, created four cell workers, advanced 4.484130859375 native seconds, saved/reloaded at the same clock, and advanced 2.71728515625 seconds after reload. The sampled cell matched at displayed precision; this is not whole-grid runtime equivalence. Original files/settings and the source hash were restored. Earlier larger normal-colony trials did not pass: one had severe paging/control timeout, another reported a missing construction-material element during restore. The same-save, same-managed-DLL Rust-off comparison reproduced the construction material assertion with the official library mapped and no Rust mapping. The save records 22 mods, while the isolated set has three; custom elements/prefabs are missing. Its content dependencies must be matched before it is a usable compatibility fixture. Original files/settings were restored; source saves were unchanged. The current 1f56c9b2 candidate now has separate Steam headless and graphical small-colony acceptance: four workers, save/reload clock equality, positive progress before/after reload, and five full native/Unity/GPU texture comparisons both before and after graphical reload. Both owned processes stopped and recorded files/settings restored. See the current runtime receipt. This does not extend acceptance to larger colonies or other mod combinations. The source archive keeps the canonical repository-relative project layout and original license/provenance files. Its separate clean-build receipt binds the exact archive hash to compilation of both the native core and managed mod. Compilation does not substitute for runtime acceptance. This remains experimental, not 100% compatibility. Uncovered interaction and payload variants, realistic multi-world/DLC saves, concurrent save/lifecycle stress, broader texture scenarios and long colony runs remain open. SIM_DebugCrash now matches the explicit SIGINT/assertion-report contract in isolated children; Linux SYSINFO returns null like the pinned original. No incoming call to the legacy three-argument gas-interaction helper was found in the pinned control flow; that does not establish every interaction's behavior. Keep gameReady=false and runtimeValidated=false. No whole-game FPS gain is established. The Lean-proved disease traversal and bounded persistent cell-worker pool are implemented; their separate evidence is in PARALLEL-VALIDATION.md and lean-lab/README.md. The conformance driver now fixes the actual empty/nonempty batch sequence before comparing data and verifies equal message counts. This exposed a polling race in the earlier driver around the fifteen-Step flow reset; failed traces remain. Readiness observation has a host test proving that it neither consumes a result nor releases a batch. All 62 catalogue message IDs are now exercised, with entry coverage kept separate from full behavior coverage. Previous accepted native SHA-256: 1f56c9b2f0dc47f0db3e24015e6d927492d61cf9c9ade4f17c6bcf3e6c897c33. The Linux system-info export now returns null as the original does. The intentional DebugCrash export reproduces SIGINT followed by the pinned fatal assertion if a handler returns. Both failed against the previous binary and passed after the change. These are not colony success claims. The prior null-backwall binary (d45cb10e) has generated-world graphical and headless save/reload receipts; these do not approve later binaries; the current 1f56c9b2 small-colony acceptance is recorded separately. See the top of RUNTIME-VALIDATION.md before interpreting its historical runs. Worker lifecycle tests additionally cover full-queue rejection before command capture, retained frame ordering, shutdown with an outstanding publication, runner failure wakeup, abandoned leases and capture panic containment. Sixteen fresh worker lifecycles process 30,720 queued frames in exact submission order. These host tests do not replace concurrent actual-game save/lifecycle stress. The allocation-only differential fixture additionally controls its realtime seed. Both original time() and Rust SystemTime consume the same fixed instant in isolated fixture children; monotonic deadlines keep running. Without this control, even the same official binary differed between separate runs. The driver rejects missing libraries before starting children or writing cases. Nine game-free driver tests cover these controls, probe build identity, full-buffer observation validation, field presence and input identity changes. The clock shim is never loaded into the actual game or included as a production native library. A native survival-world generation trial exposed rejection of the legitimate 0xffff absent-backwall marker. The original setter retains it, the managed BackwallIndexer returns null, and native serialization writes Vacuum/zero for it. The port now retains this marker through commands/publication, accepts it in backwall preflight, and avoids material lookup for an absent wall. Three new reference fixtures cover clear/restore, repeated null writes and save/reload (including stale mass/temperature at zero elapsed time). All failed against the previous Rust binary and pass after the fix. The d45cb10e candidate generated a native survival world with three duplicants and passed one full-buffer CPU/Unity/GPU comparison for all five property textures. A separate headless run loaded a copy, advanced 4.849925994873047 native seconds, saved/reloaded at identical clock 55.466583251953125 with three duplicants, and advanced another 2.883289337158203 seconds. An initial invalid sample was retained as a failed check; a second intentional reload verified a valid observed cell at displayed precision. The owned game was stopped to release memory and all recorded test settings were restored. Eight asymmetric thermal fixtures cover insulation bytes 0, 127, 254 and 255, opposite temperature gradients, unequal heat capacities and surface areas, and save/reload. All pass with one and four workers. The comparison driver now rejects extra as well as missing array/event fields, distinguishes absent fields from explicit nulls, and refuses to issue a summary if a harness or native library changes during the run. A replacement run removes its previous summary before starting children, so a failed run cannot retain an earlier green receipt. Nine topology/lifecycle fixtures cover overlapping regions on odd-sized grids, reversed region order, two-world rectangle release/reinitialization and eight successive native save/reload cycles. The last fixture exposed a liquid convection rounding bug: a weighted f32 temperature can round below the cold endpoint, where the port incorrectly selected the hot endpoint. The corrected clamp retains the cold endpoint, matching ELF 0x6fe48..0x6fe51. A two-water-cell fixture fails against d45cb10e and passes against 82460a88, as does the repeated save/reload fixture; exact comparisons and failed traces are retained. That intermediate hash has no game acceptance. The later 1f56c9b2 build retains the fix and has separate headless/graphical small-colony acceptance. Complete native frame bottlenecks and rejected performance candidates are now recorded in PERFORMANCE.md. The reusable frame benchmark compares three scenes with alternating samples and exact official publications; the SSE numeric helper is now adopted in source after 25 release tests and one/four-worker differential runs. Fixed-performance-core frame timing improved by roughly 2.6–7.8% across the three fixtures. No whole-game FPS gain is claimed. The native crate and Lean validation harness now use Rust 1.99.1 / Edition 2024, resolver 3 and explicit unsafe operations. Both dependency resolutions are at the latest Rust-1.99-compatible releases (zero packages changed). Native release tests pass 28 cases; serial/four-worker component checks each pass 65042 cases. See conformance/results/linux-744825-rust2024.json for source/toolchain identities, feature checks, warning scope and upstream Clippy feedback. The compact Load plan uses 32 rather than 56 bytes per cell; six alternating Load-memory pairs reduce sampled extra RSS by roughly 10.3 MiB in the specified two-record fixture. No actual-game memory or current-build FPS gain is claimed. Current differential coverage additionally includes zero-capacity thermal endpoints, pressure boundaries and seeded mixed-pressure fixtures; all 224 cases were rerun after the final thermal source change and native rebuild. Nine mixed-state soak fixtures add 96 batches followed by four save/reload cycles per seed/material combination. Current one/four-worker full suites each pass 224 cases and 8440 publications. A prior serial child timeout is retained separately, with a passing isolated full-suite recheck; its cause is unproven. Three interleaved gas/liquid/solid/vacuum soak fixtures exposed a thermal f32 multiplication-order error: the original rounds the squared-insulation scale before multiplying conductivity. All three failed before correction and match exactly after correction, including four native save/reload cycles per scene. The fixed source passes 31 release tests and 227 cases / 9103 publications with one and four workers. See conformance/results/linux-744825-mixed-thermal-order.json. The new native identity is c301cc3e. Both two- and four-worker Steam headless instances passed normal save/load with positive progress before/after reload, clock rollback equality and final pause. Four actual cell threads were observed in the four-worker process. Both processes stopped normally. Graphical four-worker acceptance subsequently passed, with five complete CPU/GPU texture comparisons before and after reload and actual screenshot inspection. These runtime results alone do not approve a ZIP or source archive; check their separate delivery validation receipt. A private equal-temperature pressure proposal (f1736fbb, not adopted) passes 33 release tests, including 3,651,072 result-word/exception-flag comparisons in 32 MXCSR environments, and both one/four-worker suites (227 cases / 9103 publications each). It retains original arithmetic when strict bounds or the preexisting masked/sticky-inexact environment do not permit skipping it. Eight alternating native pairs per scene against c301cc3e measured germ-flow CPU median -4.81%, below the predeclared 5% target. Other scene CPU changes range from -2.21% to +2.79%; peak RSS changes are within 0.20%. All 96 sample finals match official output. CPU frequency endpoints vary 1.40–2.33 GHz and memory-pressure some/avg10 varies 0.19–9.46%; no stable whole-game speedup is established. The gate remains failed and canonical native sources/packages are unchanged. See conformance/results/linux-744825-equal-temperature.json. A pressure-helper inline proposal (9a04afbd, not adopted) removes both disease helper calls from the compiled pressure kernel while retaining safe indexing and all arithmetic. It passes 31 release tests and the one/four-worker differential suites (227 cases / 9103 publications each). Its six-scene timing preflight was refused because another task started a real ONI instance; zero timing rows were accepted. The foreign process was left untouched. See conformance/results/linux-744825-pressure-inline.json. Own-process userspace CPU sampling is now available without installing perf or changing host permissions. Six native germ-flow profiles collected 4250 samples, 4025 in the native libraries, with no lost/corrupt records and exact official finals. Corrected ELF load-bias normalization was checked against actual exported Rust function pointers. Baseline update_pressure accounts for about 23% of native samples and its outer disease helper about 10%; inlining moves helper samples into its caller, so symbol percentages are not a speedup comparison. This is fixture diagnostics with sampling bias, not whole-game performance evidence. See conformance/results/linux-744825-pressure-sampling.json. Four new mixed-phase active-region soak fixtures pass 308 publications per selected run for both c301cc3e and the private 9a04afbd proposal with one/four workers. They exercise separated/overlapping active regions, forward/reversed region order across the 32-cell boundary and four save/reload rounds following 24 batches. This is a four-case supplement to the recorded 227-case suites; it does not claim a fresh complete 231-case suite or actual DLC-colony coverage. See conformance/results/linux-744825-multi-region-soak.json. The pressure-inline 9a04afbd native benchmark subsequently completed after the foreign game exited: 96 alternating samples, exact official finals. Relative to c301cc3e, CPU medians changed germ-flow -6.147%, mixed-germs -11.119%, fluid -7.089%, sealed -5.774%, vacuum -10.018%, thermal +3.155%. The thermal result exceeds the unchanged 3% other-scene limit, so the proposal remains unadopted. The separate private phase-barrier proposal skips only identity cell copies when gas/liquid phases reached no CellSOA-mutating path, retaining all flow/event work. Its abstract state-equivalence premise and eight Lean theorems are separate from actual Rust guard and runtime validation; acceptance is still pending. Phase-barrier V1 (098d360d) passes 31 release tests and fresh full expanded suites with one/four workers: 231 cases / 9411 publications per run. Its 96 native timing samples match official finals; all six CPU medians decrease, but germ-flow -4.9319% misses the fixed 5% target. Thermal is -6.4305%, fluid -3.7189%, sealed -3.9364%, mixed-germs -7.8161%, vacuum -10.1085%. Thus V1 remains unadopted. See conformance/results/linux-744825-phase-barriers-v1.json. V2 refines the conservative pressure marker to reduce bookkeeping and retains identical gates; its validation is separate and pending. Phase-barrier V2 (9cddf664) passes 31 release tests and complete 231-case / 9411-publication suites with one/four workers. Its 96 paired native samples vs c301cc3e show germ-flow CPU -6.6547%, mixed-germs -8.0404%, vacuum -10.3347%, fluid -3.1659%, sealed -3.3749%, thermal +1.0757%. The explicit thermal -5% target fails; source remains unadopted. A separate 96-sample direct official comparison is more relevant to replacement cost: vacuum CPU -37.6986%, sealed -1.8453%, mixed-germs +1.3204%, germ-flow +3.3282%, fluid +5.5145%, thermal +13.4461%. The unchanged maximum-3%-regression official gate fails. All sampled finals match official output, but there is no whole-game FPS/CPU/RAM claim. See conformance/results/linux-744825-phase-barriers-v2-official.json. Three additional thermal CPU profiles collect 641 samples without lost/corrupt records and retain exact official finals. Native code contains 484 samples; update_temperature accounts for 34.09% of native samples. libm contains 19.50% of total samples. Sampled instruction locations also cluster after packed f64 division; software sampling cannot precisely attribute stall cycles to an opcode. Investigate heat exchange and repeated conductivity math before more copying micro-optimizations; actual-game CPU/RAM profiling remains required. See conformance/results/linux-744825-phase-barriers-v2-thermal-profile.json. A new phase-local single-contact cache (0631b3dd), separate from the two older rejected 32-entry caches, passes 34 release tests and complete 231-case / 9411-publication one/four-worker suites. Actual-helper tests compare 955776 result/flag/errno observations in 32 floating environments, including 387072 cache hits. The cache is <=32 stack bytes with no extra heap or World field. Five Lean bit/effect replay theorems pass under explicit libm/guard assumptions; they are not a compiled floating-point proof. The first NaN code-generation failure and unavailable-SAT proof attempt are retained separately. Native timing versus 9cddf664 reduces thermal CPU median 22.168%, but mixed-germs +3.526% and vacuum +3.882% fail the fixed 3% other-scene gate. Keep unadopted. A separate three-pair CPU16 hardware-counter diagnostic, with exact official finals and >=98% counter running/enabled, finds cold-scene retired-instruction changes within 0.07%; cycle changes are -0.94%..+2.48%. This does not replace or relax CPU-time acceptance, but contradicts substantial added cold-loop work. The initial generic PMU returned zero on this hybrid CPU's atom core and was correctly rejected; valid events are selected from the pinned CPU's sysfs PMU. See conformance/results/linux-744825-thermal-contact-one-entry.json. The frame engine already runs preflight before its fixed-tick loop, while each simulation_step::step repeats it. Investigate that duplicate work and its invariants before another cache/cold-loop tweak. Whole-game CPU/RAM, broader colony compatibility and four real overlapping instances remain outstanding. PreparedStep (7811921b) removes only the duplicate frame/first-substep preflight. Its private borrowed, consumed token prevents mutation between validation and execution; every subsequent mutated substep still validates anew. 37 release tests pass, including one-check count, later invalid-state rejection and invalid time rejection without advance. Reintroducing the duplicate fails the exact count test (observed2 expected1); correct sources were restored and all tests rerun. Three Lean theorems establish pure duplicate-check/time-guard/later-check preservation without any step-preserves-valid-state assumption. Both full 231-case /9411-publication one/four-worker suites pass. A separate short-frame workload uses 50 individually published0.2s frames per block, two warmup and six timed blocks. Bulk pilots were rejected because native async grouping returned30 of50 submitted frames; the corrected strict barrier protocol matches official finals. Eight alternating pairs per scene give thermal CPU -4.9443%, below the unchanged5% target; other scene medians remain within3% regression. The retained original long-frame workload also completes96 exact samples with no scene CPU median regression above3%. The proposal remains unadopted; those native results do not establish whole-game performance. See conformance/results/linux-744825-prepared-first-step.json. PreparedStep (7811921b) subsequently passed one actual Steam-launched headless three-duplicant save/load roundtrip. The actual managed DLL and mapped native library hashes matched the staged inputs. Three bounded steps advanced the native clock; reload restored the exact checkpoint clock and final pause. Five guarded speed-1 measurements completed after one warmup, with median 0.660 CPU seconds per native second, but 1,705–5,806 major faults per sample. There is no matched baseline or maximum-throughput/FPS result. The first measurement attempt failed because companion telemetry had not yet published MCP's paused state; its failure remains retained. The corrected collector waits for the same process, save, exact native clock and paused state. The observed owned-tree PSS plus SwapPSS peaked at 4,325,855 KiB across 123 valid samples. Swapping pages out does not reduce this footprint. The private capacity forecast was raised from 3 to 5 GiB per complete game, plus a 1 GiB host reserve. After a normal quit all five owned processes and the idle controller were reclaimed; the original save hash was unchanged. Graphical admission was refused before launch as available memory fell to about 2 GiB. Four simultaneous complete games and graphical acceptance remain unverified. See conformance/results/linux-744825-prepared-first-step-runtime.json. An isolated SIMD validation experiment retains every per-step check and error order, replacing only the element/backwall/disease slice predicates with integer SIMD and scalar tails. It uses no extra heap allocation. Rust 1.99.1 release builds pass 40 host tests, including exhaustive word/count boundaries and vector tails/unaligned slices, plus all 231 official-comparison cases with one and four workers. The first invocation accidentally selected the host's default Rust 1.99.0 from the repository root; its passing results remain separate. The explicit 1.99.1 rebuild has native SHA-256 268977a5b35f167a77c29ab5fca27b0356feaecacf00c4e167e64603de4374ba. The six-scene CPU16 eight-pair benchmark against 7811921b completed with all 96 final snapshots matching the official library and no timed major faults. CPU medians fell 5.518% fluid, 2.489% thermal, 7.091% sealed, 0.374% germ-flow, 3.041% mixed-germs and 1.021% vacuum. The predeclared incremental gates pass: one scene improves at least 5%, no scene regresses above 3%, and peak RSS does not increase above 3%. All rows, including a late host slowdown, are retained. This is relative to another experimental Rust variant; no source adoption, whole-game speedup or runtime acceptance is claimed for this new variant. See conformance/results/linux-744825-simd-validation.json. The separate direct official-library comparison also completed 96 exact final snapshots. CPU medians changed +3.235% fluid, -13.010% thermal, -7.404% sealed, +0.373% germ-flow, +1.217% mixed-germs and -36.861% vacuum. Fluid still exceeds the fixed 3% regression limit, so the combined proposal remains experimental. Improvement over another Rust variant must not be presented as superiority to the official implementation. See conformance/results/linux-744825-simd-validation-official.json. Direct userspace hardware-counter diagnostics for 268977a5 show fluid retired instructions +8.072% and cycles +3.273% versus the official library. Five candidate fluid profiles collect 2,871 total / 2,754 native samples without loss/corruption; gas::update_pressure accounts for 41.939% of native samples. The hottest sampled IP follows the weighted-temperature DIVSS. This is not precise stall attribution or whole-game evidence. See conformance/results/linux-744825-fluid-pressure-diagnostic.json. A masked-environment paired-division experiment retains the original scalar function body for unmasked callers. Its first intrinsic implementation produces equal result words but an extra invalid MXCSR flag in a boundary test; that failure and source are retained. Opaque DIVPS with neutral upper lanes passes 3,030,272 word/control-flag observations in 32 environments, all 41 release host tests, and both 231-case official comparison suites. Nevertheless, eight-pair CPU16 measurements regress fluid +1.817%, germ-flow +9.563% and mixed-germs +9.752%. The proposal is rejected, not adopted. All 96 exact snapshots and noisy host intervals are retained. See conformance/results/linux-744825-pressure-packed-divisions.json. The separate, opt-in MemoryProbe now compiles against the pinned installed game. It reads Unity allocation/reservation, Mono heap/used bytes, managed-reported bytes, runtime-specific GC generation counts and Linux PSS/swap counters without requesting GC or asset unloading. Its collector binds the loaded DLL, request, native process incarnation, run nonce, paused save and actual native clock. Five collector protocol tests and 13 existing instance-helper tests pass; these do not exercise Unity/Mono. A four-profile group with probe 6517b5f5 and native 268977a5 is prepared at /tmp/ct-mem-268v2, with zero games started. The preparation helper defaults to a 5 GiB per-game forecast plus 1 GiB reserve. The last host snapshot remains below the resulting 6 GiB single-game budget. Repeated-load and official-library memory attribution, graphical acceptance and four simultaneous complete games remain open. See conformance/memory_probe/README.md and conformance/results/linux-744825-memory-probe-preparation.json.

title: OniSim Vulkan compute operators
body: 整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 OniSim Vulkan compute operators This crate started as a local operator test project and is now a dependency of the native core (native/Cargo.toml → onisim-gpu). It uses Rust 1.99.1, wgpu 30.0.1, hand-written WGSL and the Vulkan backend. OpenCL, CUDA, OpenGL and software fallback adapters are not used. The shader and resource layout are vendor-independent; actual AMD hardware acceptance is still required. The crate-level doc comment in src/lib.rs still says the operators are "deliberately not enabled in the game"; that sentence predates the production wiring described below. Production wiring (2026-11-08) native/src/frames_engine.rs creates a GpuSimulation (native/src/gpu_sim.rs) at startup unless CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_GPU=0. Initialization failure is logged as [CycleTrim OniSim] GPU initialization failed: … and the CPU path is used; success logs GPU acceleration active on Vulkan device: …. CYCLETRIM_GPU_PROFILE (or the Steam launch argument --cycletrim-gpu-profile) enables sampled per-operator timing. Operator Module Status Thermal diffusion (variable-coefficient FV), resident temperatures, compressed mixture-presence upload thermal_diffusion.rs, thermal_enthalpy.rs committed, in tick Gas multicomponent diffusion, density-gradient velocity, pressure projection, transport multicomponent.rs, pressure_projection.rs, material_eos.rs committed, in tick for eligible regions Sparse liquid multicomponent diffusion (overlapped with CPU gas pressure) multicomponent.rs committed, in tick for eligible regions Bubble / droplet movement bubble_settling.rs working tree only Phase-transition selection (event application stays ordered on CPU) phase_transition.rs working tree only Gas pressure faces + liquid hydraulic head / liquid flow gas_pressure_faces.rs, liquid_head.wgsl working tree only Disease diffusion and growth disease_diffusion.rs, disease_growth.rs working tree only Radiation regions radiation_region.rs working tree only Inactive-cell mass decay inactive_decay.rs working tree only Shared resident SoA buffers for operator chaining resident_cells.rs working tree only, not yet consumed "Working tree only" means uncommitted at the time of writing: the native crate passes cargo check --release, but there is no matching Player.log run, differential fixture or FPS measurement for these passes. Every tick still uploads inputs, waits on the device and reads results back; event application, building interaction and publication remain on the CPU. The last recorded game log (2026-11-08 00:26) shows GPU acceleration active on an RTX 4060 Laptop and predates the later commits. The sections below are the original isolated-operator records and remain valid as historical measurements. Flow presentation operator (historical) The first operator computes the flow presentation image from padded CellSOA arrays. Each invocation reads one cell and writes one independent output. This does not move the ordered fluid/thermal solver to the GPU. CPU buffers retained by the managed game remain CPU addresses, not Vulkan texture handles. Run only the targeted checks From this directory: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --release --lib cpu::tests rtk proxy cargo run --locked --release --bin flow-bench -- /tmp/flow-unique-report.json nvidia # On an AMD host with a working Vulkan driver, select its real adapter name: rtk proxy cargo run --locked --release --bin flow-bench -- /tmp/flow-amd-unique-report.json radeon Reports must use a new path: previous observations are never overwritten. Exit code 0 means all admission gates passed, 2 means the measured candidate failed correctness or speed gates, and 1 means the experiment could not complete. A missing adapter is an error, not a skipped passing GPU test. To check the helper through its native production compilation, from ../native: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --release presentation::flow::tests -- --nocapture These commands do not run the full native suite, official-library conformance, package builds, game launches or deployments. Measurement contract Original CPU arithmetic/indexing versus the row-sliced production CPU helper versus a GPU candidate. Inputs use deterministic seeds and the real padded layout. Element u16 arrays upload directly, including odd-length tail handling. Seven shapes: 1x1, 3x5, 17x19, 96x96, 256x384, 512x512, 1024x1024. Three seeds per shape, repeated writes, transition masks, partial workgroups, wrong-sized output rejection, and a separate IEEE edge-value case. Five warmups followed by 31 quartets with rotating CPU/GPU sample order. CPU timing repeats small cases to amortize timer overhead and retains black-box output observations. Individual samples, median, p95 and range are reported. GPU timing includes all current-state uploads, dispatch, output copy, bounded synchronization, map/readback and the copy into existing CPU output. Context/pipeline/buffer creation and fixture allocation are outside timing on all sides. GPU buffers and bindings are reused between samples. Admission requires zero differing float words and at least 1.10x speedup over the row CPU helper for a shape. The aggregate flag deliberately requires every tested shape and edge case to pass. No automatic GPU-selection policy is implemented or inferred from this experiment. NaN payload differences count as bit failures. semantic_mismatches excludes pairs where both values are NaN; signed-zero differences remain failures. Non-finite errors are counted separately instead of serializing infinity as JSON null. No tolerance is widened to make a failing shader pass. First observation and next boundary On the local RTX 4060 Laptop, the first flow GPU candidate failed both exact float-word comparison and end-to-end speed gates. On 256x384 and larger grids, the row CPU helper was about 2.1x faster than the original CPU indexing, while the GPU roundtrip was about 12.5x slower than that helper. A follow-up run showed 1.8-2.1x CPU speedup and 10.6-16.3x GPU slowdown at those sizes. This measures only this flow image pass, not simulation frames or game FPS. Host/GPU contention must be recorded with each run; these numbers are not a hardware-wide ranking. Only the CPU helper is connected to PresentationBuffers::update. At the time of this measurement the Vulkan project had no dependency edge from the native core; that changed with the production wiring above, but the flow presentation shader itself is still not used by the game. Its failed shader remains an explicit experimental candidate. The CPU helper still needs full conformance and real-game acceptance before release. Further GPU work needs a more compute-heavy stage or multiple dependent stages resident on the GPU, with deterministic arithmetic and controlled synchronization. The fluid/pressure sweeps mutate neighboring cells in a defined order; replacing them with an unordered GPU stencil would change the simulation. DLSS/FSR are a separate rendering integration. The observed Linux game uses OpenGL, while NVIDIA's DLSS SDK requires a supported DirectX/Vulkan rendering integration and the appropriate frame inputs. This project adds no DLSS/FSR switch and claims no upscaling support. Follow-up operator revision The current shader uses 32x8 two-dimensional workgroups, removing per-cell division/modulo from padded-grid addressing. A bounded integer long division computes the reciprocal with round-to-nearest-even instead of Vulkan FDiv's permitted approximation. The normal-data corpus and a 257x257 stress fixture covering reciprocal exponents 127..252 now compare bit-exactly against CPU. The existing special-value gate still fails; no GPU production dependency was added and the original speed/exactness gates remain unchanged. upload and run_resident separate snapshot upload from dispatch. Resident use before upload, and after a rejected upload, is refused. The benchmark now runs 31 rotating quartets (original CPU, row CPU, complete GPU roundtrip, and a resident-input diagnostic which still includes dispatch/sync/readback). The resident diagnostic reuses one immutable snapshot, so it cannot be reported as an end-to-end simulation speedup. Even excluding uploads, the measured resident path is slower than CPU at the tested colony-sized grids. An external Linux FSR1 launch profile is documented separately in docs/cycletrim-fsr-linux.md. That profile does not enable this experimental simulation GPU backend. References: wgpu 30.0.1, NVIDIA DLSS programming guide, AMD FSR1 input model. Multi-component finite-volume operator — Stage 1 The Stage 1 runner binds the isolated multi-component WGSL kernel to a real Vulkan compute pipeline. It uses compact NHWC mass storage and ping-pong device buffers. The benchmark reports two different costs: End-to-end one-step: five input uploads, one dispatch, bounded device synchronization, GPU-to-host readback and host copy. Resident 32-step batch: one initial upload, 32 dependent dispatches using device-local ping-pong buffers, one final synchronization/readback. The per-step figure is the batch total divided by 32; it is not a pure kernel time. Run on a machine with Rust 1.99.1 and a hardware Vulkan adapter: rtk proxy cargo run --locked --release --bin multicomponent-bench The executable selects the first discrete or integrated Vulkan GPU. It runs 96x96x4 and 256x384x4 fixtures, performs five warmups and 31 timing samples, and emits JSON containing adapter identity, CPU timing, end-to-end timing, resident batch timing, per-cell CPU/GPU error, per-species mass drift, non-negativity and solid-cell checks. It exits nonzero if the per-cell relative error exceeds 1e-5 or either physical invariant fails. No software Vulkan fallback is accepted. The kernel advances each component with a paired-face first-order upwind flux. Each invocation owns one output cell; neighboring invocations evaluate a shared face from identical inputs. The runner alternates two storage buffers for multi-step batches. The CPU reference uses the same face velocities, donor selection, boundary closure and solid mask. Stage 1 scope: transport operator only. Pressure projection, EOS-derived buoyancy, phase change, thermal transport, C# integration and production selection remain outside this benchmark. The current execution workspace has no Rust toolchain and no Vulkan hardware adapter, so it cannot produce a hardware measurement. The benchmark must be run on the target GPU before any latency or speedup result is recorded. A missing adapter is an explicit failure, never a skipped/passing test. The OniSim diamond workflow now has a dedicated gpu-operator job. It validates WGSL with Naga, runs CPU conservation/wall tests, and compiles all benchmark targets without requiring a GPU. Real Vulkan timing remains a hardware-only run.

title: CycleTrim
body:
整合《缺氧》模组开发、构建发布与 MCP 游戏观察和操作。 CycleTrim CycleTrim 前置 Mod： 先安装并启用 Jlib 0.3.10 或更新的兼容版本，再重启游戏。CycleTrim 自 0.4.10 起使用新的批量读取接口，启动器会在加载实现前检查依赖版本。消费者包不再内嵌一份 Jlib。 实验性仿真与性能 Mod。目标是重构底层算法，按实测耗时选择 CPU/GPU，并减少重复计算与同步等待。每次改动分别验证数据正确性、兼容性和性能。只在可丢弃的测试存档副本上使用。 本文介绍 CycleTrim 0.4.25 的功能与改进。使用时需要 Jlib 0.3.10。当前改动重点是跳过必然失败的 CPU 热传导全网格预扫、移除未用 GPU 初始化，以及完整保存多组分库存、明确派生数据可用性。OniSim 在原生时间步内结合 CPU 算子与 GPU 批处理；旧 Grid 仍显示主要元素，完整组分通过发布接口读取。详见实现说明、下文的验证范围与更新记录。 下面列出的热路径裁剪已进入源码；原版语义对照与整机收益按具体构建和场景分别验收。 本模组来自 OniMods。onim 是这个仓库里的工具，把缺氧 Mod 的开发、测试和创意工坊发布连成一条直线：onim dev 放进游戏里试，onim build 打包，onim publish 发到 Steam。 快速索引（本页为总览） 全游戏更新链路与诊断（0.4.12） 历史整链实验与验收边界（0.4.12） 多组分路线设计（历史） GPU 进度（2026-11-08） 多组分假设审计 算法演进与数学模型 (Stage 2/2.1) 核心优化 架构与优化原理 安装与运行 验证与兼容性 性能实测摘要 详细说明与日志 全游戏更新链路与诊断（0.4.12） 一次游戏更新包含原生仿真、结果发布、建筑和对象状态机、寻路队列、属性纹理、动画以及 UI、相机和声音。GPU 内核变快之后，主线程仍可能在这些交接处计算或等待。0.4.12 把诊断扩展到 22 个阶段，并测量相邻 Game.Update 入口之间的完整间隔；独立 Unity 回调也在审查范围内。调用链与源码依据 在 Steam 启动参数中加入 --cycletrim-perf-probe，即可同时开启托管阶段与原生批次诊断。Player.log 中的 [CycleTrim][FrameChain] JSON 记录完整区间、中位数、P95/P99、各阶段包含子调用的耗时和扣除子调用的自身耗时，以及尚未归因的时间。日志解析命令： python3 scripts/analyze_cycletrim_frame_chain.py /absolute/path/Player.log --output frame-chain.json 父阶段和子阶段的耗时不能直接相加；PrepareGameData 和 JobManager.Run 都可能包含工作与等待，未归因时间也不能直接当作 GPU 时间。这里的更新入口频率不是显示器实际呈现的 FPS。诊断默认关闭，关闭时不安装专用计时补丁。指标定义与验证范围 本轮评估了交替空转发布复用、原生内容身份驱动的纹理上传复用，以及减少 worker 对象头复制的候选。四轮完整原生对照均未通过既定性能门槛；四轮上传消融中只有第二轮通过，不能与其他版本拼接验收。因此 0.4.12 撤回本轮性能候选，保留 0.4.11 原有生产优化、22 阶段诊断与手动整链路测试。完整报告保留每轮失败、全部场景和尾部耗时；本轮没有取得整局帧率提升或新的 ONI、硬件 GPU 验收。完整实验记录与交付范围 算法演进：从一格一物排挤到 GPU 泊松压力投影 (Stage 2/2.1) 作为 CycleTrim 底层物理重构的核心方向，模拟管线正在从原版的离散状态排挤演进为GPU 驻留连续流体泊松投影。 1. 原版旧算法（串行网格遍历 + 排挤分支） 串行供受体质量迁移（受 ElementRecord.flow 控制）： $$\Delta m = 	ext{clamp}\left(k \cdot (m_a - m_b), , -0.125 \cdot m_b, , 0.125 \cdot m_aight)$$ 排挤仲裁（Displacement）：当新物质试图进入已被占据的格子时，执行 displace_gas / liquid_displacement，沿邻格进行深度与空间分支搜索。 伴随状态维护：单次迁移量硬截断在供体质量的 $12.5%$，同步搬运离散温度与病菌计数，改变目标格材料身份并处理 Vacuum / Sink。 硬件局限：严苛的时序依赖和分支跳转导致现代 CPU 宽向量指令（AVX）难以对齐，并在 GPU 上引发严重的线程束分化（Warp Divergence）与缓存颠簸。 2. 新版 GPU 连续流体泊松投影算法（Stage 2/2.1 WGSL 内核） 新算法基于变密度有限体积连续流体模型，并实现为全流程 GPU 驻留算子： 步骤 1：多组分守恒界面通量输运（Multicomponent Transport Kernel） $$M_c(t + \Delta t) = M_c(t) - \Delta t \cdot 
abla \cdot F_c$$ 每个格子执行完全相同的向量乘加（MAC），彻底消除排挤搜索与抢占仲裁。 步骤 2：有限体积中间速度场散度（Divergence Kernel） $$
abla \cdot u^* =  rac{u(y, x+1) - u(y, x)}{\Delta x} +  rac{v(y+1, x) - v(y, x)}{\Delta y}, \quad 	ext{RHS} =  rac{
abla \cdot u^*}{\Delta t}$$ 步骤 3：变密度泊松方程与红黑高斯-赛德尔求解（RBGS Pressure Kernel） $$
abla \cdot \left( eta 
abla pight) =  rac{
abla \cdot u^*}{\Delta t}, \quad 	ext{其中界面渗透率 }  eta_f =  rac{1}{ho_f} =  rac{2}{ho_1 + ho_2}$$ 使用带松弛因子的红黑棋盘格（Red-Black Gauss-Seidel with SOR）多 Pass 并行迭代： $$p_i^{(k+1)} = p_i^{(k)} + \omega \left(  rac{\sum_{j \in \mathcal{N}(i)}  eta_{ij} p_j - 	ext{RHS}i}{\sum{j \in \mathcal{N}(i)}  eta_{ij}} - p_i^{(k)} ight)$$ 分为 Red Pass $((x+y)  mod 2 = 0)$ 与 Black Pass $((x+y)  mod 2 = 1)$ 分步调度，管线屏障保证内存可见性。 步骤 4：无散速度场投影修正（Velocity Projection Kernel） $$u_f^{n+1} = u_f^* - \Delta t \cdot  eta_u \cdot  rac{p_{right} - p_{left}}{\Delta x}$$ $$v_f^{n+1} = v_f^* - \Delta t \cdot  eta_v \cdot  rac{p_{bottom} - p_{top}}{\Delta y}$$ 边界条件：固体壁面与封闭外边界严格强制法向速度 $u_n = 0$，Neumann 齐次边界 $ rac{\partial p}{\partial n} = 0 \iff  eta = 0$。 3. GPU 闭环流水线愿景 $$ oxed{ 	ext{Transport} \longrightarrow 	ext{Divergence} \longrightarrow 	ext{Poisson} \longrightarrow 	ext{Projection} \longrightarrow 	ext{Transport} }$$ 目标是让完整物理循环驻留显存，CPU 处理状态快照、接口与上层游戏发布；当前实际执行边界见下节，尚未实现这一整环驻留目标。 阶段说明：Stage 2 的 CPU 数值参考（残差 $10^{-7}$、散度收敛、零速度不动点等 6 项测试）与 Stage 2.1 的 WGSL 核心算子（7 项 GPU Operator 测试及 Benchmark）均已就绪。这些压力投影算子保留为独立实验与参考。0.4.15 的生产气体路径使用密度驱动的有界传输和热计算，已移除不可压缩投影及中间速度回读。 GPU 进度（2026-11-08） 此节保留 11-08/09 的管线记录；当前保存、数据可用性与算法状态见后文的原生内核检查点及 0.4.25 性能段。 OniSim 启动时用 wgpu 30（Vulkan 后端）创建 GpuSimulation，默认开启；CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_GPU=0 可在启动前关闭，初始化失败时打印原因并回到 CPU 路径。CYCLETRIM_GPU_PROFILE=1 或 Steam 启动参数 --cycletrim-gpu-profile 打开抽样耗时日志。 已提交（main）并接入时间步： 全图 GPU 热扩散（变系数有限体积）与组分显热焓换算；温度在步间驻留显存，组分存在掩码压缩上传，按变化块上传。 符合条件的气体区域：多组分浓度扩散、密度梯度速度、有界传输与热计算在一次 GPU 提交内接力。 符合条件的液体区域：GPU 多组分稀疏扩散，与 CPU 气压遍历重叠执行；扩散快照只覆盖活动区域。 CPU 侧：区域资格扫描和打包、相变结果应用、事件与建筑组件仍需处理；没有 GPU 或区域不符合条件时，相关阶段执行 CPU 路径。空闲零时长帧可复用已经生成的发布结果。 2026-11-09 整链源码审查： 气泡、温度、相变选择、符合条件的气体压力/传输、疾病与辐射存在 GPU 调用路径；上传、等待、读回及 CPU 应用仍穿插在固定步内。液体多组分扩散有 GPU 路径，但生产 gpu_liquid_flow 固定为 false，液体压力、流动和有序排挤仍由 CPU 执行。仓库中存在液体流动等 WGSL 算子和 resident_cells 缓冲，不代表整条路径已经接管生产更新。0.4.15 已移除生产气体压力投影，并将环境辐射改为 CPU 直接遍历；上述记录保留其历史时点。逐阶段依据见原生固定步审查。 历史检查点的未完成项： 11-08 时每步仍有 CPU 上传、GPU 等待与读回，事件、建筑交互和发布留在 CPU；当时的压力、额外组分与保存贯通状态见原记录。此后已增加完整库存保存、22 组分 host/FFI 回归和六个自然混合格的实机重载验证；最新压力与液体占格状态见下方 U60 段。原 11-08 日志中的 RTX 4060 激活记录属于当时构建。细节见 OniSim/gpu/README.md 与 OniSim/docs/progress.md。 核心功能（简要） 优化拾取候选的成本复用逻辑。 仅对忙碌复制人的高开销任务进行间歇刷新，空闲复制人不受影响。 节流静止小动物的重复导航探测。 存档时复用组件类型的固定标记和名称，减少重复反射查询。 电力视图每次刷新时复用同一电路的需求功率查询。 输送轨道构建中，重复搜索较多的长路径可使用临时索引。 动画覆盖数据逐位相同时，避免重复增加版本号和复制纹理数据。 可选降低气液管道显示网格的重建频率；模拟更新、每帧绘制和音效保留原路径。 大地图远景缩放时按缩放级别对静止物体动画、材料视图与管道视图更新分帧降频（复制人保留更高刷新率）；纹理插值与延时摄影相机优化由 Jlib 提供。 强制关闭 VSync 并解除帧率上限；被其他代码恢复时重新应用并记录一次日志。 使用方式 订阅后按常规启用即可。 先复制存档，只在测试副本启用；原存档继续单独保留。 模组设置 在游戏的模组 → CycleTrim → 设置中调整。设置界面由独立 Jlib 提供；更改后按提示重启游戏。 OniSim 仿真核心：启动时先校验游戏版本与原生接口，通过后映射 Rust SimDLL；未验证版本保留原版仿真及兼容的托管优化。启动前关闭可用 CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_ENABLE=0。 物流候选、忙碌复制人刷新、静止小动物寻路、异步寻路去重、小动物思考刷新：五项优化可分别关闭，便于排查其他模组的兼容问题；默认保持开启。关闭某项后不安装该组优化补丁。 性能诊断日志：默认关闭。开启后把耗时和内存统计写入 Player.log，统计本身有额外开销。 存档类型信息缓存：默认开启，减少存档时重复反射，并在同一次存档内复用相邻的类型查询；可单独关闭，修改后需要重启。 电力视图查询复用：默认关闭，可选开启。它只在本次视图更新内复用；电路重复少时可能增加开销，未知电力组件或冲突补丁保留原查询。修改后需要重启。 输送轨道路径查找：默认关闭。在一次路径构建内，扫描量足够大时才建立索引；短路径、早期命中和少量查询保留直接搜索。路径被修改时重新搜索，修改设置后需要重启。 动画重复更新优化：默认关闭。按浮点位模式比较覆盖数据，完全相同时保留版本号，让显示端复用已经复制的数据；发生过写入异常的实例继续保留原更新行为。修改设置后需要重启。 状态机查询复用：默认关闭。列表未变化时复用状态机查找结果；列表变更后重新查找，短列表和工作线程保留原路径。修改后需要重启。 管道动画刷新：默认 Full。Half / Quarter 在输入稳定时每 2 / 4 个渲染帧重建显示网格，中间帧继续绘制；模拟、视野、高亮等变化立即刷新，达到 100 毫秒时在下次绘制刷新。内容覆盖层及音效请求保留完整更新。修改后需要重启；FastTrack 或不兼容渲染补丁存在时让出这组优化。小工作量可能因缓存检查而变慢，详见实现、完整测量与验收范围。 这些优化来自对 oni-moono 机制的研究，使用独立实现。存档与电力视图的验证见首轮说明，轨道查找与动画更新的设计、测试及收益范围见后续优化报告。各项合成基准分别度量具体工作量；实机性能需用同一存档和设置交替测量。 短轨道、提前返回和动画比较等退化路径的后续改进，见开销回收与复测报告。其中保留了旧版与新版的交错样本，以及未采纳方案的记录。 如果列表里只有旧的 CycleTrimHarness 测试副本，需退出游戏后更新 CycleTrim 并启用 Jlib，并确认只启用一份相同 staticID 的安装。源码中存在设置页，不代表当前游戏加载的旧 DLL 也有这个入口。 兼容与说明 OniSim 的主线、DLC 和其他 Mod 完整兼容性仍待验收；已验证的构建与场景见下文。 兼容性与数据正确性按构建、玩法和场景分别记录。 CycleTrim 不再接管 SmartReservoir 的 automation 信号发送；储液罐/气库及复用该组件的第三方建筑保留原版重复通知语义。 OniSim 原生仿真内核 OniSim 是 CycleTrim 的原生仿真核心，源码位于 OniSim/。Windows x64、macOS x64、Linux x64 构建默认把本机原生库打入 Mod 包，启动时通过版本与接口校验后才映射接管官方 SimDLL。映射被拒绝或在启动前禁用时，不启用依赖该原生后端的多组分适配层，兼容的托管优化继续工作。已经建立的映射无法热撤销。CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_ENABLE=0、false 或 off 仍可作为启动前的紧急关闭开关。 疾病发射范围使用 Lean 证明的逐行菱形扫描，发射范围与疾病生长后处理已接入最多 8 线程的常驻线程池；小任务保留串行。未设置时默认 CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_WORKERS=8，启动前设置 CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_WORKERS=1 可关闭内核并行。GPU 算子相关开关见上文 GPU 进度。源码内的验收记录见 OniSim/docs/parallel-validation.md。 运行回执只适用于其精确源码、二进制和场景，见 OniSim/docs/runtime-validation.md。Linux x64 接受经过检查的 744825、763796 两组 Assembly-CSharp、Mono 与官方 Sim 指纹，并校验完整原生接口与消息布局；未知版本或混用运行时会拒绝映射。Windows/macOS 仍限 744825，没有 U60 实机验收。仅用于可丢弃的测试存档；完整原版对照、长时运行、DLC 和其他 Mod 兼容性仍未通过。 U60 / 763796 开发构建检查点（2026-11-20）：Linux x64 的精确运行时组合已通过严格 profile 检查与实际 Unity Mono ABI 核对。源码 8db265410028785b1cc89a94ab90e52662a3247b 经 Steam 正常图形启动，在三复制人存档副本中自然形成 6 个氧气/二氧化碳混合格；新建检查点、同进程重载后，完整组分的质量、温度及总质量 binary32 位一致，并能继续推进。方法、文件身份和结果见实机回执。 混合存档需要新读者。 没有任何正质量的第二或后续组分时，仍写出原 SIMSAVE v15；混合世界使用专用版本 0x4f4d0001 和必需的 ONIMIX 扩展。受测的扩展前 OniSim 会拒绝该混合档，不能假定降级、卸载或切回原版后可继续读取。22 组分的精确往返已在 host/FFI 中验证，实机目前只覆盖每格两个正质量组分；格式和旧读者边界见存档契约。 当前派生字段状态（Jlib 0.3.10）： 压力和分压明确报告不可用，旧截图中的零占位不再作为当前读数。液体占格份额按求解器标称容量计算，并单独提供可用性标记。后续 U60 实机读取已观察到气体格 pressureAvailable=false、liquidVolumeFractionAvailable=true 和已知液体占格值 0；正液体填充场景仍待实机验收。六混合格存读档回执属于前述 8db2654 检查点，新的派生字段检查单独记录。最初启动拒绝记录保留为此前检查点。 Windows x64、macOS x64、Linux x64 下构建默认包含 OniSim；可用 IncludeOniSim=false 生成不带核心的包。运行时默认尝试经过校验的映射；CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_ENABLE=0 可在启动前关闭原生替换。CYCLETRIM_ONISIM_NATIVE_PATH 可用绝对路径覆盖包内原生库；未设置时使用 Mod 目录下 OniSim/<platform>/ 中的 .dll、.dylib 或 .so。macOS 需要 x64 游戏进程（Apple Silicon 上使用 Rosetta）。三平台 CI 构建与宿主加载器测试不等于全平台 ONI 实机验收。 性能实测摘要 0.4.25：先减少确定无效的工作 本轮算法与资源清理提交包含两项具体改动： 热传导资格预判。 原 CPU 快捷路径需要先扫完整网格，数出合格格子后再判断是否达到原阈值 floor(padded_cells / 2)。现在先把现有热区域裁剪后的矩形面积相加，得到合格格子数的保守上界。即使这个上界也不足，就直接跳过必然失败的 CPU 预扫，继续原有 GPU 热路径。重叠区域只会把上界估大；原资格条件、GPU 区域图和求解算术保持原有规则。对应实现见区域上界判断。 删除未用 GPU 初始化。 模拟 worker 不再创建未被使用的 ResidentCells 缓冲及三个寻路管线。225,828 个含边界填充格子的场景因此少请求 225828 × 20 × 4 = 18,066,240 字节，即 17.229 MiB 的 GPU 缓冲。这里统计的是取消的分配请求量；显卡驱动的实际驻留量另行测量。独立公开寻路接口继续保留。 四个新增区域/暂存状态回归、既有 CPU/GPU 热传导等价用例均通过，Linux 原生 Release 构建通过。通过这些门禁后，下一步是在同一存档、设置及硬件图形后端下测量完整更新链路。 整机帧率结论须来自相同硬件、渲染器、存档和设置的对照。 早期 GL 功能检查使用 llvmpipe 软件渲染；后续 f0819fa 构建已通过 Steam 启动并确认使用 Vulkan / RTX 4060，当次未加载测试存档，不能据此推断游戏帧率收益。图形环境回执只证明这一启动环境。源码 3a6a600 的三平台 CI已通过构建及静态门禁；正式 bundle 的 170 项源码身份和 ELF/PE/Mach-O 格式核验通过。三份构建回执均为 gameRuntimeTested=false，Windows/macOS 尚未实机验收。CPU/GPU 路径正确性和硬件加速收益分别记录。 旧版本局部场景记录 以下保留旧版固定场景增量记录；其适用范围为各自历史构建、硬件和存档。本轮 0.4.25 的验证范围与待测项目见上节： 场景 指标 优化前 -> 优化后 改善 忙碌复制人节流 FPS 中位数（CPU 热点场景） 70.6 → 85.1 +20.6% 忙碌复制人节流 Brain 总耗时 5.087s → 2.449s -51.9% 静止小动物导航节流 FPS 中位数 81.23 → 109.28 +34.5% 静止小动物导航节流 Navigator 热点总耗时 826.852ms → 47.970ms -94.2% UpdatePickups 缓存 命中率中位数 24.37% 命中率 24.37% UpdatePickups 缓存 平均耗时 41.279us → 35.708us -13.5% UpdatePickups 缓存 每秒命中数（30s 窗口估算） ~6.29/次 命中有效复用 Brain 调度的函数级合成基准（已接入，仅普通 Creature） Brain 限流已接入生产 Harmony 补丁，但只作用于原版普通 CreatureBrainGroup。复制人（Dupe）、自定义 Brain 组继续走原版调度；priority Brain 保留原版队列选择和即时执行路径，不受普通 Creature 限额影响。 这是独立的合成函数基准，不是游戏内 FPS 测试，也不能直接换算为整局性能提升。 环境：独立 .NET 10 Release 基准，不启动 ONI。 场景：模拟 240 渲染 FPS、持续 30 秒，每次普通 Brain 调用执行 512 次确定性 CPU 工作。 方法：2 次预热，7 组 baseline/candidate 交替配对测量，取中位数；每组校验调用数与 checksum 一致。 调用口径：总调用从 43,200 降至 19,200（-55.56%）；其中普通 Creature 调用从 36,000 降至 12,000（-66.67%），Dupe 的 7,200 次调用保持原版。 代表性本机结果：耗时从 255.580ms 降至 113.289ms（-55.67%，2.26x）。 边界：不包含 priority 工作量、真实 Sensors/PathProber 成本或游戏内 Harmony 调度开销，不能代表实际 FPS。 安全差异：当前游戏 DLL 使用动态 i != brains.Count 边界。CycleTrim 同样每轮重读 Count，让帧内新增 Brain 可纳入扫描；但在 Update 中列表收缩到已扫描位置之后时会有界终止，避免原版条件可能无法收敛。 AsyncPathProber 去重与背压 仅支持精确的原版 CreaturePathFinderAbilities；Minion、Robot 与自定义 abilities 因动态权限/装备状态无法完整证明，全部回退原版。 缓存只在 Navigator.TakeResult 正常应用后成立；排队清空、注销、过期未应用及异常不会写入缓存。相同快照最多连续跳过 8 次，随后强制刷新。 0.3.3 修复工作线程出队后、回调前主线程已进入下一 tick 的交错：工作线程保留该任务原有的排队标记，只有主线程准备替换任务时才推进标记。跨 tick 及注销后的迟到回调有直接调用生产补丁的宿主回归覆盖。 启动时会验证 Creature 的 sentinel 回收方法仍为空实现；若游戏更新改变该契约，整组 Async 优化会自动禁用而不是冒险运行。 队列背压按 worker 与 in-flight 动态计算，范围 1..4；1 worker 空闲时 quota=2、忙碌时 quota=1。 10,000 请求合成矩阵（不是游戏内 FPS）：目标命中率 0/25/50/75/90% 时，实际 PathProbe 执行为 10000/7701/5501/3301/2000，避免 clone 为 0/2299/4499/6699/8000；理论 probe 工作下降 0/22.99/44.99/66.99/80.00%。8 次有界回退使实际降幅低于名义命中率。 上述数字来自已退役的合成基准项目，保留为历史测量记录。当前宿主回归位于 tests/；历史数字不代表当前游戏性能。 完整场景明细见：dist/CycleTrim/README.md（打包产物中的实测段落）。 源码目录 mods/CycleTrim/ ├── ModInfo.cs # KMod 入口 ├── OniSim/ # 原生仿真核心、C ABI 与加载器 │ ├── native/ # Rust SimDLL（时间步、多组分通量、发布） │ └── gpu/ # wgpu/WGSL GPU 算子与基准 ├── Core/ # 与游戏补丁无关的核心逻辑（如 BrainRateCap） ├── Patches/ # Harmony 补丁 ├── docs/ # Steam 描述、设计与审计文档、截图 └── CycleTrim.csproj 与仓库其它 mod 约定一致：根目录只保留入口与工程/元数据文件；补丁进 Patches/，可复用逻辑进 Core/。 详细说明与日志 变更记录： CHANGELOG.md 运行时目标验证脚本： verify_cycletrim_target_contract.py

title: 概览
body: 通过授权 MCP 会话调用开发机的命令、文件和原生工具。 ssmcp 面向 Astra Pro 的 harness 支持 Astra Pro 集群，在你自己的开发环境中协同完成开发任务。 ssmcp 把多个已授权的 Astra Pro 会话连接到你的开发机，围绕同一项目分工、交换进度、执行命令并汇总结果。命令和工具在你的开发环境中运行，所需结果与上下文通过已授权的会话传递。 你可以让不同会话分别实现功能、检查改动和运行测试，通过成员身份和定向消息协作，把结果提交到同一个项目。了解集群协作 演示视频 · 快速开始 · 本地与远程目标 · 会话操作 · 工具与 Zuse CLI · 编写自己的客户端 · 部署服务器 Rust License: MIT Releases 演示视频 中文：抖音 · ssmcp 项目介绍 · 哔哩哔哩 · ssmcp 项目介绍 English：YouTube · ssmcp Demo 一条连接，三种用法 你想做的事 ssmcp 提供什么 让云端 Agent 操作开发机 原生 Shell、独立命令任务、文件、Zuse CLI 管理，以及按需加载的 Codex / Claude Code / Pi / OpenCode 工具 在终端里持续协作 Markdown 回复、代码高亮、文件和技能引用、问答队列、历史恢复；运行期间仍可继续输入 做自己的远程 harness 客户端拥有工具目录、schema、上下文与 UI；复用协议和客户端扩展 hook，替换自己需要的部分 它的基本过程很直接：Agent 选中一个在线客户端，提交带参数的工具调用，客户端在本机执行，再返回结果、图片或完整输出的归档位置。工具的名称和参数来自实时目录；安装了一个产品，不代表它的全部内部功能都可以直接调用。 快速开始 1. 安装 Linux / macOS： curl -fsSL https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/ssmcp/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh Windows PowerShell： irm https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/ssmcp/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex 也可以使用 cargo install ssmcp --locked --bin ssmcp。安装脚本获取已发布版本；源码构建使用下文的完整子模块检出步骤。平台与安装选项 手动安装的客户端可以直接检查和更新： ssmcp update --check # 只检查最新稳定版 ssmcp update # 校验下载后替换当前安装 更新使用官方发布的 SHA256SUMS，并检查候选程序的版本；下载或校验失败会保留原程序，源码版本较新时不会降级。Cargo、系统包管理器等管理的安装继续使用原来的更新命令。已有会话保持当前程序，重启后使用新版本。自更新说明 2. 在项目目录连接 ssmcp alice@relay.example.com --name dev --title "开发与测试" 把服务器地址换成自己的服务地址。首次连接引导 GitHub 授权，并在该服务器绑定你选择的用户名。后续直接运行 ssmcp，即可复用最近的授权账号；没有图形浏览器时使用 --no-browser。 客户端主动建立 HTTPS/WSS 连接，无需在设备上开放入站端口。保持终端或后台客户端运行，就能使用它的工作区和工具。 ssmcp list # 查看已授权的在线进程与已登记线程 ssmcp -i # 进入一台设备的交互终端 ssmcp whoami # 查看当前账号 完整步骤见账号与设备和默认服务器与可信公钥。 3. 接入 MCP 将终端显示的 https://你的服务器/mcp 加入 ChatGPT 或其他支持 OAuth 的 MCP 客户端，再完成该应用的授权。CLI 登录与 MCP 应用授权分别管理。 对外入口有三个： 入口 作用 list 发现当前身份可访问的设备与客户端工具目录 code_mode 用 JavaScript 组合原生调用，安排顺序、并发和结果读取 collab 同一会话中的成员身份、定向消息、广播与确认 被控设备可以不登录，直接运行 ssmcp --allow 用户名@中继服务器；控制者必须登录该服务器的既有账号。显式名单仅授权列出的人，已登录客户端省略名单时仅允许自己。CLI invite / join 和 MCP invite 已移除，会话内 agent 的 collab.join 保留。账号与授权 先从 list 选择确切的客户端 ID，再查询工具的原始 schema： const clientId = "CLIENT_ID_FROM_LIST"; return await tools.search(clientId, { query: "ssmcp.exec", include_schemas: true }); 运行一个独立命令： const clientId = "CLIENT_ID_FROM_LIST"; return await exec.run(clientId, { command: ["git", "status", "--short"], wait_ms: 5000 }); 返回值包含任务 ID、运行状态、退出码与输出游标。等待时间到期后，任务可以继续运行；使用同一个 ID 读取或取消。大结果返回可追溯的归档元数据。命令接口 · 编排与输出 终端就是工作会话 只在本机运行 Linux 上可以使用 ssmcp local 在当前项目启动本地 MCP 会话，无需远程服务器或 GitHub 登录。默认监听回环地址的可用端口；在终端执行 /logs，将本次 MCP 地址加入同机的 OAuth 客户端，并用其中的一次性登录码授权。终端会保持运行，退出后本次连接授权结束。 本地 code_mode 还需已安装的 Node.js、Bubblewrap（bwrap）和 prlimit，以及系统允许创建相应的 Linux namespace。缺失时会明确失败，不会绕过沙箱。同版 code-mode.js 已编入 Linux 客户端，每次本地会话使用自己的私有副本，无需额外安装脚本。详见运行前提。 已有 .local 名称解析和受信任的本机 HTTPS 反向代理时，可运行 ssmcp local --listen 127.0.0.1:8765 --public-url https://workstation.local。代理须指向该固定端口；命令不自动配置 mDNS、证书或防火墙。详见本地运行与 .local 入口。本段描述源码能力，安装版本是否包含该命令，以 ssmcp local --help 为准。 使用同一入口选择连接目标 把本机或 HTTPS 中继保存为命名 context，随后用同一个参数选择： ssmcp context create here --local ssmcp context create work --server https://relay.example.com ssmcp --context work --name dev ssmcp context use here --context 只选择本次目标，context use 保存新连接的默认选择；已有连接和保存的 session 继续使用原目标。用 ssmcp context show 查看目标与选择来源。命名目标不保存账号凭据；完整优先级和本地运行前提见本地与远程目标。安装版本是否支持，以 ssmcp context --help 为准。 对话与工具 默认对话页收起侧栏，把主要空间留给正文和输入。你可以在工具运行期间补充要求，也可以指定某个已登记的 Agent 接收。账号与本月剩余流量显示在输入区上方，底部保留连接来源与操作提示。 操作 用法 查看会话统计 向左进入统计页，查看会话进程 ID、主 Agent 线程 ID 与实际计数 发给指定 Agent /sessions 或 /message 打开收件人选择器，选定后返回输入框发送 引用文件、图片 输入 @ 枚举工作区；支持中文、带空格路径和目录续补 粘贴图片 Ctrl + V 或 /paste；/attach PATH 导入本地图片 引用技能 输入 $ 枚举有效技能；项目技能覆盖同名全局技能 接受候选 ↑ / ↓ 选择，Tab / Enter 补全；补全后再 Enter 发送 运行本地命令 !pwd、!cargo test；输出与退出码回到会话 查看任务 /tasks；/tasks cancel JOB_ID 停止指定命令任务 回答问题 Shift + ↑ 打开待答问题，保留普通草稿 继续旧会话 /resume 选择本工作区的 JSONL 历史 交接给另一个 Agent /handoff [备注] 生成上下文文件与可编辑引用草稿，选好收件人后发送 查看上下文 /context、/memory 查看当前分支与有界记忆 压缩与分支 /compact [摘要]、/fork [名称]、/switch CONTEXT_ID 查看原生工具 /pi、/cc、/codex 列出真实目录；TOOL {...} 显式调用 浏览工具输出 默认显示状态与最多两行已脱敏结果；点击 Click expand 或选中后按 Enter 展开 查看成员历史 在成员列表右键点击进程或线程，查看该真实身份的记录；Esc 返回 查看详细日志 /logs 打开 Logs；其他对话页可用右键切换日志 展开状态侧栏 F3 或 /sidebar；再按一次收起，F8 保存当前设置 复制与帮助 /copy 复制最近回复；F7 原生选择；/help 打开完整帮助 工具调用成功结束时显示 done，运行中、失败、取消或超时显示实际状态。对话页只预览简短结果，详细记录可在 Logs 中查看；长输出仍可按任务游标或归档读取。 回复支持 Markdown 和常见代码块语法高亮。读取图片后，客户端会探测终端的 Kitty 图像能力；支持时显示清晰图片，其他终端显示有界半块预览或文字说明。超过 8 KiB 的整段粘贴会保存为私有工作区文件并插入引用，便于继续补充文字。 Agent 使用 ssmcp.ui.message 把进度与回答显示在这个会话里；重试可带幂等键，回执提供消息 ID 与历史保存状态。使用 ssmcp.ui.ask 非阻塞提问，再通过 ssmcp.ui.questions 读取答案。这些工具提供本地沟通通道，外部聊天应用仍决定自己的消息显示方式。 ssmcp.ui.present 支持文字、卡片、指标、表格、进度、步骤与条形图，复用同一条消息历史和复制通道。结构化显示 分支上下文保留消息来源 ID 与内容哈希，并限制保存和返回的大小。/compact 可使用本地抽取或你提供的摘要；/fork 和 /switch 管理分支。它们不启动模型，也不重放历史任务。上下文与分支 未选择接收人时，用户要求由下一次符合条件的单个调用领取；选择成员后，仅绑定该成员身份的调用能领取。已交付表示要求进入了工具响应，执行进度仍需由接收者反馈。输入与交付语义 · 成员协作 从命令行连接对话与传递结果 ssmcp list 按进程和已登记线程显示树形目录，远程 attach 默认连接所选对象的聊天输入与输出。进程输入发给选定目录中的主接收入口及已登记线程；线程输入只发给确切的成员 ID。数字引用最近一次列表，保留 5 分钟；显示名称不会被当成线程身份。选择规则 ssmcp list ssmcp attach thread THREAD_ID ssmcp send process PROCESS_ID '检查当前改动' | ssmcp wait --any ssmcp send thread THREAD_ID '整理当前结论' | ssmcp wait --gather | ssmcp send thread NEXT_THREAD_ID --stdin send 输出请求回执，wait 输出接收者的实际最终回复。可以等待任意一条、全部，或用 --count N 等待 N 个输入的结果；确认收到输入和进度更新都不算完成。输入在接收者下一次符合条件的原生调用响应中交付，这些命令不启动模型；停止等待或退出 attach 也不取消尚未完成的工作。收发与等待 聊天收发需要中继与接收端客户端同时支持相应接口，仅更新本机程序不会更新远端服务。请求和回复保存在服务端的有界内存中，最长保留 1 小时，服务端重启会丢失这批状态。原有 Shell 终端仍可用 ssmcp -i 或 ssmcp attach process PROCESS_ID --terminal main；本地保存会话使用 ssmcp attach --local NAME。兼容与保留边界 成员历史只展示当前进程保留、能够核对真实身份的事件。旧记录中无法确定成员归属的内容留在进程视图，不会按显示名称分配给某个线程。线程历史 定时更新 Git 上游 连接存续期间，ssmcp 默认每 300 秒检查当前分支的远端上游并更新对应的远端跟踪引用；JSONL、无终端和后台连接同样运行。可设为 60–86400 秒，或用 0 关闭，修改对新连接生效。 ssmcp config get git-fetch-interval ssmcp config set git-fetch-interval 300 ssmcp config set git-fetch-interval 0 首次检查、共享调度、超时与更新范围见定时 Git fetch 配置。 先预览，再调整 ssmcp ui preview ssmcp ui init ssmcp ui check 内置 dark、codex-dark、nord、solarized、light、minimal 六种主题。通过 [ui] 配置调整侧栏、面板顺序和颜色，F5 应用显示配置；/reload 则重新启动客户端。终端支持原生图片且侧栏空间足够时显示方形像素二维码，窄窗口显示完整链接；网关提供教程时进入中英文指南，旧网关暂未提供教程时进入门户首页。界面配置 复用现有工具 ssmcp 默认启用命令、文件、会话和 Zuse CLI 管理工具，不要求安装其他 harness。Codex、Claude Code、Pi 和 OpenCode 默认不探测、不启动；需要时用 ssmcp.harnesses.load 显式加载一项，ssmcp.harnesses.list 只读取缓存状态。加载后保留该工具的完整 schema、会话和审批方式，实际模型调用仍须显式发起。按需加载说明 --input 默认从终端接收聊天消息，--agent 默认由下一位调用方领取。要在启动时加载原生协议，请用 --load-harness codex 或 --load-harness claude-code。用 ssmcp --list-harnesses 查看支持项。--load-harness ssmcp 可以连接明确指定并已认证的 MCP 网关。客户端输入 · 协议加载 ssmcp local --socket 提供默认路径的本机 HTTP/MCP Unix socket，--socket PATH 可指定私有路径。时间工具支持当前 UTC、跨时区时间差和倒计时，终端直接显示运行时长与剩余时间，/wait 可查看详情。本机连接 · 时间原语 开发工具：Codex、Claude Code、Pi、OpenCode；能力以当前成功注册的目录为准。 桌面与浏览器：直接运行独立 Zuse CLI，通过通用 exec 传递 argv、管理任务和读取结果。computer 原生工具只提供版本查询、下载、安装、卸载；没有内置动作代理或隐藏 fallback。Zuse 工作流 · Windows 安装范围 上下文：工作区文件、项目指令、有效技能视图和显式只读 context roots。 指定已有浏览器时，先确认所选 Zuse 版本支持的连接方式和实际会话，再操作用户选定的目标。OAuth 登录、用户打开链接和已授权外部 MCP 的通用转发仍保留；它们不恢复旧内置浏览器工具。现有浏览器连接 · code_mode 示例 管理 Zuse CLI ssmcp computer version --json ssmcp computer download --json ssmcp computer install DOWNLOAD_ID_FROM_REPLY --json 版本来自实际 CLI 的 --version。下载选择官方稳定版并核验资产身份、大小与 SHA-256；安装仅写入当前管理器的私有目录，不覆盖外部 Zuse、不修改 PATH。使用返回的可执行路径运行任务；卸载必须提供真实 installation_id，且所有权和字节仍匹配。四个管理工具与示例 旧控制开关、兼容入口和默认 Super + Alt + C 快捷键已移除。独立 Zuse CLI 可直接使用，无需先切换控制权或进入 takeover 流程。Zuse 管理与执行 通用 Shell 与独立 Zuse 仍遵循操作系统权限；需要隔离时配置实际的账户、会话或沙箱边界。 独立核心库 ztuio、zharness 和 zplugin 作为固定源码的 Rust 依赖参与构建，分别承担终端帧、扩展接口和本机动态库加载。三个库均使用固定 Git 子模块，ztuio 的包名与 Rust 导入名均为 ztuio，精确版本为 0.1.0。它们独立维护版本，不启动模型或外部 harness。源码构建请使用 git clone --recurse-submodules；已有 checkout 使用 git submodule update --init --recursive。依赖与协同开发 客户端掌握能力，服务端负责连接 服务端负责身份、会话路由、成员通信与受限 JavaScript 编排。客户端负责执行工具、组织上下文、保存输出和绘制界面。增加客户端原语后，调用方可以通过实时目录发现它，并继续使用通用 call(clientId, name, arguments)。 因此，你可以重写客户端，接入自己的远程 harness，或只替换 UI。现有界面也通过小接口读取状态和控制任务： 边界 可复用接口 能力发现 客户端版本、原生工具 schema、客户端资源 执行 terminal.*、ssmcp.exec.*、原生 harness 工具 上下文 ssmcp.fs.*、ssmcp.skills.*、ssmcp.agents.* 会话界面 ssmcp.ui.*、问答、历史、队列与源码事件 扩展策略 可选的客户端 ToolCallHook，调用前允许或拒绝，调用后观察结果 hook 默认关闭，不内置额外审核流程，也不改变工具原生权限。自定义策略由客户端开发者接入。当前连接统一使用 wire v7，旧协议会明确拒绝。扩展接口与最小客户端 · 上下文边界 Project Z：ztuio 终端帧差分、几何边界和定宽行已接入固定源码子模块 ztuio。这个小库使用 no_std，禁止 unsafe，没有第三方依赖；缓冲区由调用方提供，Unicode 宽度规则由宿主决定。它只计算该写哪些终端字节，图片协议、终端输入、主题和会话状态仍由客户端管理。 运行边界 工具使用客户端进程的操作系统权限；MCP 账号授权控制谁能调用设备。文件 API 受工作区和显式 context roots 限制，Shell 仍按操作系统权限执行。 本地历史采用版本化 JSONL，/resume 恢复文本上下文，不重放工具，也不恢复外部模型线程。问答队列当前保存在进程内；reload 后可从历史查看已记录正文。完整边界见会话历史。 图片导入会在客户端生成有界预览文件，仍以私有文件引用发送；不改变 wire v7。原生图片读取限制为 400 KiB，支持 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP。GIF / WebP 经 code_mode 返回时还需要支持这些格式的 relay；旧 relay 的图像通道仍只有 PNG / JPEG。长工具输出保留有界预览与归档，展开界面事件只读取当前保留的显示正文。 开发 git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/ssmcp.git cd ssmcp cargo build --locked --bins --example vt_snapshot cargo run --locked --bin ssmcp -- ui preview make check 检查格式和 Clippy；make test-client-ui 在隔离的真实 PTY 中验证输入、问答、图片、历史和重载。验证脚本使用测试自己的进程与工作区。 项目持续使用 ssmcp 自己的远程工具开发。发布与构建 · 下一版本计划 文档 从这里开始 深入实现 账号、设备与临时接入 工具注册与 harness 输入框与本地工作流 客户端扩展与上下文工程 主题、布局与快捷键 Zuse、浏览器与能力资源 部署服务器 完整输出与会话控制 信任与默认服务器 会话历史格式
