title: 概览
body: 本地化消息目录、显式语言回退与命名模板格式化。 zi18n zi18n is Project Z's Rust library for borrowed localization catalogs, explicit language fallback, and named template formatting. The application supplies the messages, requested locale, and fallback order. The core has zero runtime dependencies and requires no allocator. Caller-supplied Write and Display implementations control their own allocations. Install Add the registry release to your Cargo manifest. [dependencies] zi18n = { version = "=0.1.0", default-features = false } Release verification records the published package and registry-consumer checks. Example The same catalog set can serve plain labels and plural counters. A missing Chinese key can fall back to English, and the returned message carries the locale of its actual catalog. use zi18n::{Argument, Catalog, Catalogs, Locale, Message, PluralCategory, PluralForm, format_to}; const EN: &[Message<'static>] = &[ Message::text("status", "Ready"), Message::text("retry", "Retry"), Message::plural("files", &[ PluralForm::new(PluralCategory::One, "{count} file"), PluralForm::new(PluralCategory::Other, "{count} files"), ]), ]; const ZH: &[Message<'static>] = &[ Message::text("status", "就绪"), Message::plural("files", &[ PluralForm::new(PluralCategory::Other, "{count} 个文件"), ]), ]; let en = Locale::parse("en")?; let zh = Locale::parse("zh")?; let catalogs = [Catalog::new(en, EN)?, Catalog::new(zh, ZH)?]; let fallbacks = [en]; let messages = Catalogs::new(&catalogs, &fallbacks)?; let requested = Locale::parse("zh-Hans-CN")?; assert_eq!(messages.lookup(requested, "status")?.text(), Some("就绪")); assert_eq!(messages.lookup(requested, "retry")?.locale(), en); let matched = messages.lookup(requested, "files")?; let count = 2_u64; let template = matched.select_cardinal_integer(count)?.unwrap(); let mut output = String::new(); // The caller chooses the sink. format_to(&mut output, template, &[Argument::new("count", &count)])?; assert_eq!(matched.locale(), zh); assert_eq!(output, "2 个文件"); # Ok::<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>>(()) The zmcl adapter example keeps the existing --version output in English and verifies the output bytes, including the newline. Features Cargo features Available API Default ([]) no_std catalog lookup and formatting to a caller-supplied core::fmt::Write, with no allocator required alloc Adds zi18n::format to return an allocated String std Enables alloc and standard-library mode. Errors implement core::error::Error under all feature sets Rust 1.85.0 is the minimum supported version. The crate uses edition 2024. Locale and fallback Locale::parse borrows the original tag and checks RFC 5646 structure, including extlangs, extensions, private use, and the fixed grandfathered tags. It rejects duplicate variants and extension singletons. Locale comparisons ignore ASCII case. Registry validity, alias canonicalization, extension semantics, likely subtags, and OS locale discovery are outside this API. RFC 5646 §2.1, §2.2.9 Lookup searches per key in the exact request, its truncated parents, then the caller's configured fallback locales in order. The search skips absent request candidates and absent keys, returns the matched catalog's original locale spelling, and produces MissingMessage when it runs out of candidates. Each configured fallback must name an exact catalog, ignoring ASCII case. Catalogs::new returns CatalogError::UnknownFallback with the zero-based index of the first missing catalog. Pass &[] for no configured fallback. The search uses the list as supplied, so include any desired fallback parent explicitly. Parent truncation removes the last subtag and all consecutive single-character subtags immediately before it, including private-use values. For example, en-x-a-tail goes directly to en, skipping the valid tag en-x-a. The request zh-Hant-HK-u-nu-hanidec tries zh-Hant-HK-u-nu, then zh-Hant-HK, zh-Hant, and zh. This is an exact-catalog policy with no Accept-Language parsing or likely-subtag inference such as zh-HK to zh-Hant. RFC 4647 §3.4 Catalogs and formatting Catalog::new checks all templates, duplicate keys, duplicate plural categories, and the presence of Other in every plural message. Catalogs::new rejects duplicates across catalog locales. Message keys are case-sensitive. Templates support {name}, {{ for a literal opening brace, and }} for a literal closing brace. Argument names are case-sensitive ASCII identifiers matching [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Values can implement Display and their output is opaque, including any braces. Valid, unique extra arguments are accepted and ignored. Repeated placeholders reuse the same argument. Format syntax and argument validation occur before any sink writes or value formatting. Syntax errors report a UTF-8 byte offset, and argument errors report the affected name. A sink or replacement Display failure returns FormatError::Write and can leave a partial prefix. Plurals The caller can select any of the six categories directly or pass a rules provider to select_plural_with. The provider receives the matched catalog locale, including when lookup fell back. An absent category uses the catalog's required Other form. cardinal_integer handles only English (en) and Chinese (zh) primary languages and accepts the full u64 range. English selects One for exactly 1 and Other otherwise, while Chinese always selects Other. Other languages return UnsupportedLocale. The helper excludes visible fraction digits, compact exponents, ordinals, and localized number formatting. UTS #35 rev. 79, CLDR 49 cardinal data Design notes describe the validation boundaries and how the operations use borrowed data.

title: Design
body: 本地化消息目录、显式语言回退与命名模板格式化。 Design zi18n separates catalog validation, message lookup, and rendering. An application can validate borrowed catalog data once and reuse it for different requests and output sinks. Borrowed data Locale retains a borrowed spelling. Message and PluralForm are constant definitions, so an application can place them in static slices or borrow runtime-loaded data. Catalog validates each message and Catalogs validates the locale set. Both keep their slices immutable for the lifetime of the validated values. Data loading and language selection belong to the caller. These types have no runtime dependencies and require no allocator. Validation uses scans of the supplied slices. Lookup performs an exact locale scan for each candidate and an exact key scan within a matching catalog. The library builds no index and keeps no shared mutable state. Locale candidates The parser follows the language-tag productions in RFC 5646 §2.1 and checks variant and extension singleton uniqueness. It accepts syntactically valid unregistered combinations. A grandfathered spelling is retained as supplied. RFC 5646 §2.1, §2.2.9 Lookup truncates the request according to the singleton rule from RFC 4647 §3.4. A shorter candidate may keep a shorter extension or private-use sequence. Every lookup starts from the full request for the specific key. RFC 4647 §3.4 The fallback list supplies exact catalog locales in priority order after the requested parents. Catalogs::new checks each entry against the catalog set case-insensitively and reports the first unknown index. Only the requested locale expands to its parents. An empty list ends lookup after the requested hierarchy. Rendering A single tokenizer interprets UTF-8 text, ASCII braces, and argument names. Catalog validation uses it to check grammar. Standalone formatting uses it to preflight the template and its arguments, then walks the same template again to render. The argument list and template are borrowed in both passes. Replacement values go directly to the sink as display output. An application can format atomically into its own buffer if its final destination requires that behavior. The streaming API cannot undo writes already made by a failing sink or replacement Display. Plural selection A matched text message yields a plain template. A matched plural message supplies its locale to the caller's rules, selects the corresponding template, and uses Other when that category is absent. A provider may capture operands of any type. The built-in provider works with plain unsigned counts for en and zh only. The English CLDR rule tests i = 1 and v = 0. The u64 input represents a plain integer with zero visible fraction digits. UTS #35 rev. 79, Pinned CLDR 49 cardinal data

title: 概览
body: 输入法组合、候选状态与原生输入事件编解码。 zinput Reusable input-method state, native Linux event decoding, and terminal input encoding in Rust. The portable library remains #![no_std]; its default feature set has no external dependencies. The composition and evdev paths use caller-owned or fixed storage without allocating during event processing. Existing terminal encoding APIs use alloc for returned or reusable byte buffers. The optional plugins feature adds a shared input-engine trait and a generated native ABI through zplugin. System library loading is centralized in zsys. Desktop input-method registration, keyboard-layout mapping and text delivery are provided by application frontends. The separate zinput-wayland package supplies a Linux input-method-v2 adapter with compositor keyboard grabs, XKB layout mapping, preedit/commit delivery and paired virtual-keyboard forwarding. It is optional and does not change the core library's default feature set. With plugins enabled, the runtime dependency chain is zinput → zplugin → zsys. Generating the typed interface also builds zplugin-macros, which uses proc-macro2, quote, syn and unicode-ident. Those build dependencies are not part of the default feature set; this is not a claim that the plugin build has no third-party packages. Install [dependencies] zinput = "0.1.3" Composition lifecycle The ime module keeps one focused input context and one composition in a caller buffer. A composition is the text being edited before the user accepts it; preedit exposes that provisional text. An accepted commit copies complete UTF-8 to a caller buffer and ends the composition. use zinput::ime::{Composition, ContextId, Selection}; let mut preedit = [0; 128]; let mut committed = [0; 128]; let mut state = Composition::new(&mut preedit); state.set_focus(Some(ContextId::new(7).unwrap())); let token = state.begin().unwrap(); let token = state.set_preedit(token, "你好", Selection::caret(6)).unwrap(); assert_eq!(state.preedit(), "你好"); let result = state.commit_preedit(token, &mut committed).unwrap(); assert_eq!(&committed[..result.bytes_written], "你好".as_bytes()); assert_eq!(result.context.get(), 7); assert_eq!(state.preedit(), ""); Every accepted preedit update returns a new revision token. CandidatePage borrows a slice of candidate strings and carries the token that produced them; commit_candidate rejects an older page after another update or a focus change. Tokens belong to the same Composition instance and must not be exchanged between instances. Changing focus or blurring cancels the old composition; reporting the same focus again preserves it. Buffer and selection failures leave state and output unchanged. Selection endpoints are UTF-8 byte offsets at character boundaries; grapheme navigation belongs to the engine. Commit, cancel, a shorter preedit, focus change and drop clear the retained text bytes that are no longer used. This ordinary memory clearing is not a guarantee against compiler elimination or process-memory inspection. The revision counter returns an error at exhaustion and never wraps. TextTarget is the delivery boundary for applications. Its commit_text method receives an explicit context and a complete string. The frontend must confirm that context still identifies the intended target before delivery. A delivery error can follow partial platform output, so the platform adapter owns retry semantics; the composition core cannot roll back external application input. Input engine plugins Enable plugins to use one shared Rust trait and its generated native ABI: [dependencies] zinput = { version = "0.1.3", features = ["plugins"] } Built-in engines implement engine::InputEngine directly. Separately compiled engines export InputEngineExport<T> using zplugin::export!; hosts use InputEngineApi and its generated proxy. The service ID is dev.project-z.zinput.engine, version 1. EngineSelection has its own explicit ABI type ID and uses 64-bit byte offsets, independent of the host pointer width. Engine call Contract reset(context) Establish one context; zero means blur. Discard old preedit and pending commit. process(phase, key, modifiers, text) Consume a logical key after keyboard-layout mapping. Return change flags; zero leaves the event to the frontend. preedit(output), selection() Read complete provisional text and valid UTF-8 selection offsets. candidate_count(), candidate(index, output) Read a bounded candidate page without returning pointers into plugin memory. select(index) Accept a candidate and report the resulting change flags. commit(output) Drain a pending commit only after complete copying succeeds. Phases and logical keys are constants in engine::phase and engine::key. Modifier bits match Modifiers. Calls that write strings return their UTF-8 byte length. A short buffer returns zplugin::Error::BufferTooSmall without partial output or a consumed commit. An engine must return Busy rather than overwrite undrained committed text. Hosts drain commits before processing the next producing event and fetch changed preedit/candidates according to the flags. # #[cfg(feature = "plugins")] # fn load_reference_engine() -> Result<(), zinput::engine::zplugin::Error> { use zinput::engine::{InputEngineApi, key, phase, zplugin::Plugin}; // SAFETY: This path must identify reviewed, trusted native plugin code. let library = unsafe { Plugin::load(c"/absolute/path/libime_engine.so")? }; let mut engine = InputEngineApi::create(&library)?; engine.reset(7)?; engine.process(phase::PRESS, key::TEXT, 0, "ni")?; let mut candidate = [0; 64]; let used = engine.candidate(0, &mut candidate)?; assert_eq!(&candidate[..used as usize], "你".as_bytes()); # Ok(()) # } The example ime_engine implements a bounded reference engine: arbitrary UTF-8 composition, scalar backspace, and two candidates for ni. It is a protocol and lifecycle example, not a full language dictionary. Its constructor allocates the plugin object through zplugin; its event methods use fixed buffers. Native plugins execute trusted code in the host process. Library loading comes from zplugin through zsys; zinput adds no independent system FFI or loader. Native Linux event boundary linux::EvdevDecoder accepts bytes from Linux input_event records and emits key presses, repeats, releases and synchronization events. The decoder supports explicit 16-byte and 24-byte timestamp layouts, little and big endian records, and fragments split at any byte. On 64-bit Linux, EvdevDecoder::native() selects the native layout. Device access and keyboard-layout translation remain in the platform adapter; keycodes from evdev are physical codes, not Unicode text. After SYN_DROPPED, the decoder suppresses events until it observes SYN_REPORT and the host calls resynchronized(). The host must first query current device state through its system layer, as required by the Linux input event protocol. This explicit acknowledgement prevents records from an unsynchronized stream from being mistaken for valid keystrokes. The callback executes synchronously without an allocated event queue. This library does not register a desktop input method, read a keyboard device, install a shortcut, or select a target application. Its portable state and plugin contract can be used by Linux, Windows and macOS frontends. A working desktop frontend still needs its platform's input-method and text-delivery integration. Neither the core nor the reference engine depends on Fcitx5. Encode keyboard input use zinput::{encode_key, Key, KeyEvent, Modes, Modifiers}; let legacy = Modes::default(); assert_eq!( encode_key(Key::Up, Modifiers(0), KeyEvent::Press, "", &legacy), b"\x1b[A", ); let kitty = Modes { kitty_keyboard: 1, ..Modes::default() }; assert_eq!( encode_key( Key::Character('c'), Modifiers(Modifiers::CTRL), KeyEvent::Press, "\u{3}", &kitty, ), b"\x1b[99;5u", ); Key::Character identifies the unshifted key. The text argument is the complete UTF-8 text committed by the platform. Pass Key::Unidentified or use encode_text when an input method commits text without a physical key identity. Multi-character commits are retained. The modifier bit values are Shift=1, Alt=2, Ctrl=4, Super=8, Hyper=16, Meta=32, Caps Lock=64 and Num Lock=128. The encoder adds the protocol's modifier offset. For a modifier key's own event, supply its state after the transition, including any other physical key that keeps the same modifier active. Reuse a buffer extern crate alloc; use alloc::vec::Vec; use zinput::{encode_key_into, Key, KeyEvent, Modes, Modifiers}; let modes = Modes::default(); let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(128); encode_key_into(Key::Enter, Modifiers(0), KeyEvent::Press, "\r", &modes, &mut bytes); assert_eq!(bytes, b"\r"); // After the transport accepts these bytes, clear and reuse the same allocation. bytes.clear(); encode_key_into(Key::Left, Modifiers(0), KeyEvent::Press, "", &modes, &mut bytes); assert_eq!(bytes, b"\x1b[D"); The _into functions append to the supplied buffer. They avoid further buffer allocation while its existing capacity is sufficient. The convenience functions return a new Vec<u8>. Protocol coverage Input Behavior Legacy keyboard UTF-8 text, Control/Alt combinations, distinct Ctrl+Shift character shortcuts, application cursor and keypad modes, function keys and modifiers Kitty keyboard Progressive enhancement flags 1/2/4/8/16, press/repeat/release, alternate keys, modifier keys, keypad identity and associated text Mouse Tracking modes 9/1000/1002/1003, SGR 1006 and legacy encoding, modifiers, vertical/horizontal wheel and xterm buttons 1–11 Paste Optional bracketed-paste delimiters; tabs and line endings preserved; other control characters removed Focus Focus-in/out sequences when focus reporting is enabled Kitty alternate-key reporting can infer a shifted character from committed text. Use encode_key_with_alternates with KeyAlternates when the platform also knows the standard-layout key identity. A pure input-method commit uses key 0 with associated text when flags 8 and 16 are both enabled; otherwise it is emitted as UTF-8 to preserve input that has no physical key event. Enter, Tab and Backspace retain their legacy behavior until Kitty flag 8 is enabled. Function key F3 uses CSI 13~ in enhanced mode to avoid cursor-report ambiguity. Modifier-key events require flag 8, and release reports require flag 2. In legacy mode, Ctrl+Shift character shortcuts retain the Shift distinction using CSI-u, as in Kitty and Ghostty. Ctrl+Shift+Space keeps the legacy NUL exception. Lock state remains absent from legacy sequences. Ctrl+tilde emits the documented ASCII control value 30. Mouse positions are zero-based at the API boundary. The encoder converts them to one-based protocol coordinates. Buttons are 0=left, 1=middle, 2=right, 3/4=vertical wheel, 5/6=horizontal wheel and 7–10=extra buttons. These are zero-based xterm/X11 button numbers; platform frontends must normalize their native button order. Wheel releases and wheel-button motion are ignored. Extra-button releases identify their button in SGR and use the common release code in legacy encoding. Motion with an extra button follows mode 1002/1003. Mode 9 reports only left/middle/right presses and omits modifiers. SGR encoding alone does not enable tracking. Legacy coordinates beyond its representable range produce no event. The host should suppress mouse motion that remains inside the same character cell. Clipboard encoding removes Escape, DEL and C0/C1 controls other than Tab, CR and LF. Consequently clipboard contents cannot inject a bracketed-paste end marker. Integration contract The host is responsible for input-mode negotiation, keyboard layout, native input-method protocols and text delivery, clipboard access, transport backpressure and delivery order. Report only modes that are connected to the host's actual event path. The codec owns no window or operating-system resources and performs no I/O. Verification cargo test --all-features python tools/test_native_plugin.py cargo check --lib --no-default-features --target x86_64-unknown-none cargo check --lib --all-features --target x86_64-unknown-none cargo bench --bench ime The native plugin driver builds a separate dynamic library, locates Cargo's reported artifact and runs the explicit ABI integration test against that file. Generic cargo test leaves this one test ignored so missing plugin artifacts cannot become silent passes. The CI workflow is configured to run this driver on Linux, Windows and macOS. Core tests cover multilingual commits, UTF-8 selection boundaries, caller capacity, stale candidates and focus changes. Linux tests cover both event layouts and byte orders, fragmented records and loss/resynchronization. On 64-bit Linux they compile a small C fixture against <linux/input.h> and decode the actual native records it emits. This fixture needs a C compiler and Linux development headers; it never opens an input device. The benchmark performs one million bounded composition lifecycles and one million evdev records. It reports elapsed time, buffer sizes and allocation counts, and asserts zero allocator calls inside each measured loop. Timing results describe that build and machine; they are not a comparison against other input frameworks or a desktop latency guarantee. Existing codec tests cover all 32 keyboard flag combinations for reset-key behavior, alternate-key and release-text boundaries, multi-character commits, xterm button ranges, mouse tracking and coordinate limits, clipboard delimiter injection, focus reporting and buffer reuse. Test tooling uses Rust's normal test harness; the published library remains no_std. Protocol references Kitty keyboard protocol XTerm control sequences Ghostty input guide Ghostty keyboard encoder Ghostty mouse encoder License MIT. Part of Project Z. Source and releases: zinput.

title: 概览
body: 处理 LDAP 与 BER 消息的有界解析和编解码。 zldap An allocation-free LDAP/BER protocol codec. The published crate is always #![no_std], uses only core, has no dependencies, and forbids unsafe code. Minimum supported Rust: 1.74 (edition 2021). Bind example use zldap::{Authentication, BindRequest, Message, MessageInput, Operation, OperationInput, ParseLimits, ber::Frame}; let request = MessageInput { id: 1, operation: OperationInput::BindRequest(BindRequest { version: 3, name: "cn=alice,dc=example,dc=org", authentication: Authentication::Simple(b"example-password"), }), controls: &[], }; let mut output = [0u8; 256]; let n = request.encode(&mut output)?; let mut workspace = [Frame::EMPTY; 32]; let message = Message::parse(&output[..n], ParseLimits::default(), &mut workspace)?; assert_eq!(message.id, 1); assert!(matches!(message.operation, Operation::BindRequest(_))); # Ok::<(), zldap::Error>(()) Parsing returns protocol data. Authentication, authorization, filter evaluation, transport security, connection state and request scheduling belong to the caller. In particular, decoding a BindRequest or a success result code does not establish an authenticated session. Debug output redacts Bind credentials. Supported wire types BER identifiers (including high tags), definite lengths, signed INTEGER and ENUMERATED, BOOLEAN, primitive OCTET STRING, SEQUENCE and SET are available in ber. The LDAP layer supports simple and SASL Bind protocol data, BindResponse, SearchRequest, SearchResultEntry, SearchResultDone, UnbindRequest, controls and referrals. SASL credentials remain opaque bytes. An empty SASL mechanism is preserved as the RFC 4511 negotiation-abort signal; the application handles the required response. Filters cover AND, OR, NOT, equality, substrings, greater-or-equal, less-or-equal, present, approximate match and extensible match. Filter::children exposes immediate children; Filter::events traverses preorder with depth using a caller-owned stack. No recursive parser or recursive destructor is used. Other application operations return ErrorKind::UnsupportedOperation(tag). Unknown trailing SEQUENCE extensions are structurally validated and retained in the original message bytes. Known duplicate fields, invalid field order, malformed values and unknown filter choices are rejected. Metadata is checked as UTF-8; passwords, assertions, control contents and attribute values stay binary. Resource bounds and buffers ParseLimits defaults to a 1 MiB encoded frame, 32 TLV levels, 65,536 total TLVs, and 1 MiB per primitive value. The outer message counts as depth one and one field. Every nested TLV, including ignored extensions, consumes these budgets. Limits apply before returning a message; callers need not iterate every view to trigger validation. A short frame workspace returns WorkspaceTooSmall. Message::parse requires exactly one complete frame. parse_prefix returns the first frame and its consumed size for TCP buffers and batches; limits apply to that individual frame. Truncation, malformed BER, overflow and resource-limit failures have separate structured error kinds and byte offsets. MessageInput::encoded_len validates fields and computes exact required capacity. encode writes at the beginning of caller-provided storage and leaves it unchanged on invalid fields or insufficient capacity. The low-level ber::Writer writes backward: write siblings last-to-first, then wrap their parent using a checkpoint from Writer::len. Writer::finish returns the encoded suffix without shifting payload bytes. Message::copy_encoded explicitly copies an existing frame. The BER layer accepts nonminimal definite length encodings, as BER permits them; it rejects indefinite lengths. Integers must use minimal signed encodings and fit in i64. LDAP INTEGER fields additionally obey their ASN.1 ranges. LDAP BOOLEAN true must use ff, and default FALSE criticality/dnAttributes fields must be absent; generic BER BOOLEAN accepts any nonzero octet. Constructed OCTET STRING is outside the LDAP BER profile. Embedded ASN.1 in an OCTET STRING is opaque and is not recursively decoded. DNs and referral URIs are exposed as UTF-8 strings; this crate does not evaluate directory schemas or implement full RFC 4514 DN and RFC 3986 URI grammars. Use the calling application's directory and URI handling for those semantics. The runnable Search example builds a BER Filter, encodes a request, then reads the borrowed fields: cargo run --example search Build and verification cargo test --locked cargo +1.74.0 test --locked cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings cargo doc --no-deps cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown cargo check --target thumbv7em-none-eabi cargo +nightly miri test --locked --lib --tests python3 scripts/check_package.py The independent comparison/ workspace pins Kanidm protocol and BER releases. It is excluded from the published package and the core dependency graph. Its README documents the corpus, semantic checks, timing and allocation accounting. Performance conclusions apply only to measured equivalent protocol operations. The recorded comparison against ldap3_proto 0.9.0 measured full-decode speedups of 2.45×–17.66× across eleven accepted workloads on one Xeon Platinum 8573C. Simple Search was 2.78× and a complex Filter was 2.94×. zldap made no measured heap allocations. The 128 KiB value advantage comes from borrowing bytes; decoding and hashing every payload byte was effectively tied. The report separates BER, full LDAP, byte-reading, native-API encoding, errors and memory, with raw CSV and source hashes. See the engineering report for supported fields, safety evidence, throughput, memory accounting and release status. Release The GitHub Release workflow accepts current, patch, minor or major. It validates the release commit, checks registry version availability, publishes using the CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN repository secret, then creates the Git tag and GitHub Release in the same run. PR jobs receive no publishing credentials. References RFC 4511: LDAP protocol RFC 4512: LDAP attribute descriptions Kanidm LDAP protocol implementation License: MIT OR Apache-2.0.

title: 概览
body: 基于 Project Z 的原生 Minecraft 启动器。 zmcl 基于 Project Z 的原生 Minecraft 启动器，目标是把启动器的常驻内存和安装体积压低，同时逐项补齐 XMCL 的功能。 当前开发预览已实现 Minecraft Java 版安装与启动、Modrinth 模组和整合包、资源包和光影包管理、Java 管理、存档与备份、实例回收站、本地服务器管理和 Horizon 官方启动器下载。完整 XMCL 功能覆盖仍在开发中。 功能记录 区分了已有代码、实际验证和仍缺少的能力，比较基线固定为 XMCL 0.73.1。 项目网站 · 预览版下载 · 实际验收 · 性能测量 下载与安装 从 GitHub Releases 选择已发布版本，并按发行页实际列出的平台资产下载。每个版本的文件摘要、运行条件和原生验收范围随发行记录提供。 使用环境 软件包 安装方式 Linux x86_64，用户级安装 tar.gz 解包后运行 Python 安装器，自行选择安装位置 Debian 系 Linux x86_64 DEB 确认运行库满足要求后，交给 apt 管理 Arch Linux x86_64 AUR 的 zmcl-bin 使用 yay 或 paru，以 AUR 当前配方版本为准 Windows amd64 ZIP 查看对应发行的原生 Windows 验收记录与安装说明 Linux 预编译程序要求 glibc 2.39+、Fontconfig 2.17.0+、FreeType 和 X11/XWayland。文件与下载操作使用 curl、系统 CA 证书和 Python 3.8+；Java 与 Minecraft 单独安装。DEB 的具体依赖由二进制符号和发行元数据生成，安装前应核对目标系统的库版本。较旧的 Debian 或 Ubuntu 需要相应运行库，或在目标系统从源码构建。本项目暂未提供 macOS 下载包。 Linux 便携包 校验并解包后，在包含 scripts/install.py 的包根目录运行： python3 scripts/install.py install --prefix "$HOME/.local" "$HOME/.local/bin/zmcl" gui --prefix 接受含空格的路径，例如 --prefix "$HOME/Applications/zmcl preview"。安装完成后会显示实际版本、安装位置、直接启动命令和更新方法；如果 PATH 中的 zmcl 指向另一份程序，也会同时显示两处路径。使用完成提示中的完整路径即可启动本次安装。 从新版本解包目录再次运行安装器，并传入相同的 --prefix，即可升级这份安装。卸载也使用相同前缀： python3 scripts/install.py uninstall --prefix "$HOME/.local" 安装器依据文件清单与摘要处理程序、图标、桌面入口和安装信息。用户修改过的文件、非受管文件以及 Minecraft 实例、存档和账号资料会保留。详细步骤见安装说明。 Arch Linux AUR 包 zmcl-bin 提供预编译程序、桌面入口与图标： yay -S zmcl-bin # 或 paru -S zmcl-bin AUR 与用户级安装分别由各自的安装记录管理。用 zmcl --version 核对 PATH 实际选中的版本；包管理器安装的副本继续通过同一包管理器更新。 查看当前安装与检查更新 Settings 展示当前程序版本、平台、位置和安装来源。点击 Check for updates 手动查询官方 GitHub 发行，包括开发预览，并检查是否有适合当前操作系统和架构的软件包。失败后可重试，也可打开或复制官方发行链接。当前构建比线上软件包更新时，会显示 Newer build installed。 确认版本后，按原安装方式更新：便携安装重新运行同前缀安装器，DEB 与 AUR 使用对应包管理器。缺少有效来源信息的程序会显示 Unknown / source build。也可从命令行检查： zmcl update check --json 为什么体积可以小 启动计划由 Rust no_std + alloc 核心生成，JSON 使用 zconv，命令行使用 zclap，主线界面使用 Project Z 的 zgpui::native。Linux 默认采用 CPU 栅格化和 X11 提交，不创建 OpenGL 上下文。界面按事件重绘，空闲时等待事件。受管理文件依据上游提供的摘要和大小校验；不可变文件放进共享内容库，再通过硬链接或复制提供给实例。 重型操作使用按需退出的系统程序，未把整套浏览器运行时装进启动器。因此，“Rust 依赖都来自 Project Z”不等于没有系统依赖：curl、Python、图形库、Java 和可选 OpenSSL 仍需明确计算。游戏内存、Java 安装、游戏资源和 Horizon 官方发行包不属于 zmcl 本身的可执行文件。 已发布 v0.1.3 的 Linux GUI 主程序为 1,473,752 字节（1.41 MiB）。分发包、安装文件和内存使用分别测量，详见性能报告。GUI 的 --exit-after-launch 选项会在启动命令成功返回游戏 PID 后退出；已实际验证启动器退出后 Java 进程继续存活。命令行启动本身也无需保留常驻服务。 性能对照使用固定 XMCL 0.73.1、完整进程树、重复样本，并同时记录 RSS、PSS、SwapPss 和宿主内存压力。软件渲染结果不能替代硬件 GPU 实测，现阶段功能范围也不同。 主线已接入正式发布的 zgpui 0.1.5：实际窗口、输入和绘制调用来自 zgpui::native，启用 native 和 linux-software，不保留旧包别名。Library 的 Manage 入口提供世界、备份与资源管理，侧栏提供本地服务器管理。新建实例支持异步官方版本选择、自动避开重名、五种加载器和默认创建后安装。隐藏 Activity 不再为每段日志触发重绘，离开管理页会释放其列表内容与容量。九个页面标题已通过 zi18n 借用静态英文，完整多语言仍待后续。 0.1.2 迭代的限定测试中，空库重绘 CPU 时间中位数下降 44.5%；2000 个世界的两对交错测试中，返回 Library 后 GUI 的 PSS+SwapPss 下降 23.0%，RSS 下降 14.5%。两项来自不同冻结候选，不能相加，也不代表最终发行二进制在所有状态的结果。完整进程树、显示服务与换页边界见本轮报告。源码能力与当前 AUR 发行版本分别记录，详见架构说明和功能记录。 0.1.3 继续减少管理助手的临时分配。在相同系统 Python、两份各含 10000 个文件的备份夹具中，对比已经完成按需导入的上一候选，三轮完整 CLI 树的最大观测 RSS 为 45,692 → 35,368 KiB、PSS 为 35,099 → 24,824 KiB。最终 GUI 管理全程的完整树观测峰值仍为默认环境 RSS/PSS 59,884/48,651 KiB，明确指定系统 Python 时为 37,948/19,306 KiB；后者是环境条件变化。缺读、主进程、显示服务和观察成本均保留，完整 GUI 低于 10 MiB 仍未完成。0.1.3 报告与安装证据 构建与运行 需要 Git、固定的 Rust 1.100.0 工具链及 C 编译环境。当前 Linux GUI 使用 X11/XWayland、FreeType 和 Fontconfig。Ubuntu/Debian 的开发包通常为 libx11-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev pkg-config；系统发行版的运行时包名可能不同。 git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/zmcl.git cd zmcl cargo build --release --locked ./target/release/zmcl gui --exit-after-launch 只有 CLI 时可用 cargo build --release --locked --no-default-features。启动器支持 --root DIR 或 ZMCL_HOME 选择数据目录；运行 zmcl doctor 查看系统程序与 Java 状态。文件助手要求 Python 3.8+；Windows 会尝试 py -3、python、python3，其他平台尝试 python3、python。ZMCL_PYTHON 可指定一个解释器可执行文件路径，含空格的路径作为单个参数处理。默认数据目录为 Linux 的 XDG data/zmcl、macOS 的 Application Support/zmcl、Windows 的 LocalAppData/zmcl。 已记录的真实游戏与桌面验收在 Linux x86_64 完成。预编译包的 glibc 和 Fontconfig 下限由实际 ELF 符号生成，见包内 release.json；源码支持的条件分支不代表预编译程序兼容同样的旧运行库。较旧发行版可在本机构建，并验证运行条件。符号要求不能替代完整发行版兼容性验收；Windows GNU 完整 GUI 已正常跨编译；zgpui 0.1.5 的 Windows/macOS 原生探针已在对应系统运行。zmcl 的原生 Windows 构建、安装、窗口和卸载由独立发行工作流记录实际结果；请查看对应版本的验收范围。macOS 应用流程与 Windows/macOS 的真实游戏启动仍待验收。 常用操作 以下示例中的 zmcl 可替换为 ./target/release/zmcl。 zmcl versions zmcl instance create demo --version 1.21.1 --loader fabric zmcl instance set demo --memory 2048 zmcl install demo zmcl mods search modmenu --version 1.21.1 --loader fabric zmcl mods add demo modmenu zmcl mods update demo zmcl mods disable demo modmenu zmcl mods enable demo modmenu zmcl launch demo --offline Player 离线名称是显式选择的单人游戏身份。Microsoft 设备登录使用自己的已注册应用 Client ID 和操作系统凭据库： zmcl auth login --client-id YOUR_REGISTERED_CLIENT_ID zmcl account list zmcl launch demo --account YOUR_PROFILE_UUID 真实正版账号的完整登录链路需要注册应用和用户登录，本轮未以真实账号验收。不会把刷新令牌退回明文文件保存。 Mod 更新会重新检查必需依赖与已声明冲突，完成下载后再提交。mods remove 拒绝移除仍被依赖的项目；mods recover 用带身份校验的事务记录恢复中断操作，无法确认归属时保留现场。 Java、存档与实例 zmcl java list zmcl java install 21 zmcl world list demo zmcl world import demo /path/to/world "My World" zmcl world export demo "My World" /path/to/world.zip zmcl backup create demo before-upgrade zmcl backup list demo zmcl backup restore demo BACKUP_ID zmcl instance clone demo demo-copy zmcl install demo-copy zmcl instance trash demo-copy zmcl instance trash-list zmcl instance restore TRASH_ID 安装游戏时会选择所需 Java 主版本；未找到且没有显式 --java 配置时，自动下载并验证官方 Temurin JRE。本轮已实际安装 Java 21，并为 Minecraft 26.3 自动补齐 Java 25。launch 仅使用已有运行时。 克隆会独立复制可变游戏文件，并要求重新执行 install 来关联共享运行文件。移入回收站不会删除共享内容，恢复不会覆盖同名实例。存档导入和 ZIP 导出拒绝覆盖已有目标，备份恢复会先保留恢复前快照。这些修改操作会检查运行状态和未完成事务；实例运行时不会提交配置或游戏文件变更。 资源包与光影包 zmcl resources search resourcepack "No Pumpkin Blur" --version 1.21.1 zmcl resources add demo resourcepack no-pumpkin-blur zmcl resources search shader "Potato" --version 1.21.1 zmcl resources add demo shader terders-potato-shader zmcl resources list demo zmcl resources update demo zmcl resources disable demo resourcepack no-pumpkin-blur zmcl resources history demo zmcl resources restore demo REVISION 资源文件校验摘要、大小与 ZIP 结构，使用独立锁文件记录归属。启用与禁用控制游戏能否发现文件，游戏内选择保持由玩家完成；光影所需的 Iris/OptiFine 等引擎要另行安装。更新和删除保留恢复历史，尚未提供历史自动清理策略。 整合包与本地服务器 zmcl pack search "Simply Optimized" --version 1.21.1 zmcl pack install sop-continued pack-demo --pack-version TAU7qd8y zmcl pack import /path/to/pack.mrpack imported-demo zmcl install imported-demo zmcl pack export pack-demo /path/to/export.mrpack zmcl server create local-test --version 1.21.1 zmcl server install local-test zmcl server status local-test zmcl server ping 127.0.0.1 25565 在线整合包安装会记录精确项目、版本和来源。.mrpack 支持 Vanilla、Fabric、Quilt、Forge、NeoForge 的 loader 字段；其下载校验 SHA-1 与大小，导出时计算 SHA-1 和 SHA-512。CurseForge/FTB 等其他格式仍未实现，详见功能对照。 本地服务器默认绑定回环地址，并保留 eula=false。运行服务器前由用户阅读并设置其 EULA；启动器不代替用户接受。Linux 的启动/停止会核对进程身份，其他平台的进程管理仍待实机验证。 Horizon zmcl horizon versions zmcl horizon install zmcl horizon list zmcl horizon launch INSTALL_ID 这里管理的是 Horizon 官方项目 的 launcher 组件，不是可脱离官方资源准备流程独立运行的裸 game 包。发行包核对官方 Ed25519 签名、SHA-256 和平台；安装版本并存，数据放在独立 provider 目录。官方启动器负责正版身份与 Minecraft 26.3 资源准备，Horizon 不能直接运行 Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 的 Java 模组。签名验证需要支持 Ed25519 的系统 OpenSSL。 文档与验证 架构和边界 XMCL 功能对照与验收记录 0.1.3 AUR、管理助手内存与安装后验收 0.1.2 GUI、跨平台与性能迭代 实际安装、启动与恢复验收 资源占用及测量方法 维护与传播规则 GitHub Pages 站点源码 cargo test --workspace --locked cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings python3 -B src/content/test_archive.py python3 -B src/java/test_extract.py python3 -B src/server/test_process.py python3 -B src/backup/test_archive.py python3 -B src/worlds/test_manage.py python3 -B src/horizon/test_archive.py python3 -B scripts/test_bench_linux.py 发行端通过固定版本的 zdistro 和 scripts/zdistro_package.py 生成并校验软件包；使用方法见分发说明。scripts/install.py 提供用户级安装和清单校验卸载，保留游戏数据和用户修改过的安装文件。 本项目并非 Mojang/Microsoft 官方产品，也不是 XMCL 或 Horizon 的官方发行版。各上游项目和游戏资源保留各自许可。

title: 安装 zmcl
body: 基于 Project Z 的原生 Minecraft 启动器。 安装 zmcl 0.1.4 开发预览提供 Linux x86_64 的 tar.gz、DEB，以及 Windows amd64 的 ZIP。 按下表选择一种安装方式。macOS 暂无发行包；Java 和 Minecraft 内容由启动器另行安装。 选择下载 系统与用途 官方下载 文件大小 Linux x86_64，安装到自己的目录 tar.gz 用户安装包 700,244 字节 满足运行库要求的 Debian 系统，交给 apt 管理 DEB 软件包 571,108 字节 Windows amd64，安装到自己的目录 ZIP 用户安装包 670,411 字节 发行页为 GitHub v0.1.4，本次发行的源码固定为 25c243a。三个下载包的 SHA-256 如下；校验通过后再解包或安装。 8265e672ef7914362c1038b71ed382d18efafe49668d7791005713faa5f580f1 zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz c19afcdd4e567ffcb580f60fbe5812d6915c12b484e9751518c3f0b790c5b7b8 zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.deb 48bd7dc7ce0eb799fed225678b6a6d9c4ed518f7ee96482b2c5c1f0f516271cf zmcl-0.1.4-windows-amd64.zip AUR zmcl-bin 已公开 0.1.4-1 配方，源码为 a769068256b4aa0803ab08b7f0691a8a4024a464。Arch 用户可用 paru -S zmcl-bin 或 yay -S zmcl-bin 安装，再用 zmcl --version 核对实际程序。此处已确认公开配方；公开新克隆构建、本机升级与已安装界面验收已通过，真实官方更新查询返回当前 0.1.4。0.1.3 及更早版本的安装与验证记录保留在文末历史区。 先检查运行条件 条件 Linux x86_64 预编译包 libc glibc 2.39 或更新 字体库与字体 Fontconfig 2.17.0 或更新、FreeType、系统 TrueType/OpenType 字体 窗口系统 X11；Wayland 桌面需要 XWayland 下载与文件任务 curl、CA 证书、Python 3.8 或更新 Microsoft 凭据 可选的 libsecret-tools／secret-tool 与桌面 Secret Service Horizon 验签 可选 OpenSSL，需支持 Ed25519 Linux 默认使用 CPU 绘制，预编译程序没有直接 OpenGL 依赖。glibc 与 Fontconfig 下限来自实际 ELF 符号引用；它们同样适用于 DEB。DEB 已在 Debian forky/sid 容器验收，不能据此视为兼容任意 Debian 稳定版或 Ubuntu 版本。 不满足依赖时，请使用适合目标系统的源码构建，不要强制忽略包依赖。 Windows ZIP 需要 amd64 系统和 Python 3.8 或更新；下面使用 Python launcher 的 py -3。若该命令不可用，先检查已安装 Python 的版本，再用相应的 python 命令替代。Windows 原生构建、安装和窗口验收在 build 26100 的 runner 上通过，尚未覆盖所有 Windows 版本，也未在本轮验证 Windows 的真实游戏或账号流程。 Linux：安装到自己的目录 下载 tar.gz 后，在其所在目录核对摘要并解包： printf '%s %s\n' \ '8265e672ef7914362c1038b71ed382d18efafe49668d7791005713faa5f580f1' \ 'zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - tar -xzf zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz cd zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64 python3 scripts/install.py install --prefix "$HOME/.local" "$HOME/.local/bin/zmcl" --version "$HOME/.local/bin/zmcl" gui 默认前缀也是 ~/.local。想使用另一目录时，将安装、启动、更新和卸载命令中的前缀保持一致；有空格的目录应始终加引号： python3 scripts/install.py install --prefix "$HOME/Applications/zmcl portable" "$HOME/Applications/zmcl portable/bin/zmcl" gui 安装器完成后会显示版本、安装位置、直接启动命令和更新方式。它不会改写 PATH 或 shell 配置。直接使用安装器给出的完整路径，即可打开本次安装的程序。 Debian：使用 apt 管理 下载 DEB 后先校验，再让 apt 检查并安装实际依赖： printf '%s %s\n' \ 'c19afcdd4e567ffcb580f60fbe5812d6915c12b484e9751518c3f0b790c5b7b8' \ 'zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.deb' | sha256sum -c - dpkg-deb -f ./zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.deb Package Version Architecture Depends sudo apt install --no-install-recommends ./zmcl-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.deb /usr/bin/zmcl --version /usr/bin/zmcl gui ca-certificates 是显式依赖。验收使用原本没有 CA 证书的最小 Debian 镜像，以上不安装推荐包的方式仍会自动安装必需证书；随后严格验证 GitHub HTTPS 和真实手动更新查询均通过。实际安装结果与边界见0.1.4 发行报告。 今后下载新版 DEB，校验后用相同的 apt install ./文件名.deb 升级。卸载使用： sudo apt remove zmcl apt 管理系统程序和附带文件，用户的实例、存档、下载缓存和账号资料不属于该软件包的文件清单。 Windows：安装到自己的目录 在 PowerShell 中进入 ZIP 所在目录。先将结果与上面的 Windows SHA-256 核对，再解包和安装： Get-FileHash .\zmcl-0.1.4-windows-amd64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 Expand-Archive .\zmcl-0.1.4-windows-amd64.zip -DestinationPath . Set-Location .\zmcl-0.1.4-windows-amd64 py -3 scripts/install.py install --prefix "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\zmcl" & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\zmcl\bin\zmcl.exe" --version & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\zmcl\bin\zmcl.exe" gui 安装器会保留 bin\zmcl.exe 的扩展名，完整路径可直接运行。自定义目录同样需要加引号。ZIP 安装器不修改系统 PATH；不要依靠另一份同名程序来判断本次安装是否成功。 命令打开了旧版本时 安装器会检查当前 PATH。如果 PATH 先找到另一份 zmcl，完成提示会同时列出那份程序和本次安装程序的位置，并给出本次程序的直接启动命令。它不会删除另一份安装。 Linux 可用 command -v zmcl，PowerShell 可用 Get-Command zmcl -All 查看命令选择。之后用完整路径运行 --version，并在 GUI 的 Settings 页顶部版本信息卡片核对当前版本、可执行文件位置和安装来源。若选择了不同前缀，更新时也应指向那个前缀。 手动检查和安装更新 打开 Settings → Check for updates，启动器才会查询官方 GitHub 发行信息。页面会区分有新版本、已经最新，以及本机版本比线上版本新；网络失败可以重试。找到更新后可打开官方发行页；打开失败时保留结果与链接提示。 检查更新不会替换正在运行的程序。关闭 zmcl 后，按安装来源完成更新： tar.gz 或 ZIP：下载并校验新版，在新版解包目录运行安装器，使用与原来相同的 --prefix。 DEB：用 apt 安装新版 DEB。 AUR：确认公开配方版本后，按包管理器流程更新。 安装器依据受管文件清单和摘要检查旧文件。如果程序、图标、桌面文件或安装信息文件已被修改，会拒绝覆盖并说明冲突；先备份和处理该文件，再重试。不要通过删除安装清单来绕过保护。正常升级不清除已有实例、存档、Java、下载缓存或账号资料。 用户安装的卸载与信息文件 保留解包目录中的安装器，使用安装时的同一前缀卸载： python3 scripts/install.py uninstall --prefix "$HOME/.local" py -3 scripts/install.py uninstall --prefix "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\zmcl" 卸载只删除这次安装清单中摘要仍匹配的受管文件。修改过的受管文件、非受管文件以及游戏数据会保留；目录内有其他文件时不会整目录删除。 <prefix>/share/zmcl/installation.json 记录版本、便携安装渠道、前缀、可执行文件位置和官方发行页；distribution.json 说明 zdistro 的打包格式与身份。install.json 继续使用旧版兼容的严格列表格式，记录每个受管文件的路径和摘要，新安装信息文件也纳入保护。GUI 会校验来源信息；无法验证来源时显示未知／源码构建，不凭目录名猜测安装来源。旧合法格式仍可安装，无法验证版本的旧包会明确显示未知。 0.1.4 验收范围 发行报告与结构化回执记录三个资产的身份、安装和更新流程。Linux 在 Debian forky/sid 容器中通过实际 0.1.3 → 0.1.4 升级、重装、卸载；用户安装通过带空格前缀、PATH 被旧程序遮蔽、九组原生 GUI 夹具和数据保留检查。正式发布前的一次真实更新查询正确识别本机 0.1.4 高于线上 0.1.3，查询前后二进制未改变。 Windows 原生 workflow 44739704182在 build 26100 runner 上通过 MSVC 构建、ZIP 包、私有目录安装、--version、Win32 窗口、五项受管文件与卸载数据保留检查。两平台的窗口及文件夹具不等同于真实账号登录、游戏下载或实际游戏游玩。 主程序 文件大小 SHA-256 Linux ELF 1,504,616 字节 586968d15c5187c0223d5223294ddcba585789d93934e6a37a3c7e1c516a3615 Windows PE 1,382,912 字节 33164565b43bf2f9db63da8e61db2a211318ca2fa682fd29ef988e910612910f 文件大小不含系统库、Java、游戏和缓存，也不是运行内存。完整 GUI 低于 10 MiB 的目标仍未完成；既有测量保留原版本与场景，见性能记录。 历史发行与验收记录 以下保留当时的说明与原始版本；其中“当前”“本次”均指该历史发行。 Arch Linux / AUR zmcl-bin 当前为 0.1.3-1 开发预览，安装官方 Linux x86_64 预编译程序、桌面入口和图标。公开 AUR master 为 60c9ad8e1be8204c6a4e0024c83a4a5851ada0f5。 公共 HTTPS 新克隆构建、正常系统升级和安装后六组原生 GUI 流程均已通过。 本机已从 0.1.2-1 升级到 0.1.3-1，19 个受管文件、0 个改动，已安装程序版本、大小和摘要与官方包一致。首次 RPC、yay、paru 查询曾命中 0.1.2-1 缓存；2026-11-20 **19:46:59（Asia/Taipei）**复验均为 0.1.3-1。完整回执 yay -S zmcl-bin # 或 paru -S zmcl-bin 按已核验的公开 Git 配方安装： git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/zmcl-bin.git cd zmcl-bin makepkg -si 安装后在应用菜单打开 zmcl，或运行 zmcl gui。用 zmcl --version 核对版本，zmcl doctor --json 检查运行条件。更新与卸载由包管理器管理： yay -Syu sudo pacman -R zmcl-bin 包管理器管理程序、桌面入口、图标、许可证和说明文件，不管理用户的 Minecraft 实例、存档和账号资料。0.1.0 的隔离安装、重装、卸载及合成存档保护检查保留在历史记录；0.1.1
