Engines and framework Component Responsibility zinput Composition buffer, focused context, candidates, commit lifecycle and engine interface zinput-x11 XIM transport, key repeat, XKB map changes and native candidate positioning zinput-wayland input-method-v2, virtual-keyboard-v1, preedit/commit, state and popup surface ztype Vocabulary, ranking, user preferences, editing, candidate content and service installation zgpui Native graphics and candidate text rendering Native services support pinyin, kana and table engines. Kana is romaji transliteration without kanji conversion. Unicode-scalar conversion, literal UTF-8 and explicitly trusted native plugins are available through the CLI or optional panel. The standalone panel has its own controls and is not required for normal input. Environment Scope Linux X11 / XWayland XIM implemented; real Ztty versions are covered by current acceptance tests Hyprland / input-method-v2 compositors Protocol path implemented; actual tested applications and settings are listed in the acceptance record KDE Plasma native Wayland Its input-method-v1 frontend is not implemented GNOME native Wayland GNOME/IBus integration is not implemented Windows / macOS Portable components and historical build checks exist; TSF and InputMethodKit IME frontends are not implemented Distribution portability depends on the listed build/runtime libraries. Desktop compatibility depends on compositor and client input protocols. These are separate requirements. Protocol references: KDE Plasma Keyboard and IBus Wayland desktop documentation. Verification cargo test --all-targets --locked cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings python3 scripts/test_install.py python3 scripts/test_daily_input.py --binary target/release/ztype Native tests verify actual UTF-8 received by applications, candidate pixels, focus transitions and process cleanup. The tests run their own display sessions and do not need to replace the user's active input method. The current record documents commands, tested versions, evidence and remaining limitations. Earlier panel, plugin and platform results remain in historical verification; they are not presented as fresh native-IME acceptance. The 0.4.0 daily-input record remains available for the previous dependency and application baseline. The 0.2.1 interactive trial record remains available as historical evidence.

title: Native service installation
body: Linux 原生输入法，在应用中组合拼音、显示候选并提交文字。 Native service installation Ztype installs one service for each native frontend compiled into the supplied binary. ztype-wayland.service handles Wayland text-input clients; ztype-x11.service handles X11 and XWayland clients through XIM. Install or upgrade cargo build --release --locked python3 scripts/install_dictionary.py --source rime-ice python3 scripts/install.py --binary target/release/ztype --activate ztype status Install a public vocabulary before activating pinyin. The dictionary installer verifies a pinned source revision, keeps the original license and writes to the XDG data directory. ztype config shows which files the foreground commands and services will load. An explicit --dict can select a different vocabulary. --activate enables the services matching the current display session and restarts them with the installed executable. Restarting during an upgrade replaces any process still running the previous binary. Without --activate, the installer writes files and reloads user unit definitions; it leaves activation to ztype start. The service waits for a readiness datagram from its main process after dictionary loading, engine initialization and native registration. Startup fails if readiness does not arrive within 30 seconds. Use ztype restart after changing configuration. ztype stop and ztype status also work from a terminal without graphical display variables. A failed or still-starting service produces an error with its actual state. status reports an older or different running executable and includes the systemd result and exit code when a service fails. Paths and existing configuration Artifact User installation Staging with --prefix /path Executable ~/.local/bin/ztype /path/bin/ztype Desktop entry $XDG_DATA_HOME/applications/ztype.desktop /path/share/applications/ztype.desktop Service units $XDG_DATA_HOME/systemd/user/ /path/share/systemd/user/ Configuration $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ztype/config /path/etc/ztype/config Unset or relative XDG paths use ~/.local/share and ~/.config. The installer creates a commented configuration example with mode 0600 only when the configuration path is absent. Existing files and symlinks are preserved. A staging prefix never controls the running user service manager or writes to the user's XDG directories. start and restart import the current display connection and explicitly present XDG configuration/data/state paths and ZTYPE_CONFIG into the user service manager. The foreground wayland and x11 commands and the installed services read the same Ztype configuration. Application connection Wayland applications need the compositor's text-input support. X11 and XWayland applications select the XIM endpoint through XMODIFIERS=@im=ztype, or the name configured by ZTYPE_XIM_NAME. Apply this variable in the desktop session before launching those applications. Already-running applications retain their launch environment. The service manager controls process lifecycle and prevents duplicate starts of the same unit. A running service's status describes the process; actual application input is checked by the native Wayland and XIM acceptance tests. Targeted checks python3 scripts/test_install.py --binary target/release/ztype cargo test --bin ztype service::tests Installer tests use temporary paths and a substituted service manager. They cover upgrades, simultaneous Wayland/XWayland activation, XDG directories, configuration preservation and isolated staging. Service tests cover restart, exit-state diagnostics, stale-executable detection, and stop/status without a display connection.

title: Ztype 0.2.1 安装与实测记录
body: Linux 原生输入法，在应用中组合拼音、显示候选并提交文字。 Ztype 0.2.1 安装与实测记录 日期：2026-11-20（Asia/Taipei） 现在怎么用 Ztype 0.2.1 已安装到 ~/.local/bin/ztype，可用 ztype --version 查看版本。当前桌面的 ztype-wayland.service 正在运行；独立体验窗口通过 ztype try 打开。两种入口的用途如下。 想做什么 使用方式 在独立窗口里体验输入、选词和删除 运行 ztype try，或打开菜单中的 Ztype 输入试用 在当前桌面的应用里输入 保持 ztype-wayland.service 运行，在支持原生 Wayland text-input 的输入框中输入 使用原有 X11/XWayland 候选面板 运行 ztype panel 只把拼音转换成文本 运行 ztype convert --text nihao 在当前 Wayland 会话中，不带参数的 ztype 会打开试用窗口。这修正了此前默认进入 X11 面板、出现 “Cannot open X11 display” 的使用障碍。试用需要安装辅助组件；本次已一并安装。 点击试用输入框，输入下面的拼音，然后按空格： 键入内容 确认后的文字 nihao 你好 woxiangceshishuruxiaoguo 我想测试输入效果 jixushiyongzhongwenshurufa 继续使用中文输入法 按键 行为 Space / Enter 确认当前候选 Tab / Shift+Tab 切换下一项 / 上一项 Backspace 删除最后一个输入字符 Escape 取消尚未确认的组合 Ctrl+Space 切换组合输入和直接输入 Ctrl+Q 关闭试用窗口 试用窗口还提供 清空 和 结束试用 按钮。关闭后，其自有输入法、窗口和嵌套桌面进程会退出。普通试用不保存输入内容；自动验收仅通过显式 --state 保存合成测试文本。 其他引擎入口： ztype try --engine kana ztype try --engine table --dict phrases.tsv 本轮改变 增加可直接使用的原生试用入口。 安装器现在可通过 --with-trial 安装 GTK 输入窗口、启动辅助程序和桌面菜单。试用使用独立的 Wayland 连接和会话，不改变当前桌面的输入法服务。正常试用接受用户键盘输入；自动验收模式禁用嵌套桌面继承的键盘和指针，防止真人操作与合成按键混入同一测试。 修复假名组合的容量处理。 ASCII 罗马字转换成假名后，UTF-8 字节数会增长。原来只按原始输入长度限制，可能让转换结果超过前端容量。本轮在接受编辑前核对展开后的大小；超限时保留原组合与已选候选，允许继续退格修改。相关回归测试覆盖小缓冲区、多字符按键和超过引擎容量的展开。 扩充原创入门词表。 内置拼音词条从 82 条增加到 114 条，增加输入、测试和反馈相关常用词。示例句由已知词组合成，未把整句作为固定答案。无法完整识别的输入，例如 woxiangceshixyz，仍完整保留原文。 修正自动验收的焦点回执。 原 GTK 接收程序在本地切换焦点后就确认控制命令。本轮在确认前完成一次 GDK 显示同步，让显示服务器先处理已发送的输入目的和状态，再允许测试键盘开始下一段输入。所有密码框、焦点切换、快捷键和只读断言保留。该同步保证的是发送方请求到达显示服务器；不把它描述成所有应用与输入法之间的全局就绪保证。GDK 官方说明 实测结果 以下结果来自本轮安装的 0.2.1 二进制。最终原生 GTK 与 foot 验收未启用协议追踪，输入来自独立虚拟键盘，目标是自有嵌套 Wayland 会话中的真实应用。 检查 结果 证据 Rust 测试 39 项通过：17 项增量控制、19 项组合、3 项插件契约 Rust 日志 Clippy 通过，release / all-targets，警告视为错误 Clippy 日志 格式检查 通过 汇总 安装后 CLI 14 项通过，包括实际原生插件加载 CLI 结果 安装后的试用窗口 13 项通过 交互报告 原生 GTK 输入 14 项通过 GTK 报告 foot 终端输入 通过，真实 TTY 标准输入收到 你好世界 终端报告 重装保持运行状态 通过，二进制内容与 inode、已有服务进程保持一致 安装检查 自有进程清理 通过，自动窗口和自有服务已退出 嵌套会话报告 试用窗口的 13 项检查包括未确认组合、空格提交、连续输入、完整例句、退格、取消、Tab 选词、中英切换、未知尾缀保留，以及 Ctrl+Q 关闭与进程清理。自动验收前后，宿主输入法服务状态和进程一致。 GTK 的 14 项检查还包括数字选词、密码框直接输入、切换焦点丢弃旧组合、Ctrl+A 替换、只读字段不变。终端测试键入的是 ASCII nihaoshijie，通过原生输入法转换，再由 foot 内的 Python 接收程序从真实标准输入读取。收到的 UTF-8 字节为 e4bda0e5a5bde4b896e7958c0a，末尾是换行。 实际截图 下面是自动验收中真实接收窗口和终端的截图。截图内仅有合成测试文本。 原生试用输入框收到我想测试输入效果 foot 标准输入收到你好世界 安装与复现 在包含固定子模块的仓库中： cargo build --release --locked python3 scripts/install.py --binary target/release/ztype --with-trial ztype try 试用需要当前 Wayland 桌面、支持 Lua 配置的 Hyprland、hyprctl、dbus-run-session、Python 3 和 GTK 3。安装时还需要 C 编译器、pkg-config 与 GTK 3 开发文件。完整 GUI 构建的其余依赖见 README。 复现自动验收时，为输出选择尚未使用的目录： cargo test --locked cargo clippy --release --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings cargo fmt --all -- --check python3 scripts/test_trial.py --binary ~/.local/bin/ztype --output .build/trial-reproduction python3 scripts/test_wayland_nested.py --binary ~/.local/bin/ztype --output .build/native-reproduction --terminal --screenshot 图形验收会在当前桌面显示临时窗口，完成后自动关闭。普通使用不需要运行这些验收脚本。 本次安装写入六个文件：主程序、通用菜单、Wayland 用户服务、试用辅助程序、GTK 接收程序、专用试用菜单。完整列表见 安装记录。 验收时的服务状态是：Ztype active / disabled，Fcitx5 inactive / enabled。前者表示 Ztype 当前运行、尚未设为自启动。用户已在本轮手动启动原生服务；安装新版后刷新过该服务，随后重装辅助组件保留了原进程。本轮没有更改自启动选择。 管理当前桌面的服务： systemctl --user start ztype-wayland.service systemctl --user stop ztype-wayland.service 如需恢复本机原先的 Fcitx5： systemctl --user stop ztype-wayland.service systemctl --user start fcitx5.service 范围与限制 本轮验证环境是 Linux、Hyprland 0.57.2、原生 GTK 3 和 foot；二进制同时包含 GUI、desktop、plugins 和 Wayland 功能。当前选中候选显示在输入框的预编辑位置，尚无独立 Wayland 候选弹窗。 114 条词表适合框架验证和上述例句，词汇覆盖与整句预测尚未达到成熟中文输入法的水平。应用是否接收原生输入仍取决于 compositor 协议和应用的 text-input 接入。本报告不把 GTK 与 foot 的通过外推到全部浏览器、Qt、Electron、终端或其他桌面。Windows TSF、macOS InputMethodKit 和 XIM 仍未实现。 源码与证据标识 核心修复与词表：36d217a 0.2.1 原生试用入口：a8d9b29 验收焦点同步：b55b980 安装二进制 SHA-256：d39571c75b308aa5d24ed339fdf71756c7cc7f23e378aa3d1d1792a9eaa63440 结构化汇总 公开证据保留测试输入、结果和内容指纹；本机用户名、临时进程标识与原始桌面日志未纳入公开报告。

title: ztype 0.4.2：候选界面与 ztty 输入验收
body: Linux 原生输入法，在应用中组合拼音、显示候选并提交文字。 ztype 0.4.2：候选界面与 ztty 输入验收 本轮把原生候选界面接到当前 Git 依赖基线，并分别验证 X11/XIM 与原生 Wayland 的 ztty 输入。运行时代码固定于 053eb39eb115decc0cb046e901598cf0bc4645fb；后续测试与文档提交不改变该提交的 Rust 源码及 Cargo 文件。完整文件哈希、二进制哈希和分阶段结果见机器可读验收记录。 界面变化 候选正文为 16 px，页内序号为 12 px，预编辑标题为 14 px；面板左右留白为 20 px，候选行高为 40 px。窗口宽度仍限制在 248–640 px，长候选只在显示时省略，提交文本保持完整。选中项同时使用浅蓝背景和加粗正文，数字选词、分页及焦点处理沿用原有行为。 浅色主题采用 Material 3 的语义颜色角色：表面 #F8FAFD、正文 #1F1F1F、次要文字 #5F6368、选中表面 #D3E3FD、选中文字 #041E49。四组实际文字配色的对比度分别为 15.764、5.786、12.568 和 4.919，均高于小字号文字的 4.5:1 目标。候选像素保持完全不透明，适配 X11 depth-24 与 Wayland surface。 依据为 Google 的 Material 3 主题、颜色和字体说明及文字对比度指导。具体字号、留白和配色是本项目对原生桌面输入法的选择。本轮覆盖浅色主题、1 倍缩放及记录中的实际画面，不能据此推断所有缩放比例、暗色主题或其他平台均已验收。 ztty 首字丢失的原因与修复 原生 Wayland 中，连续输入 nihaoshijie 曾得到 ihaoshijie。协议日志显示，首个 n 已产生预编辑“你”，随后收到 text_change_cause(OTHER) 和 done，组合被清空；余下字母重新组成并作为原文提交。该问题发生在 IME 形成提交文本之前。 终端更新光标矩形只是在报告位置。修复在即时光标更新和等待确认后的延迟更新中，显式使用 INPUT_METHOD 作为这类批次的原因，避免已有 OTHER 标记再次使输入法丢弃组合。首次启用、真实外部编辑、焦点切换、serial/ack 和 UTF-8 提交逻辑保持原来的语义。 Wayland text-input-v3 协议规定 change cause 在每次 commit 后恢复默认值。这里记录的是对实际组合中观察到的 OTHER 重用所作的客户端兼容处理；没有把所有合成器归为同一种行为。修复源码与实际使用的 ztty ELF 身份保留在验收记录中。 修复由 ztty PR #23 提供，实际验收源码为 076bc6ac8ff9ca17effe25decac7a4dbc4ec0c43。同一连续输入在修复前的两份二进制上均复现首字丢失；修复后的真实 PTY 收到“你好世界”，UTF-8 为 e4bda0e5a5bde4b896e7958c0a（末尾为换行）。最终使用的 ztty ELF SHA-256 为 c5debb5f35d2563e1a3cdf7eeb18bb064439c864ad020fd452f0c730afc61197。 验收范围 检查 结果 Rust 全目标测试 72 通过；1 项需单独安装完整词库的测试按原规则跳过 Clippy 与 release 构建 通过；记录了实际根 crate 的 clippy-driver 调用和 fresh=false 的编译产物 日常输入检查 8 通过，服务管理器使用测试替身 安装器测试 15 通过 X11/XIM 到 ztty 13/13 通过，使用修复后的同一 ztty ELF Wayland GTK 原生输入与候选 28 通过 原生 Wayland ztty 7/7 通过；原生 Wayland 窗口、真实 PTY 收到“你好世界” 候选窗界面检查 真实 X11、Wayland 截图；候选文字、编号、选中态和不透明边缘已检查 XIM 验收通过独立 Xvfb、XTEST 和真实 PTY，包含后启动输入服务、多窗口焦点、数字选择、候选窗显示/关闭、服务停止时普通按键及重启重连。ztty 的 XIM 客户端未提供字符 spot 时使用窗口边缘回退位置，本轮不宣称该路径跟随终端内的字符光标。 Wayland 验收使用独立 Weston headless → Hyprland、私有 socket 和虚拟键盘。ztty 窗口通过 broker 的 Unix peer credential、可执行文件和进程身份绑定，再核对实际 Wayland 窗口、候选状态与 PTY 收据。输入仍为连续的 nihaoshijie → Space → Return，没有添加延时来改变通过条件。测试结束后核对本轮进程清理和二进制哈希。修复前后两份收据的第三个脚本条目覆盖不同；共同的 nested runner 与 ztty helper 哈希完全相同，命令仅改变输出目录和 ztty 二进制路径。具体差异见收据补充说明，原收据保持原样。 原生 Wayland ztty 的提交前截图中，终端自己的行内预编辑曾覆盖提示行开头；提交后提示行恢复，中文出现在下一行。测试接收器的就绪标记与终端绘制之间仍存在时序差异，本轮未确定这个视觉偏移的原因。真实 PTY 提交和候选窗检查通过，终端行内预编辑的视觉定位保留为待核对项。 测试合成器复用了固定哈希的私有 Aquamarine 兼容库，仅用于子进程；系统库保持原样。当前桌面的 Fcitx5、输入法配置及已安装 ztype 不在本轮切换范围内。PNG 和 ELF 留作本地验收产物，Git 只保存源码、文字说明及哈希记录。 复现 先准备带 Wayland 支持的 ztty 和本轮 ztype 二进制，在具备测试工具的 Linux 环境运行： python3 scripts/test_wayland_nested.py \ --binary "$ZTYPE_BINARY" \ --ztty-binary "$ZTTY_BINARY" \ --output "$ZTYPE_PROOF" \ --headless --popup --screenshot --trace-events \ --aquamarine-library "$ZTYPE_TEST_AQUAMARINE" 测试输出包括整体报告、真实终端收据、协议日志和候选截图。日常安装与输入法服务配置仍见安装与服务。

title: 概览
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 zuse 为 agent 设计的电脑操作语言、Rust 库、命令行程序与 MCP 服务。 zuse 把小段程序变成电脑观察与操作，支持桌面、浏览器、移动设备、串口和 USB。程序先计算坐标、展开有界控制流，再执行输入；常驻会话保留状态，供外部控制器逐步观察和决策。 English · 语法 · 数值程序 · 常驻会话 · 协议 v1 · 平台能力 安装与使用 cargo install --git https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/zuse --locked zuse doctor zuse schema zuse eval 'window.list()' zuse script examples/scoped-mice.zuse --dry-run zuse shell Rust 要求 1.100 或更高版本。Cargo 包名为 zuse-computer，项目、库导入名和可执行文件都叫 zuse。crates.io 的短包名已被其他项目注册。 更新命令 zuse update --check # 查询最新稳定版，不安装 zuse update --dry-run # 返回具体更新命令，不安装 zuse update # 更新有 Cargo 所属记录的用户安装 更新器通过 curl 与 Cargo 核对安装来源，保留安装目录、features、profile 和 target，选择精确的稳定版本或官方 Git 标签；较新的开发版本保留。系统/AUR 安装使用包管理器，便携、自定义及固定 revision 的安装返回手动说明。stdout 返回 JSON，stderr 显示进度与错误；详见更新行为。 下面的普通命令示例明确选择用户的系统鼠标： mouse.use(kind="user", appearance="system") mouse.move(x=400, y=240, duration=350, curve="smooth", jitter=0.6, seed=42) mouse.click(button="left") keyboard.type(text="你好") wait(min=80, max=160, seed=42) screen.capture(path="desktop.png") mouse.release() zuse check 文件.zuse 或 --dry-run 返回执行计划；--read-only 拒绝输入、程序启动、JavaScript 执行和设置修改。运行时先检查整个程序，再执行第一步；执行失败时返回已完成步骤并停止。 目标点移动及 mouse.click_at 默认使用 350 ms、curve="smooth" 和 0.6 px 抖动，接近终点时抖动归零。常规移动保持平滑，提速优先合并调用；duration=0 留给明确选择的瞬移操作。 数值程序与绘图 短程序直接交给 zuse -c '源码'，多行源码使用 zuse script -： zuse script - --dry-run <<'ZUSE' let size = 80 for i in 0..3 { let x = 40 + i*100 draw.triangle(x1=x,y1=100,x2=x+size,y2=100,x3=x+size/2,y3=20) } ZUSE 不可变 let、算术、比较、if/else、整数半开 for、纯数学函数和递归均在准备阶段求值。每个循环最多 4096 次，调用深度最多 32，展开工作最多 16384 次；非法计算在输入前失败。见数值语法与递归分形示例。 draw.triangle 将三个数值顶点连成一笔闭合描边。执行前选好应用画笔，并按真实窗口绑定 anchor.set；mouse.click_at、mouse.stroke 和 draw.* 校验窗口身份、焦点、几何与缩放。同窗标签页共用 ID；看到用户切页时停止后续输入，重新观察内容。见绘图与锚点。 常驻会话与外部决策 Unix 上的命名会话可跨 CLI 调用保留函数、设备和锚点： zuse session start board --idle-timeout-ms 900000 zuse session observe board - <<'ZUSE' window.list() ZUSE zuse session result board 取得观察结果后，由外部控制器决定下一步，把短程序交给 zuse session script board -，按返回的 job_id 查询结果，再观察。accepted 表示已接收，完成情况以结果回执为准。同一会话一次执行一个作业；status、result、cancel、close 可继续控制当前工作，取消后需查询清理结果。 公开的 JSON-lines 协议 v1 使用 start 返回的私有 Unix socket。稳定请求 ID 用于有界重试，--expect-revision 检查 Zuse 会话状态；应用内容仍需重新观察。该通道执行 flat Runtime 及展开后的数值程序；scoped mouse 仅支持 dry-run 预检。默认空闲 15 分钟释放会话，运行时间不计入空闲；单一 stdin 流仍可使用 zuse shell。支持原生信号处理的构建中，SIGINT 或 SIGTERM 会取消当前工作、清理 shell 持有的运行时与子进程，并丢弃排队命令；空闲等待和未输入完整一行时也会清理退出。详见会话说明与shell 取消。 随附的 Python 控制器示例 从 stdin 提交一次源码，并在同一连接上等到作业终态。它只使用 Python 标准库，接收实际观察到的 socket 路径、执行预算及可选修订号。 可复用函数与本地事件 在同一个 zuse shell 会话中导入一次，后续命令直接调用： import(path="skills/zuse/assets/wechat.zuse", as="wechat") eval(source="fn delay(ms){wait(ms=ms)}", as="local") local.delay(ms=10) 在函数前写连续的 /// 描述，再用 functions(namespace="wechat") 查询限定名称、参数顺序、说明和源码位置。查询只读取已登记的元信息，不调用函数、不重新读取文件。MCP 提供同一个 zuse.functions 目录，Rust 提供类型化的 function_metadata()。可运行 zuse run examples/function-catalog.zuse --read-only 查看完整例子。 微信示例只登记读取、准备文本和发送按钮三个函数；调用前必须从实际应用确认窗口、会话和节点，创建函数不会自动发送消息。也可用 import(source="...", as="模块名") 导入源码。显式 eval 可同时定义函数并执行动作。整段展开结果共用预检查、只读限制和累计预算；预检失败或 dry-run 不提交新定义。文件中的相对导入以该文件目录为基准。 Git 包通过 pkg init/add/install/update/remove/list/publish 管理，zuse.lock.json 固定完整提交。pkg:名称 与 pkg:名称/导出 从已安装的本地源码导入声明。用 pkg install --locked 恢复依赖；见包管理和标准库。 observe、watch、wait_until 默认返回结构化文本，通过局部 DOM 或 AT-SPI 事件等待变化。明确调用 watch_until_click 才把出现事件连接到点击，限定原标签页、域名、容器、次数和超时。timer.start/reset/stop/status 提供每条命令及累计耗时。可选 --features vision 增加多尺度图标匹配与按需渲染的视觉时间切片。完整用法见本地程序说明、Zuse 技能和实测记录。 keyboard.state() 将当前 Wayland 键盘与其它设备分开；文本输入保持锁状态。明确设置 NumLock 使用 keyboard.num_lock(state="on")、off 或 toggle 并读取实际回读。Wayland 的彩色标记跟随共享用户鼠标、点击穿透；独立多鼠标仍依赖 X11 MPX。原生 pinch 不可用时明确返回不支持。 keyboard.hold(key="Up",duration=400) 与 browser.hold(key="ArrowRight",duration=300) 提供有时限的方向键按住与释放，绑定已观察目标并响应取消，见按键保持。ChatGPT 桌面模块提供本地观察、带进程和空编辑器检查的草稿准备，以及需要明确授权的发送函数；目标需暴露原生无障碍接口。 独立鼠标、变量生命周期与并行轨迹 zuse script 让每个鼠标变量拥有自己的位置、按键状态和可见光标，默认创建独立鼠标。Linux 原生 X11 的 XInput2/MPX 提供独立设备身份，因此移动这些鼠标不会移动用户的鼠标。颜色、形状、大小、发光强度和自定义图像都可以设置。 let cyan = mouse(color="#2FE2FF", shape="arrow"); let violet = mouse(color="#B58CFF", shape="ring"); parallel { cyan.move(x=320, y=180, duration=600); violet.move(x=520, y=320, duration=600); } 用 zuse script examples/scoped-mice.zuse --dry-run 预检，在支持的 X11 会话里执行。块和函数拥有局部鼠标，别名与参数借用已有鼠标。sequence 串行执行，parallel 的直接子语句各为一个分支；连续操作放入同一分支块。同一鼠标的并行冲突在输入前拒绝。 普通 mouse.* 动作现在也默认使用独立鼠标。要控制用户鼠标，普通命令先调用 mouse.use(kind="user", appearance="system")，作用域脚本使用 user_mouse(appearance="system")。这一显式系统模式适用于已有的 Wayland、Windows 和 macOS 后端；独立鼠标或自定义原生光标不受支持时直接报错。普通运行时的 mouse.position() 只观察已经选定的鼠标，需要先调用 mouse.use() 或执行一个鼠标动作。 作用域退出、运行错误和协作取消都会触发清理，包括释放程序按住的鼠标键。支持的 Linux 构建中，zuse script 的 SIGINT/SIGTERM 通过取消标记走正常清理路径；SIGKILL、进程崩溃等无法运行析构函数的终止不保证清理。完整语法、Rust 接口、目标定位、外观格式和平台边界见作用域鼠标说明。 移动到文本或按钮 mouse.move_to 一次完成定位和移动：先读取目标的无障碍信息，再获取当前鼠标位置，沿指定轨迹移动到目标中心加偏移的位置。默认耗时 350 毫秒，只移动鼠标。 zuse eval 'mouse.move_to(text="保存",role="button",duration=650,curve="bezier",jitter=1.2,speed_variation=0.25,seed=42,offset_x=4,offset_y=-3)' --dry-run zuse eval 'mouse.move_to(text="继续",role="button",speed=600,via="320,180;480,220")' --dry-run cargo run --example target_motion duration 与 speed 二选一；via 指定绝对坐标，jitter、speed_variation 和 seed 控制可复现轨迹。定位依赖原生无障碍文本，同名目标用 scope 或 index 选择。--dry-run 只校验参数；Rust 示例需 --execute 才输入。路径规划与 Runtime::move_to_with 回调见轨迹说明。 Project Z 结构 基础命令解析器和鼠标轨迹核心支持 no_std，不分配堆内存、零依赖。桌面运行时及作用域脚本的编译器、调度器使用标准库，Rust 依赖树只有 Project Z 自有的 zmcpio、zcall、zconv、zclap、z64、zsys。系统动态库加载复用 zsys 0.1.1；CLI 和 MCP 共用执行器。 鼠标路径包含线性、平滑、缓入缓出和贝塞尔轨迹，支持种子固定的抖动与随机等待。轨迹首尾坐标准确，使用绝对时间安排采样。 motion::FunctionalMotion 在 no_std 核心中接收自定义路径函数；mouse.circle 将完整圆周轨迹安排在一次调用中。定位与桌面事件执行属于启用 std 的运行时。 MCP zuse mcp --stdio zuse mcp --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8377 zuse mcp --socket /run/user/1000/zuse.sock socket 路径请换成自己的运行目录。HTTP 入口为 /mcp，默认仅本机访问；绑定其他网卡需要配置至少 32 字节的 ZUSE_TOKEN。stdio/socket 支持传统初始化流程和当前协议，HTTP 使用 MCP 2026-07-28。 工具包括执行、预检查、能力发现、语法查询、观察、直接返回 PNG 图片、查看人工请求、恢复执行。zuse.script 接收完整作用域脚本及可选的 dry_run、read_only，每次调用返回前清理该次创建的鼠标；zuse.execute 执行普通命令批次。 后台浏览器与无障碍 browser.launch(headless=true) browser.viewport(width=1280, height=800) browser.navigate(url="data:text/html,<input id=message><button id=save>Save</button>") browser.fill(selector="#message", text="你好") browser.snapshot() browser.capture(path="browser.png") browser.close() 浏览器使用原生 CDP 连接和独立临时配置，不依赖 Playwright。截图输出当前视口的 PNG；browser.viewport 按 CSS 像素设置视口大小。browser.fill 遇到密码输入会返回错误，可使用可见浏览器和 human.request 交给本机操作人完成。 Linux 无障碍通过 AT-SPI 读取角色、文本、边界、动作，并支持聚焦、按钮动作和编辑文本。Windows 使用 UI Automation，macOS 使用 Quartz 与 System Events；它们的实机验证范围在平台表中单独列出。 Android 两种模式 android.devices() android.connect(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL", mode="foreground") android.status() android.connect(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL", mode="background", display=4) android.tap(x=240, y=160) 原生 ADB 客户端要求已授权的 ADB server；省略 serial 时需恰有一台就绪设备。前台操作主显示，后台明确选择已有的非零显示，并绑定输入、启动与截图；映射不明确时拒绝。文本支持最多 4096 字节可打印 ASCII，排除 %s，其余输入在预检时拒绝。Android 16 前台、副显示隔离与像素验证见测试流程和设备证据。 手机浏览器、iOS 与设备 I/O android.browser.sockets(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL") browser.connect_android(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL") browser.navigate(url="https://example.com") browser.snapshot() browser.capture(path="phone-browser.png") browser.close() 手机 Chrome 通过原生 ADB 隧道连接可响应的调试 socket，在已有配置中创建并控制一个自有标签页，见手机浏览器。iOS 使用明确配置的本地 WebDriverAgent，支持触摸、Unicode 输入、观察、截图和应用启动；当前验证为协议夹具，物理 iPhone 验证待完成。准备方式见iOS 说明。 serial.ports() usb.devices() 串口通过原生 termios / Win32 COM 接口收发；USB 通过 zsys 加载系统 libusb， 支持 bulk、interrupt 和 control 传输。打开 USB 必须明确指定设备地址、 VID/PID 和接口，不自动分离内核驱动。部分写入会报告已经发送的字节数并停止， 不会自动重发。串口已用 Linux 内核 PTY 实测，USB 传输使用隔离 C ABI 夹具验证， 没有向未知实体设备发送测试命令。详见设备 I/O。 MCP 图片工具支持 source=desktop/browser/android/ios，可以直接把已连接设备的 PNG 返回给 agent。需要跨多条命令保持连接时，使用 zuse shell 或 MCP 服务。 人类协助 human.request(kind="yubikey", message="请触碰安全密钥，完成后确认。", timeout=300) window.list() 人工请求会产生系统通知及请求 ID。操作人执行 zuse human assist ID；完成后通过 MCP 重试或 zuse resume ID 继续。密码请求要求指定窗口，由本机提示框取得并输入该窗口，不进入 MCP 返回值或执行记录。 需要保留浏览器、harness 状态的流程，请运行在持久的 zuse shell 或 MCP 服务中。单次 CLI 退出时会结束自己拥有的浏览器和进程。 开发与发布 python3 scripts/check.py cargo check --no-default-features --lib cargo bench --bench core python3 scripts/bump.py patch --commit --tag --push 工作流支持版本 bump、原子提交/标签推送和五个平台的原生制品。Cargo 发布使用单独验证的源码暂存目录，内部依赖必须与 Git 锁定来源对应的 registry 精确版本及完整发布内容一致。详见 开发说明 与 验证记录。 MIT 开源。

title: zuse
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 zuse An agent-native computer-use shell, Rust library, and MCP server. zuse turns small programs into desktop observations and actions. The same executor drives native windows, Chromium, accessibility trees, mobile devices, serial/USB devices and managed harness processes. Programs calculate coordinates and expand bounded control flow before input; persistent sessions keep runtime state available to external controllers. 中文 · Language · Numeric programs · Sessions · Protocol v1 · Platforms · Releases Small core, explicit effects The flat-call parser and pointer-motion kernel compile with no_std, use no allocator, and have no dependencies. The optional host runtime, including the scoped-script compiler and scheduler, uses Rust's standard library and six Project Z crates across its dependency tree: zmcpio, zcall, zconv, zclap, z64, and zsys. Native dynamic-library loading reuses zsys 0.1.1. There is no embedded JavaScript engine or browser automation framework. The runtime checks the entire program before its first effect. Unknown operations, wrong argument types, duplicate arguments, malformed strings, excessive steps, and excess fixed-duration wait budgets fail before execution. Speed-based target movement is charged to the remaining wait budget after its path is resolved, before sending its first pointer event. Runtime errors return completed steps and stop the remaining program. Execution records omit keyboard input contents. Install Rust 1.100 or newer: cargo install --git https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/zuse --locked zuse --version zuse doctor The Cargo package is zuse-computer; the executable and Rust library are named zuse. The short package name was already registered by another project. Native archives for Linux, Windows, and macOS are published on the Releases page. Extract the matching archive and place its zuse executable on your PATH. Remove that executable to uninstall; Cargo installations use cargo uninstall zuse-computer. Update zuse update --check # Query the latest stable version; do not install zuse update --dry-run # Show the exact update command; do not install zuse update # Update a tracked user Cargo installation The updater uses curl and Cargo, verifies installation ownership, and preserves its root, features, profile and target. It selects an exact stable registry version or official Git release tag and keeps newer development versions. System/AUR installs use their package manager; portable, custom and pinned installs receive manual instructions. JSON goes to stdout; progress and failures go to stderr. See update behavior and verification. Project Z dependencies Project Z dependencies use their GitHub repositories directly. Each currently uses main as its default branch. Refresh the pinned Git commits with cargo update -p zmcpio -p zclap -p z64 -p zsys -p zcall -p zconv, review the lockfile diff, and run the relevant local checks before publishing a refresh. Reproducible builds use --locked. GitHub publishes the native binaries; registry packaging is separate and must not silently substitute a different dependency graph. First program zuse eval 'window.list()' zuse eval 'mouse.move(x=400,y=240,duration=350,curve="smooth",jitter=0.6,seed=42)' --dry-run zuse script examples/scoped-mice.zuse --dry-run zuse run examples/desktop.zuse zuse shell Flat programs use named calls separated by newlines or semicolons. This example explicitly selects the user's system pointer: # Observe before acting. window.list() mouse.use(kind="user", appearance="system") mouse.position() mouse.move(x=400, y=240, duration=350, curve="smooth", jitter=0.6, seed=42) mouse.click(button="left") keyboard.type(text="Hello from zuse") wait(min=80, max=160, seed=42) screen.capture(path="desktop.png") mouse.release() zuse check FILE validates without executing. --read-only permits observation operations, including screenshot artifacts, and rejects input, page JavaScript, process launches, and settings changes. zuse schema prints every supported operation and its arguments. Point moves and mouse.click_at default to 350 ms, curve="smooth" and 0.6 px jitter. Jitter tapers to zero at the endpoints; timed samples avoid accumulated scheduling drift. duration=0 remains an explicit instant-move option. Improve throughput by batching operations while keeping ordinary pointer movement smooth. Bounded programs and drawing Use zuse -c 'CODE' for inline source or zuse script - for stdin. Immutable let values, arithmetic, comparisons, if/else, integer for ranges, pure math helpers and recursive functions expand before execution. A loop permits 4,096 iterations and calls nest at most 32 levels; preparation visits at most 16,384 statements, expressions and loop iterations. Invalid arithmetic fails before input. zuse script - --dry-run <<'ZUSE' let size = 80 for i in 0..3 { let x = 40 + i*100 draw.triangle(x1=x,y1=100,x2=x+size,y2=100,x3=x+size/2,y3=20) } ZUSE draw.triangle draws one closed stroke through three numeric vertices. Choose the application's brush and an observed window anchor before drawing. mouse.click_at, mouse.stroke and draw.* check the anchor's window identity, geometry, scale and focus. Tabs share a native window ID: stop input and observe again when the user changes pages. See drawing, numeric programs and the recursive Sierpinski example. Persistent sessions and external decisions On Unix, a named session keeps functions, devices and anchors across client invocations: zuse session start board --idle-timeout-ms 900000 zuse session observe board - <<'ZUSE' window.list() ZUSE zuse session result board Wait for the observation result, decide the next action externally, submit a short program through zuse session script board -, then query its job_id and observe again. accepted acknowledges submission; the result records completion or failure. One job runs at a time. status, result, cancel and close remain available; cancellation is cooperative and cleanup is confirmed separately. The public JSON-lines protocol v1 uses the private Unix socket returned by start. Stable request IDs support bounded retries; --expect-revision checks Zuse session state. Confirm application content through fresh observations. Sessions execute flat Runtime programs, including expanded numeric code; scoped mouse programs support dry-run preflight only. Idle sessions close after 15 minutes by default, with running work excluded. See sessions. zuse shell remains available for one retained stdin stream. On builds with native signal handling, SIGINT or SIGTERM closes the shell through normal Runtime cleanup, reaps its managed child processes, and discards queued commands. This also covers idle input and incomplete lines; see shell cancellation. The bundled Python controller example submits stdin source once and waits for its result on the same connection. It uses only the Python standard library and accepts the observed socket path, execution budgets and an optional expected revision. Packages and the standard library Git packages declare entry modules, exports and dependencies; zuse.lock.json pins full commits. Imports load installed local declarations; explicit function calls execute them. In a new project directory: zuse pkg init my-drawing zuse pkg add https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/zuse-std.git --rev v0.1.0 zuse -c 'import(path="pkg:std",as="std"); functions(namespace="std")' Commit the manifest and lockfile; restore with zuse pkg install --locked. The standard library provides desktop, drawing, text-input and timing functions. See package management for dependency checks and publication. Agent skills The repository includes three small skills that can be distributed with Zuse: Operate the computer: direct CLI programs, observed targets, batched input and session reuse. Develop and publish packages: source modules, validation, version tags and GitHub topics. Find and use packages: repository discovery, source review, locked installation and import preflight. Reusable functions and local events Import a .zuse module once in zuse shell, then reuse its functions across submissions: import(source="fn delay(ms){wait(ms=ms)}", as="local") local.delay(ms=10) eval(source="fn clock(){timer.status()}", as="tools") tools.clock() Add consecutive /// descriptions immediately before declarations, then call functions(namespace="local") to inspect names, ordered parameters, descriptions and source locations without invoking functions. MCP exposes the same catalog through zuse.functions; Rust exposes typed function_metadata() values. Run zuse run examples/function-catalog.zuse --read-only for a complete example. File imports use import(path="module.zuse", as="name"); loading only registers declarations. Explicit eval may also execute actions. The whole expanded program shares one preflight, read-only policy and budget. Failed preflight and dry runs do not replace retained definitions. run, script and check resolve file imports relative to the containing source file. observe, watch and wait_until return structured text and use local DOM or AT-SPI events. Explicit watch_until_click binds a tab, origin, container and bounded appearance count. timer.start/reset/stop/status expose monotonic command and cumulative timing. Optional --features vision adds multi-scale image matching and explicitly rendered visual timelines. See local programs, the bundled Zuse skill, and validation evidence. keyboard.state() distinguishes the active Wayland keyboard from other devices; text input preserves lock states. keyboard.num_lock(state="on") is an explicit readback-checked operation, also accepting off or toggle. A Wayland glow marker is click-through and follows the shared user pointer; independent pointers still require X11 MPX. Unavailable native pinch input remains explicitly unsupported. keyboard.hold(key="Up", duration=400) keeps a direction key down on the observed foreground Linux window, then releases it. browser.hold(key="ArrowRight", duration=300) provides the same bounded operation for the selected Chromium page. Both stop on cancellation or target changes. See direction-key holds and receiver tests. The importable ChatGPT desktop module separates native observation, guarded draft preparation and an explicitly authorized send action. Draft preparation checks the process and an empty editor before writing. A real target must expose the required native accessibility interfaces. Independent, scoped mice zuse script gives each mouse variable its own visible cursor, position, and button state. Independent mice are the default and require native Linux X11 with XInput2/MPX. Their glow, color, shape, size, and image are configurable. The following script moves two mice concurrently and closes both when its scope ends: let cyan = mouse(color="#2FE2FF", shape="arrow"); let violet = mouse(color="#B58CFF", shape="ring"); parallel { cyan.move(x=320, y=180, duration=600); violet.move(x=520, y=320, duration=600); } Run the full example with zuse script examples/scoped-mice.zuse. Blocks and functions own their local mice; aliases and function parameters borrow existing mice. sequence runs operations in order, while explicit blocks inside parallel group each branch's sequential work. The compiler rejects conflicting parallel access to one mouse before input. Normal exit, runtime errors, and cooperative cancellation close the script's mice and release synthetic held buttons. Flat mouse.* actions also create an independent runtime mouse by default. Select the user pointer explicitly with mouse.use(kind="user", appearance="system"); a scoped script uses user_mouse(appearance="system"). This explicit system mode uses the existing Wayland, Windows, or macOS backend where supported. An unavailable independent backend returns an error. mouse.position() requires an already selected runtime handle; use mouse.use() first. See scoped mice, custom paths, Rust ownership, and cleanup limits for the complete API, including the distinction between cooperative signal handling and termination that cannot run destructors. Move to text or a button mouse.move_to resolves an accessible name or text, reads the current pointer position, and moves to the target's center plus an optional offset. One call controls the whole movement; its default duration is 350 ms and it only moves the pointer. zuse eval 'mouse.move_to(text="Save",role="button",duration=650,curve="bezier",jitter=1.2,speed_variation=0.25,seed=42,offset_x=4,offset_y=-3)' --dry-run zuse eval 'mouse.move_to(text="Continue",role="button",speed=600,via="320,180;480,220")' --dry-run cargo run --example target_motion --dry-run validates arguments without reading the desktop. The Rust example generates a complete path using supplied coordinates; it requires an explicit --execute argument to move a real pointer. Targets come from native accessibility, so image-only or canvas text must be exposed by the application before this operation can locate it. Matching is exact and case-sensitive by default; ambiguous matches require a scope or explicit index. Use MovePlan to inspect a path or Runtime::move_to_with to supply a Rust callback receiving progress, the live start, and the offset-adjusted target. motion::FunctionalMotion provides the allocation-free no_std sampler. mouse.circle also schedules a closed circular trajectory in one call. See target selection, motion parameters, and Rust examples. Background browser browser.launch(headless=true) browser.viewport(width=1280, height=800) browser.navigate(url="data:text/html,<title>zuse</title><input id=message><button id=save>Save</button>") browser.fill(selector="#message", text="Hello") browser.click(selector="#save") browser.snapshot() browser.capture(path="browser.png") browser.close() The browser adapter speaks Chrome DevTools Protocol over native sockets. Launch creates an isolated temporary profile. Browser snapshots expose accessibility roles, names, relationships, and DOM identifiers, while omitting input values. browser.capture writes a PNG of the current viewport; browser.viewport sets its size in CSS pixels. browser.fill rejects password inputs. Use a visible browser and human.request for a local operator to complete those steps. Explicit browser.evaluate executes JavaScript with access to the page. browser.connect(endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:9222") connects to an explicitly selected loopback debugging endpoint and creates a fresh page. browser.tabs() lists targets; browser.select(id="...") attaches to an existing page. When connected to a browser started outside zuse, closing the connection preserves those selected existing pages. Re-selecting the current page preserves its session and content; another page is prepared before the previous selection is released. MCP zuse mcp --stdio zuse mcp --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8377 zuse mcp --socket /run/user/1000/zuse.sock Use your own runtime directory for the socket path. Unix socket files are created with mode 0600. TCP serves Streamable HTTP at /mcp. A non-loopback bind requires a ZUSE_TOKEN of at least 32 bytes; clients send it as a Bearer token. HTTP validates Host, Origin, request metadata, framing, and body bounds. Stdio and socket connections negotiate legacy MCP and support the current 2026-07-28 protocol. HTTP uses the 2026-07-28 stateless transport. Diagnostics go to stderr; stdout remains a protocol stream. Typical MCP client configuration: { "mcpServers": { "zuse": { "command": "zuse", "args": ["mcp", "--stdio"] } } } Tool Purpose zuse.functions Inspect retained function metadata, optionally filtered by module namespace zuse.script Run scoped mice, functions, and parallel tracks; close the run's mice before returning zuse.execute Validate and run a program zuse.check Return a plan without effects zuse.capabilities Inspect available host capabilities zuse.schema Get the command schema zuse.observe Read windows, pointer, accessibility, or text zuse.screenshot Return a real PNG image to the agent zuse.human.pending Inspect human handoffs zuse.resume Continue an approved request once Human assistance human.request( kind="yubikey", message="Touch the security key, then confirm that the action is complete.", timeout=300 ) window.list() The request produces a system notification and a durable request ID. A local operator uses zuse human assist ID, or records completion with zuse human approve ID. Denial, expiry, and consumed requests stop resumption. A modern MCP client with form elicitation can display a completion dialog and retry using the supplied request state. Supported kinds are approval, password, yubikey, login, touch, and permission. Password requests require an explicit window target. The local helper obtains the password, sends it to that window, and omits it from MCP results and execution logs. Login requests can open their HTTP(S) URL for the operator. Keep stateful workflows in zuse shell or an MCP server. Those processes retain browser sessions and harnesses while a request is pending. A one-shot CLI invocation saves the remaining source, while its owned browser/process objects end with the invocation. Android: foreground and background android.devices() android.connect(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL", mode="foreground") android.status() android.snapshot() Background control selects an existing secondary display explicitly: android.connect(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL", mode="background", display=4) android.tap(x=240, y=160) android.start(component="com.example.app/.MainActivity") The native ADB client requires an authorized ADB server. Select a serial explicitly; omission requires exactly one ready device. Foreground mode uses display 0; background mode selects an existing nonzero display and binds input, launch and capture to it. Ambiguous capture mappings fail. Text accepts up to 4096 bytes of printable ASCII, excluding %s; unsupported input fails during preflight. See the platform guide for permissions and display setup. Physical Android 16 testing covered foreground input, all 95 printable ASCII characters, exact screenshot pixels, and a fixture-owned secondary display whose input left the primary fixture unchanged. See native acceptance testing and the device evidence. Mobile browsers and iOS android.browser.sockets(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL") browser.connect_android(serial="YOUR_DEVICE_SERIAL") browser.navigate(url="https://example.com") browser.snapshot() browser.capture(path="phone-browser.png") browser.close() Android Chrome uses a native ADB tunnel and one owned tab in the existing profile. It requires a responsive debugging socket; mobile tab selection stays within that owned tab. See mobile browser control. iOS uses an explicitly configured local WebDriverAgent endpoint for touch, Unicode input, observation, screenshots and application launch. Protocol fixtures pass; physical iPhone validation remains outstanding. The iOS guide covers preparation, ownership, redaction and coordinates. MCP screenshots support desktop, browser, android and ios sources from the connected runtime. Serial and USB devices serial.ports() usb.devices() Native serial adapters support explicit Linux/macOS TTY paths and Windows COM ports, raw 8N1 configuration, bounded reads/writes and restoration on close. The USB adapter loads the system libusb through zsys and requires explicit bus/address, VID/PID and interface selection. It provides bulk, interrupt and control transfers without automatically detaching kernel drivers. Partial writes report progress and stop the remaining program; they are never automatically replayed. Linux serial behavior was tested through real kernel PTYs. USB transfer behavior was tested against an isolated C ABI fixture, not an arbitrary physical device. See device I/O for examples, limits, timeouts and cleanup semantics. Native integrations Area Interface Linux X11 / Wine / XWayland Xlib, XTest, targeted window events, window metadata and PNG capture Linux Wayland / Omarchy Hyprland IPC, native Wayland keyboard/keymap handling, compositor metadata and capture utilities Linux accessibility Native AT-SPI tree, text, focus, actions, editable text Windows Win32 input/window/GDI APIs; UI Automation through the system PowerShell runtime macOS Quartz/ApplicationServices; System Events accessibility through the system JXA runtime Chromium Native CDP client, visible or headless isolated browser Android Native ADB protocol, explicit displays and an owned Chrome CDP tab iOS Native HTTP client to an explicit local WebDriverAgent endpoint Serial / USB Native termios/Win32 COM; system libusb through zsys IDE VS Code open/goto/diff/extensions command interfaces Harnesses Installed harness discovery and bounded managed process input/output Backend dependencies and tested coverage are listed in Platforms. Wine windows use their host window protocol; this release does not embed Wine. Interactive harnesses need a supported pipe/protocol mode. X11 text outside the keyboard layout requires a confirmed local AT-SPI editable target. The whole string is checked before input; unsupported targets fail without a keyboard-map or clipboard workaround. See X11 text delivery for focus binding, selection/caret semantics and the isolated native regression. Embed [dependencies] zuse = { package = "zuse-computer", git = "https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/zuse", tag = "v0.6.0", default-features = false } use zuse::language::Parser; for call in Parser::new("mouse.move(x=10,y=20)") { let call = call?; assert_eq!(call.name, "mouse.move"); } # Ok::<(), zuse::language::ParseError>(()) Enable the default std feature for zuse::runtime::Runtime, native backends, and MCP transports. Development and releases python3 scripts/check.py cargo check --no-default-features --lib cargo bench --bench core python3 scripts/bump.py patch --dry-run python3 scripts/bump.py patch --commit --tag --push Checks run locally; the CI workflow is available for pull requests and manual dispatch. The release workflow builds Linux x86_64/ARM64, macOS x86_64/ARM64, and Windows x86_64 archives. The native release workflow does not publish the Cargo package. Registry publication uses a separately validated source stage with exact matching registry dependencies. The Bump and release workflow performs the version commit, atomic branch/tag push, and reusable release call. See Development and Validation for exact gates and measured results. License MIT.

title: Flat execution language
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 Flat execution language This page describes zuse eval, zuse run, zuse check, the persistent shell, and MCP flat batches. Use zuse script for mouse variables, block/function lifetimes, and parallel or sequential pointer tracks. Validate that separate language with zuse script FILE --dry-run. A program is a sequence of named calls. Newlines and semicolons separate calls; # and // start comments outside strings. Argument lists can span lines and end in a trailing comma. mouse.move( x=320, y=180, duration=300, curve="smooth", ) Values are decimal numbers, booleans, quoted strings, or bare identifiers. Quoted strings use JSON-style escapes, including Unicode surrogate pairs. Duplicate names, positional arguments, malformed numbers, unknown operations, and unknown parameters are rejected. Error locations use byte offsets with one-based line and character columns. zuse shell accepts one complete program per input line. Use zuse run FILE for files containing multiline calls. This command language executes flat bounded call batches. Scalar programs add immutable values, arithmetic, branches, bounded loops and recursion; preparation expands them before whole-program preflight. Controllers can then use the persistent session to observe and choose the next batch. Scoped pointer programs retain their own zuse script entry point. There are no implicit shell substitutions or JavaScript evaluation. Discovery and limits Run zuse schema to obtain the authoritative command list. The default execution limit is 256 calls, a 1 MiB source, 24 arguments per call, 65,536 bytes per string, and 60 seconds of cumulative scheduled waits. CLI flags can set the per-execution step and wait budgets. The entire source is parsed and validated before any effect. Fixed durations count toward the scheduled-wait budget during validation. For mouse.move_to(speed=...), the duration becomes known after target resolution and complete path sampling; the runtime checks and deducts it from the remaining budget before moving the pointer. Dynamic failures, such as a window disappearing, stop subsequent calls and include the failed step and previous results. Command families Family Operations mouse use, release, position, move, move_to, circle, click, down, up, scroll keyboard type, key, optional explicit window target window / screen list, focus, capture, text wine windows accessibility tree, focus, action, set_text browser launch, connect, tabs, select, navigate, snapshot, text, evaluate, click, fill, key, viewport, capture, close android devices, connect, status, snapshot, capture, tap, swipe, key, type, start human request, pending process / harness start, list/read, write/send, stop ide open, diff, extensions omarchy status, workspaces, workspace, themes, theme system capabilities standalone wait, notify Input and observation Pointer actions create an independent runtime mouse by default, currently requiring native Linux X11 MPX. mouse.use() selects one explicitly; mouse.use(kind="user", appearance="system") selects the user's normal system pointer on supported desktop backends. mouse.position() only observes the selected handle and returns an error in a fresh runtime without one. mouse.release() ends its lifetime; persistent shell, MCP, and Rust runtimes otherwise retain it across completed batches. See mouse ownership and platform limits. Target movements use 350 ms, smooth acceleration and deceleration, and up to 0.6 native coordinate units of jitter per axis by default. This applies to mouse.move, mouse.move_to, and the movement inside mouse.click_at. Endpoints remain exact. Explicit duration=0 selects immediate movement; jitter=0 disables displacement. The default 350 ms contributes to preflight's wait budget, and click_at adds its default 30 ms settling time before pressing and releasing the button. touchpad.capabilities() reports the current gesture capabilities without a display. touchpad.swipe, touchpad.pinch, touchpad.rotate, and touchpad.cancel support validation and dry-run planning; native gesture injection is currently unsupported and fails whole-program preflight. See gesture arguments and planning semantics. keyboard.key(key="ctrl+a") sends a chord. keyboard.type(text="...") sends text. On backends that support targeted window events, supplying window="ID" directs input to that window without changing the active window. Applications can reject synthetic targeted events; accessibility actions and browser commands are preferred when the target exposes them. screen.text() reads accessibility text. screen.text(ocr=true) captures the display and uses the installed Tesseract executable. Screenshots are PNG files. MCP's screenshot tool also returns an image content block. Native accessibility snapshots contain bounded tree paths. Pass a path from the current snapshot to accessibility.focus, accessibility.action, or accessibility.set_text. Observe again after navigation or structural changes. Targeted pointer movement mouse.move_to finds an accessible name or text and moves from the current pointer position to that node's center. It does not click. Its default is an exact, case-sensitive, unique match and a 350 ms smooth movement with 0.6 units of jitter. mouse.move_to( text="Save", role="button", duration=650, curve="bezier", jitter=1.2, speed_variation=0.25, seed=42, offset_x=4, offset_y=-3, ) scope="0/2/1" restricts matching to a fresh accessibility path and its descendants. exact=false matches a substring; case_sensitive=false compares Unicode lowercase forms. index=0 explicitly selects the first observed match. A partial accessibility snapshot requires an explicit index, even when a scope is supplied. duration is movement time in milliseconds, excluding target lookup. speed is the average sampled path length per second and is exclusive with duration. offset_x and offset_y are added to the target center. via="320,180;480,220" specifies absolute screen-coordinate waypoints. The backend's native coordinate space applies to all points, including negative coordinates on multi-monitor desktops. steps sets sampling resolution, and the backend rounds samples to integer input coordinates. zuse eval 'mouse.move_to(text="Save",role="button")' --dry-run validates the request without locating a live target. See target motion for all parameter bounds, programmatic paths, output fields, and failure behavior. Processes and harnesses process.start(program="...",args="...") starts the exact executable with a quoted argument parser. It does not invoke a shell. A shell can still be selected explicitly as the executable. Process reads return bounded incremental stdout/stderr and lost-byte counts. Managed processes use pipes. Use the harness's documented pipe or machine protocol mode. Programs that require a terminal need a terminal-aware integration. The manager bounds active processes and output tails, and owns process cleanup. Human continuations A human request saves the remaining program and pauses. The state directory is ZUSE_STATE_DIR when set, otherwise the platform state location. On Unix, request directories use 0700 and files use 0600. Decisions are explicit, expire, and are consumed once. The runtime executes with the caller's OS permissions. Human handoff coordinates an operator and agent; it does not isolate an untrusted process from the operator's account.

title: Zuse 会话协议 v1
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 Zuse 会话协议 v1 本协议让外部控制器向一个持续存在的 Zuse Runtime 提交源码、查询状态和取消工作。 连接端点由 zuse session start NAME 的 socket 字段给出。服务在本机 Unix domain socket 上交换 UTF-8 JSON-lines：每个请求和响应各占一行，以 \n 结束；源码中的换行必须进行 JSON 转义。 原生观察返回的嵌套 JSON 会去除结构空白后传输，字符串内的转义和结果对象类型保持不变。 同一连接可依次发送多个请求，服务也允许其他客户端读取状态。 连接闲置或一个未完成帧达到 5 秒会关闭连接；需要时重新连接同一 socket，已有会话与作业仍保留。 超长帧返回 frame_too_large 后断开；不完整、非 UTF-8 或超时帧返回 invalid_request 后断开。 三个标识 字段 含义 request_id 控制器给这次请求分配的字符串标识，用于响应关联和有界重试去重。 job_id 服务接收脚本后分配的整数作业标识，用于查询执行结果。 state_revision 会话状态变化计数，初始为 1；用于拒绝依据旧状态提交的动作。 不同操作使用不同 request_id。只有同一次请求的重试才复用原 ID 和完整帧内容。 ID 必须为 1–128 个 UTF-8 字节，不能包含控制字符。 request_id 不是认证凭证；能访问私有 socket 的本地进程可以控制会话。 请求 所有请求都包含 version: 1、request_id 和 op。例如： {"version":1,"request_id":"status-001","op":"status"} op 额外字段 行为 status 无 查询状态及当前、最近作业。 script source；可选 base、options、expected_revision 提交完整 Zuse 程序。 observe 同 script 提交强制只读程序。 result 可选整数 job_id 查询指定或最近作业。 cancel 可选 expected_revision 请求取消当前作业。 close 可选 expected_revision 清理运行时并关闭会话。 source 是 UTF-8 源码字符串。base 如提供，必须是绝对目录，用于解析相对模块路径。 原始协议省略 base 时，使用服务启动时冻结的工作目录；CLI 自动传入本次控制命令的工作目录。 请求对象和 options 对象拒绝重复或未知字段；字段也必须用于表中允许的操作。 options 是可选对象，包含以下执行设置： 字段 类型 默认值 read_only 布尔 false；observe 始终强制为 true。 dry_run 布尔 false。 max_steps 整数，1–65536 256。 max_wait_ms 整数，0–86400000 60000。 例如提交纯 Zuse 等待程序，并要求状态仍与之前观察一致： {"version":1,"request_id":"script-001","op":"script","expected_revision":1,"source":"fn inspect(){timer.status()} inspect()","options":{"max_steps":256,"max_wait_ms":60000}} expected_revision 是可选整数。匹配当前状态修订号才接受相应动作；不匹配返回 stale_revision， 不会执行源码。它保护从观察到决策之间的状态关联，不是整个外部应用界面的事务锁。 响应 响应包含以下公共字段： 字段 含义 version 响应协议版本，当前为 1。 request_id 对应请求标识；无法读取有效标识的帧错误为 null。 ok 请求是否被协议层成功处理。 session 会话名。 state idle、running、cancelling 或 closing。 state_revision 该回执所记录的状态修订号。 成功响应另外包含 status 和操作相关字段。脚本提交响应使用 status: "accepted" 并返回整数 job_id。这只表示收到作业，不能作为动作已完成的证据。 status 操作使用 status: "ready"，包含 pid、socket、active_job_id、 last_job_id 和 last_status。状态修订号在接受作业、首次取消、完成和进入关闭状态时递增； 单纯 status / result 查询不会递增它。 active_job_id 在空闲时为 null；last_job_id / last_status 指最近结束的作业，没有时为 null。 省略 result.job_id 时优先查询当前作业，否则查询最近结束的作业。 result 操作的 status 为： 值 含义 running 作业尚未结束。 completed 作业已结束，读取 result 中的 Runtime 回执。 failed 准备或执行失败，读取结果中的错误与已完成步骤。 cancelled 作业因取消结束；读取内部回执中的清理信息和错误。 empty 没有可返回的作业结果。 终态结果包含 job_id 和 result，后者保留 Zuse 原执行回执。 同时返回 elapsed_ms、result_bytes 与 result_truncated。超过 512 KiB 的回执不保留正文： status 为 failed、result 为 null、result_truncated 为 true，result_bytes 记录原大小。 这表示结果超限，不能推断操作未发生；应重新观察应用，不因缺少正文而自动重复输入。 dry_run 的作业也会结束，但其内部回执是检查计划，不表示输入发生。 ok: true 与 status: "failed" 可以同时出现：前者说明结果查询成功，后者说明被查询的作业失败。 状态和并发 一个会话同一时刻只运行一个作业，script 和 observe 都需要 idle。 运行中仍可发送 status、result、cancel 和 close。 取消请求进入 cancelling，清理完成后回到 idle；关闭进入 closing，清理完成后返回 closed 并断开服务。 取消响应含 cleanup_complete：有作业时为 false，已经空闲时返回 status: "idle" 和 true。 cancelling 只确认取消标志已设置并唤醒等待；不代表正在执行的原生输入派发已经返回。 关闭响应含 resources_released。等待清理超过 10 秒时可返回 status: "closing" 和 false； 只有 status: "closed" 和 true 才确认运行时及原 socket 已清理。 当前协议不提供暂停、恢复执行位置或回滚已经送达应用的动作。 作业使用保留的 Runtime 执行 flat 程序。数值程序先展开成原语；函数和 Runtime 字段可以跨作业保留。 当前通道不执行 scoped mouse 程序；其 dry_run 可以检查计划，但不创建跨作业 scoped 设备。 重试与去重 服务对 script、observe、cancel、close 保存有界去重记录。 服务仍可响应且缓存命中时，相同 request_id 和相同帧内容返回原回执，并附加 replayed: true，不会再次执行。 同一个已缓存 ID 对应不同帧内容时返回 request_id_conflict。帧比较不包含末尾换行，但包含 JSON 字段顺序和空白。 重试应重发原帧，不重新排列、修改或重建其中的状态条件。 动作的拒绝回执也会缓存，包括 busy 和 stale_revision。收到确定拒绝后，新的提交尝试必须用新 ID； 通信结果不确定时才用原 ID 和原帧找回原回执。status / result 不占去重缓存，读取请求可以复用 ID。 去重检查先于旧 expected_revision 的重新判定。因此已接收作业完成后，重发其原请求仍返回原作业 ID。 重放的是历史回执，其中 state 和 state_revision 不代表当前状态；后续决策先读取新的 status 或 result。 缓存最多保留 64 条且总数据最多 8 MiB，淘汰或会话重启后不保证同 ID 仍能去重。 保存并重发原 expected_revision 可使已淘汰的旧动作在状态变化后被拒绝。 会话重启后修订号重新计数；同名会话或相同修订号不表示原来的进程，应重新观察后再提交。 错误 协议错误使用 ok: false，并包含 error: {"code": "...", "message": "..."}。 code 处理方式 busy 当前作业尚未结束；查询结果或显式取消，新的提交尝试使用新 ID。 stale_revision 重新观察并取得当前修订号，再以新 ID 提交新的决定。 request_id_conflict 为新请求换新 ID；原请求重试保持原帧。 invalid_request 修正请求字段、操作名、参数或源码大小。 invalid_result 运行时结果无法编码为合法协议 JSON；重新观察状态，避免盲目重放输入。 unsupported_version 使用已支持的协议版本。 job_not_found 核对作业 ID；结果可能已超出保留窗口。 session_closing 停止提交，等待关闭完成。 frame_too_large 缩小单帧，勿继续发送超限帧。 request_pending 同 ID 的原请求仍在完成；稍后重发原帧。 worker_unavailable 会话执行线程不可用；读取现有结果并关闭或重新建立会话。 连接错误、EOF 或客户端超时不能证明作业未执行。先用原请求 ID 重试或查询已知作业 ID， 避免盲目创建新请求而重复输入。Zuse CLI 对协议请求错误返回非零退出码；查询一个失败作业本身仍可成功退出。 限额与生命周期 项目 限额 单次源码 256 KiB UTF-8 字节 单个协议帧 2 MiB 单条保留结果 512 KiB 保留作业结果 32 条 请求去重记录 64 条，合计最多 8 MiB 同时连接 16 条 完整帧接收或连接空闲期限 5 秒 响应写入超时 2 秒 单次关闭等待 10 秒 这些限额之外，脚本仍受自己的步数、等待、模块、展开和绘图点数预算约束。 服务的默认空闲超时是 900000 ms；有效控制请求续期，运行中的作业不计为空闲。 未完成帧和静默连接不会无限保持会话。关闭或超时会释放 Runtime，客户端不能假定函数与设备在重启后仍存在。 服务每 100 ms 检查读取状态；会话超时清理不等待未完成帧耗尽其 5 秒期限。 运行目录权限为 0700，socket 权限为 0600，两者均检查当前有效用户身份。 外部控制循环 启动或连接明确的会话，用 status 确认它空闲。 用 observe 提交观察源码，保存 job_id，查询到终态。 根据返回的应用状态，由程序逻辑或模型选择下一步。服务不调用外部模型。 将下一步写为 Zuse 源码，以新 request_id 和最近 state_revision 提交 script。 查询执行结果并再次观察。发生 stale_revision 时回到观察；通信中断时优先重发原帧或查询原作业。 打地鼠、下棋或其他交互任务可以使用同一循环；目标选择与策略属于控制器， 坐标计算、时序和实际输入留在提交的 Zuse 程序里。接口不包含专用游戏逻辑或 JEV 集成。

title: 持久会话：观察、执行与取消
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 持久会话：观察、执行与取消 持久会话是一个保留 Zuse Runtime 的本地进程。客户端提交脚本后即可退出， 后续客户端仍能使用已注册的函数、运行时设备与锚点，并查询或取消正在执行的作业。 一次提交是一个作业；接收成功与执行完成分别有回执，不依赖一直打开的 shell 标准输入。 启动并提交源码 为同一工作流选择一个会话名： 名称使用 1–40 个 ASCII 字母、数字、下划线或连字符。 zuse session start board --idle-timeout-ms 900000 zuse session status board zuse session script board - <<'ZUSE' fn inspect() { timer.status() } inspect() ZUSE start 等到服务可以响应后才返回，回执包含 socket、pid 与当前状态。 在 ssmcp 等会回收任务进程树的宿主中，把 session serve 作为长期任务启动； start 的后台子进程仍受宿主生命周期管理，客户端无法保证它在任务结束后继续存活。 script 接受完整 Zuse 源码，返回 job_id 后异步执行。用实际 ID 替换下面的 JOB_ID： zuse session result board JOB_ID 等待结果为 completed、failed 或 cancelled，再提交下一段脚本。 例如第二次提交 inspect(); functions() 可以复用第一段定义的函数。 源码仍由 Zuse 准备并执行，坐标计算、循环、递归和桌面输入无需外部程序展开。 命令 命令 作用 session start NAME [--idle-timeout-ms N] 启动后台服务，并等待就绪。 session serve NAME [--idle-timeout-ms N] 在前台运行服务，适合进程管理器。 session status NAME 读取状态、状态修订号及作业标识。 session script NAME - 从 stdin 提交完整脚本。 session observe NAME - 提交强制只读的观察脚本。 session result NAME [JOB_ID] 查询指定或最近作业的回执。 session cancel NAME 请求取消当前作业；继续查结果确认清理完成。 session close NAME 取消并清理当前工作，释放运行时，关闭会话。 script 支持 --read-only、--dry-run、--max-steps 和 --max-wait-ms； observe 支持后三项，并始终开启只读检查。只有空闲会话接受新作业，运行中提交返回 busy。 status、result 和取消控制保持可用。observe 也会占用一次作业，不在输入执行中并行读取 Runtime。 zuse session observe board - <<'ZUSE' timer.status() functions() ZUSE 观察脚本经过整段只读预检；包含输入操作时，在前面的操作执行前拒绝。 --dry-run 仅准备和检查，不提交新函数或产生应用输入。失败预检不会替换会话中已有定义。 当前持久通道执行 flat Runtime 程序及展开后的数值程序；scoped mouse 程序可以预检，尚不在该通道实际执行。 状态与清理 stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> idle idle --> running: 接收作业 running --> idle: 完成或失败 running --> cancelling: 请求取消 cancelling --> idle: 清理完成 idle --> closing: 关闭或空闲超时 running --> closing: 关闭 cancelling --> closing: 关闭 closing --> [*] 取消是协作式停止：正在等待或分派输入的执行器检查取消令牌，随后报告结果并释放应清理的资源。 cancelling 仅表示取消已请求；正在执行的原生派发可能尚未返回，需要继续查看作业结果。 取消不撤销应用已经处理的动作。下一个作业使用新的取消状态，可以继续执行。 close 的成功回执表示清理已完成；服务只删除自己创建且身份仍匹配的 socket。 如果 10 秒内尚未清理完，会返回 closing 和 resources_released=false；此时不能宣称会话已关闭。 默认空闲超时是 900000 ms，即 15 分钟。运行和取消期间不消耗空闲时间； 完成后重新开始计时，有效控制请求会刷新空闲时间。保持一个无数据连接或发送未完成帧不会持续续期。 空闲超时会释放整个会话，不会把函数、锚点或设备自动恢复到另一个进程。 外部控制器 服务使用版本化 JSON-lines Unix socket 协议，普通程序或模型驱动的控制器都可以连接。 读取 start 返回的确切 socket 路径，并遵循会话协议。 典型循环是观察、等待观察结果、决定下一段 Zuse 源码、提交、等待执行结果，再观察。 模型调用和游戏策略由控制器负责；会话服务负责有界执行、状态与回执，不内置 JEV 或模型 RPC。 仓库附带只依赖 Python 标准库的客户端示例。 它从 stdin 读取一次源码，提交一次，并通过同一连接查询到作业终态： zuse_socket=$(zuse session status board | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["socket"])') printf '%s\n' 'timer.status()' | python3 examples/session_client.py --socket "$zuse_socket" --observe 去掉 --observe 即提交普通作业。--max-steps 和 --max-wait-ms 设置 Zuse 预算； --timeout-ms 限制客户端等待，超时后作业可继续执行，客户端不会重发源码。 Ctrl+C 会尝试按已知修订号取消同一 socket 实例中的作业，随后仍需查询结果确认清理。 为需要重试的动作指定稳定的 --request-id ID；为防止基于旧状态提交，使用 --expect-revision N，其中 N 来自最近的状态或结果回执。重试必须保留相同请求内容。 服务只保留有界去重记录，长期恢复时应先查询状态及作业结果，不把重新发送当作永久去重保证。 本地边界 当前服务使用 Unix domain socket。start 返回实际位置；ZUSE_SESSION_DIR 可指定运行目录， 该目录必须属于当前用户且权限为 0700，不能是符号链接。目录访问权就是本地控制边界，协议不提供远程身份认证。 未指定目录时，优先使用 $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/zuse-sessions，否则使用系统临时目录下的 zuse-sessions-UID。 socket 的完整路径最多 100 字节；路径过长时选用更短的绝对运行目录。 socket 权限为 0600。最多同时连接 16 个客户端；连接闲置 5 秒会断开，但不会因此销毁仍有效的会话，控制器可以重连。 单次源码最多 256 KiB，单帧最多 2 MiB；每个结果最多保留 512 KiB，最多保留 32 条作业结果。 请求去重缓存最多 64 条、总请求与响应数据最多 8 MiB。完整字段、错误码和重试规则见协议文档。 结果正文超限会返回截断元数据并标记作业失败；这不代表之前的应用动作没有发生。 输入回执仍需结合应用状态判断是否达成目标；accepted 只表示作业已接收。 相关验证见 sessions.rs，使用无桌面输入的 Runtime 作业、真实 Unix socket 和独立 CLI 进程。

title: Platform support and verification
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 Platform support and verification Capabilities are discovered at runtime. Missing permissions, system libraries, display protocols, or device commands produce explicit errors. Compilation and actual application interaction are recorded separately. Backend Implemented interface Verified scope through 0.2.0 Linux X11 Xlib/XTest pointer and keyboard, window metadata, targeted synthetic events, PNG Private Xvfb fixture; delivered text and events, image dimensions/pixels/CRCs Linux Hyprland Native compositor IPC, Wayland virtual keyboard, actual XKB keymap lookup Hyprland 0.57.2 private graphical sessions, including Fcitx; foreground Unicode, background ASCII and state rejection Shared Linux desktop Window discovery and pointer operations Actual development session; keyboard stopped before effects because Num Lock was enabled; focus/pointer restored Wayland capture grim using the compositor's capture protocol Fixture PNG color and dimensions verified; window capture is its composited visible region Linux AT-SPI Tree, text, bounds, focus, actions, editable text and password redaction Private D-Bus/Xvfb GTK fixture Chromium CDP Isolated browser, navigation, text/AX, input, viewport and PNG Isolated sandboxed Chromium fixture rerun after the 0.2.0 mobile fix Windows Win32 input/window/GDI and system UI Automation Full x86_64-pc-windows-gnu type check; no live Windows desktop in this acceptance macOS Quartz/ApplicationServices and System Events accessibility Clippy/all-targets on aarch64 and x86_64 apple-darwin; permission preflight implemented; no live Mac Android Native ADB/shell-v2, display-aware input/capture/launch Physical Android 16/API 36, foreground and fixture-owned secondary display Android Chrome Native ADB tunnel and owned CDP target Physical Chrome 157: 13 checks, restored foreground during background page operations iOS Native HTTP to explicit local WDA 20 protocol/MCP tests; no iPhone available Serial Linux/macOS termios, Windows COM 5 real Linux PTY test groups; no physical serial peripheral USB System libusb through zsys 11 isolated C ABI groups and real descriptor enumeration; no hardware transfer tests Wine Host X11/XWayland control and Wine-marked discovery Shared X11 implementation verified; no separate Wine application acceptance IDE / Omarchy / harness Installed command interfaces and bounded managed processes Process tests and capability discovery; tests do not launch model sessions Detailed results: 0.2.0 validation, 0.1.1 validation, Android evidence, Linux evidence. Independent and shared mice The current repository adds scoped mouse programs. A native independent mouse needs a separate OS pointer identity as well as its own cursor image. Linux X11 supplies that identity through XInput2 master pointers; zuse creates and removes one master pair per owned mouse, keeps the user's pointer separate, and assigns a device-specific ARGB cursor. The unreleased candidate validation records the current Xvfb, GTK/AT-SPI, private Hyprland Num Lock, CLI cancellation, and cross-target results. Requested mode Linux native X11 Wayland, Windows, macOS Independent mouse, including default mouse() and flat pointer actions Requires XInput2/MPX, XTEST, and ARGB cursors Unsupported; returns an error Shared user pointer with generated or custom appearance Uses the user's master pointer and temporary per-device cursor overrides Unsupported; returns an error Explicit user pointer with appearance="system" Uses the existing system-pointer backend Uses the existing native backend, subject to its permissions and requirements Use user_mouse(appearance="system") in zuse script, or mouse.use(kind="user", appearance="system") in a flat CLI, shell, or MCP batch. The independent mode does not fall back to the user pointer. A fresh flat runtime has no selected mouse for mouse.position() until an explicit selection or mouse action creates a handle. Parallel independent trajectories have separate native coordinates and button state. Applications can still share focus and content, and some legacy GUI clients accept only one active drag or pointer grab. Those application limits are separate from pointer ownership. XWayland availability does not imply independent native Wayland pointers; ZUSE_BACKEND=x11 is an explicit request to use an accessible X11 server with the required extensions. Scope cleanup releases held synthetic buttons and removes owned devices. Normal errors and cooperative cancellation follow this path. SIGKILL, abort, crashes, or a lost display connection can prevent cleanup; XInput master devices may then remain on the server. A shared styled mouse removes its own cursor overrides on close. An older per-device override installed by another XI-aware tool cannot be recovered because XInput has no query for that previous override. Linux libraries and helpers Native dynamic-library loading uses the exact Project Z dependency zsys 0.1.1. System-pointer X11 operations need libX11 and libXtst; independent or styled mice also need libXi and libXcursor. Wayland keyboard support needs libwayland-client and libxkbcommon. AT-SPI needs libatspi and a usable accessibility D-Bus session. These libraries are loaded at runtime, with no link-time X11 dependency. Static-musl native dynamic loading is unsupported by this zsys version. Hyprland metadata, focus and targeted input use its native socket. Screen capture uses grim. Pointer buttons/wheel require an authorized ydotool daemon; pointer positioning can use Hyprland IPC. Text input no longer depends on wtype. OCR uses Tesseract, notifications use notify-send, and the graphical password prompt uses Zenity. Omarchy operations call installed Omarchy/Hyprland interfaces; zuse does not install a theme or change system settings during capability discovery. Wayland keyboard conditions Keyboard input requires Hyprland 0.55 or newer with the adapter's state queries, no held keys, Caps Lock off, and layout group 0. Text input and background shortcuts also require Num Lock off. Known unsupported or unobservable required state returns error_code=unsupported_state before keyboard effects. Sticky modifiers and custom latched/locked state are not supported: the compositor's public interface does not expose a complete modifier snapshot to an unfocused observer. Foreground keyboard.key can preserve Num Lock for an ordinary mapped chord such as Ctrl+T. It resolves the key and modifier masks against the captured XKB map, uses an owned virtual keyboard with that same map, then explicitly restores the Num Lock mask before destroying the device. This path requires a verifiable Num Lock action, byte-identical keymap parse/serialization, and the current main keyboard to be the last device in Hyprland's keyboard list so destruction selects that same keyboard again. A named target must already be focused; the adapter does not change focus or toggle Num Lock to satisfy these conditions. Lock-changing keys and configurations outside those checks remain unsupported. Foreground typing installs a bounded Unicode keymap and restores the captured original keymap before disconnecting. Background typing leaves the live keymap intact. It resolves the whole string against the real plain/Shift levels before sending targeted shortcuts. A missing character returns error_code=unsupported_character before any character in that call is sent. This does not provide arbitrary background Unicode on every layout; a US map, for example, cannot represent Chinese or emoji through these levels. The Fcitx regression demonstrates the tested session, not every input method, preedit state, compositor or application. zuse does not toggle the operator's locks or reclaim a changed focus to make an operation pass. Touchpad gestures touchpad.capabilities() reports native gesture support separately from pure planning. Current backends support bounded swipe, pinch, rotation, and cancellation plans only; every native gesture capability is false. An executable program containing a native gesture fails capability preflight before any earlier pointer action is submitted. There is no pointer-motion or wheel-event substitute. See touchpad planning for the script and Rust interfaces. Submission and application acceptance A successful native key request means the event was submitted to the OS/compositor. It does not prove that a widget consumed it. In particular, X11 applications can ignore XSendEvent events even when the X server accepts them. Keyboard results include delivery=submitted and application_confirmation_required=true. The compatibility field typed_bytes counts submitted UTF-8 bytes, as does submitted_bytes; neither measures the widget's final text. Read accessibility state or another application observation to verify the intended result. Applications that reject background events require an explicit foreground or accessibility operation. Windows and macOS requirements Windows uses Win32 for native input/window/capture and the system PowerShell/.NET UI Automation interface for accessibility. OS-protected desktops and application permission boundaries remain in effect. macOS exposes non-prompting Accessibility and Screen Recording preflight with granted/denied/unknown states. See macOS setup. Actual input/capture requires the corresponding permission. Native input uses Quartz; tree operations use System Events/JXA. The local password dialog uses the OS scripting interface. These desktop paths need live acceptance on their respective systems; cross-target compilation does not establish permission behavior or widget delivery. Browser scope The browser adapter supports Chromium-family DevTools Protocol. A launched browser owns an isolated temporary profile. Connecting uses an explicit loopback endpoint and creates a fresh page. Existing pages require explicit selection; closing an external connection preserves pages it did not create. Android Chrome uses an owned target in its existing profile; see mobile browser scope. Firefox remote automation and Safari DOM/CDP are outside 0.2.0. iOS controls native application UI through WDA and opens URLs through the default handler. Android scope A previously authorized ADB server must listen on loopback. zuse sends smart-socket and shell-v2 frames directly from Rust. It does not spawn adb for product operations. An explicit serial is recommended. Without a serial, the complete inventory must contain exactly one ready device, including consideration of offline or unauthorized entries. Foreground/preempt mode selects display 0. Background mode selects an explicitly supplied existing nonzero logical display, and never falls back to the primary display. The test APK can create its own temporary secondary display; that fixture ability is not a product virtual-display provisioning feature. Capture maps logical displays to SurfaceFlinger IDs. Physical IDs and virtual display IDs are resolved separately; absent, nonunique or ambiguous virtual names are rejected. Focus is correlated with per-display window tokens; unknown focus is reported as null rather than invented as false. Text input accepts printable ASCII, excluding the ADB-reserved literal sequence %s, up to 4096 bytes. Unsupported text, keys and components fail whole-program preflight. Android I/O uses a shared operation deadline, including handshake and partial reads; this is not a promise that arbitrary filesystem work or a multi-step program finishes within 15 seconds. The tested Android 16 device exposes window metadata, but its uiautomator command does not offer XML dumping. The result reports this observation source explicitly. Other devices and permission configurations can expose different accessibility capabilities. Peripheral interfaces See device I/O for serial configuration/restoration, exact USB selection, transfer bounds, partial completion and cleanup. Device operations use the same runtime and MCP command schema.

title: ChatGPT desktop module
body: 用有界脚本观察和操作桌面、浏览器与设备，并支持持久会话。 ChatGPT desktop module chatgpt-desktop.zuse provides importable native desktop helpers for inspecting a conversation, preparing a draft, and invoking a separately authorized send action. Importing the module registers its functions without observing or changing an application. The helpers use native windows and desktop accessibility; they do not connect to a browser, navigate, focus a window, type keys, or move the pointer. Load and inspect the functions Run the catalog from the repository root. It needs no desktop connection: zuse run examples/chatgpt-desktop-catalog.zuse --read-only For live work, use one persistent shell and import the module once: import(path="skills/zuse/assets/chatgpt-desktop.zuse", as="chatgpt") functions(namespace="chatgpt") chatgpt.windows() The returned catalog describes every parameter and each function's intended effect. The current scoped desktop implementation uses Linux AT-SPI. Confirm the actual backend with zuse doctor; a window title alone does not establish which desktop application owns it. This module contains no built-in ChatGPT installation path, account, conversation title, node path, or button index. Function Effect windows() List native windows for target selection. inspect_window(scope) Observe one selected native window subtree. read_conversation(scope) Observe one selected conversation subtree. read_draft(editor) Return the selected editor's current native observation. prepare_draft(editor, pid, message) Require the selected process and an empty editor, write and read back the same native object, then observe the editor. send_prepared(send_button, action_index) Invoke exactly one native action at the supplied node and index. Check the target and empty draft before writing The calling agent identifies the intended conversation. The native edit primitive then checks the editor's process and exact empty text immediately before writing, and verifies the written text on the same resolved object. Select the unique intended desktop conversation. Match the actual native window and process to its accessibility window, inspect that window, and identify the requested conversation and editor within it. Use a dedicated test conversation for acceptance work. Require a complete observation: truncated must be false and errors must be zero. Stop when the candidate is absent, ambiguous, stale, or belongs to a browser instead of the intended desktop application. Read the exact editor text and require it to be empty. Call read_draft(editor) immediately before preparation. Check the selected editor's text field is exactly ""; whitespace, existing text, [redacted], a missing field, and an unavailable node all require stopping. Check the same observed path, process, role and editor identity. Pass the observed positive process ID as pid. The module also supplies expected_text="" and expected_pid=pid to the native edit operation; a failed precondition stops the operation before any text is written. Compare the prepared draft with the intended text. Call prepare_draft once. Its first result contains the native edit receipt with the complete bounded text, checked pid, and verified=true; its second result observes the editor subtree. Check that both belong to the original target. Native snapshots preview at most 4096 characters, while the edit check and receipt cover up to 64 KiB of text. If preparation fails or its result is uncertain, observe the editor before deciding what to do next. Supply the actual observed paths as string parameters. Paths such as 0/application/window/editor are explanatory notation, not usable AT-SPI paths. Do not hardcode paths from an earlier application launch or infer a send action index from its position in a screenshot. Obtain the node's advertised action index from the current native snapshot. prepare_draft never requests focus. Accessibility paths use child indices; the native edit resolves its object once and keeps that object for its checks, write and readback. The process check catches a path that now points into a different application. The caller still establishes conversation identity and stops when the original window or conversation changes. Conditional native edits accessibility.set_text accepts optional expected_text and expected_pid parameters. An expected text may be empty; it is compared exactly without trimming. A missing or unreadable Text interface is rejected. A process ID must be a positive integer from the observed native application. Omitting both parameters keeps the existing unconditional edit behavior. Linux text edits hold the caller's input permission only while submitting the native request. Zuse builds the request before acquiring that permission, queues SetTextContents with the public dbus_connection_send_with_reply API, then releases the permission before waiting for the application reply or reading the edited object. A slow application reply therefore does not keep the cancellation dispatch gate or the host's input permission locked. The final dispatch check rejects a cancelled execution or denied input permission before queuing the request. Cancellation after submission stops local waiting but cannot retract the request already queued for the application. The error starts with cancelled: and explicitly says that text was submitted and completion was not confirmed. A reply timeout also reports submission. Inspect the current draft before retrying either outcome; cancellation does not mean the editor stayed empty. Reply waiting uses 10 ms D-Bus I/O slices and a 1 s deadline. The slice size is not a general completion-latency guarantee: existing native callbacks and readback calls can take longer, but they run outside the input permission. The AT-SPI serialization lock still protects the native connection while these calls run. Windows and macOS currently return unsupported_state before input when either condition is supplied; their existing unconditional edit path is unchanged. After a guarded write, Zuse reads the same native object and requires its full bounded text to match the requested value. If an application changes that text or readback becomes unavailable, the operation fails and subsequent batch commands stop. The error explicitly says that input was submitted, so the caller inspects the current editor instead of blindly retrying. AT-SPI checking, editing and readback use separate application calls. They do not form an atomic compare-and-set against concurrent user or application input. A process ID also identifies the application, not a particular conversation inside it. Keep these native checks together with the caller's unique conversation selection and normal user takeover mechanism. Keep sending separate Call send_prepared only after the user has authorized the specific target and message, and the draft checks above have passed. The module offers no automatic send, retry, conversation switching or follow-up loop. After the single action, call read_conversation on the same selected transcript and inspect the actual message state. When delivery is uncertain, inspect that state before any further action. Importing this module or preparing a draft grants no sending authority. Validation The module contract is covered by tests/chatgpt_desktop_module.rs. These tests exercise the real module loader and command preflight: imports have no effects, inspection works under read-only policy, writes and sends are rejected under that policy, message strings remain literal data, and input helpers contain no focus or shared-pointer operations. cargo test --locked --test chatgpt_desktop_module zuse check skills/zuse/assets/chatgpt-desktop.zuse zuse run examples/chatgpt-desktop-catalog.zuse --read-only The private GTK fixture additionally checks exact empty-text refusal, process mismatch, missing text, password refusal, input-permission cancellation, full text beyond the observation preview limit, application-modified readback, and module draft preparation without a send or focus change. A second native test holds a GTK text-change callback for 800 ms and checks that cancellation and the cancelled execution return before that application reply, after releasing the input permission. It also verifies that the following button action does not run: python3 tests/run_accessibility_native.py --test-target accessibility_guard_native Use --test-binary /absolute/path/to/accessibility_guard_native-HASH to reuse an already compiled integration-test harness. The launcher creates its own X display and accessibility bus; the fixture is a local test application, not a ChatGPT installation.
